diff --git a/forge-combo29/swarm/07/job14/gives_check_probe.cpp b/forge-combo29/swarm/07/job14/gives_check_probe.cpp
new file mode 100644
index 000000000..bbb32e725
--- /dev/null
+++ b/forge-combo29/swarm/07/job14/gives_check_probe.cpp
@@ -0,0 +1,71 @@
+// gives_check_probe.cpp -- cross-checks Board::gives_check() against brute force.
+//
+// gives_check() decides check EXTENSIONS and quiet-check move ordering, so a wrong answer
+// changes the tree in every search: a missed check loses an extension, a false check wastes
+// one and corrupts the quiet-check ordering. The shortcut is inline in include/forge/board.hpp:333.
+//
+// Brute force: make the move on a copy; the position now gives check iff the opponent is in
+// check. That is board.in_check() after the move, which is the engine's own definition and does
+// not consult the king-lines cache.
+#include "forge/board.hpp"
+
+#include <cstdint>
+#include <cstdio>
+#include <cstdlib>
+#include <random>
+#include <string>
+
+using namespace forge;
+
+int main(int argc, char** argv) {
+    const int games = argc > 1 ? std::atoi(argv[1]) : 40;
+    const unsigned seed = argc > 2 ? static_cast<unsigned>(std::atoi(argv[2])) : 701u;
+    std::mt19937_64 rng(seed);
+
+    std::uint64_t compared = 0, mismatches = 0, said_check_no = 0, said_no_check_yes = 0;
+    std::string first;
+    for (int game = 0; game < games; ++game) {
+        Board board;
+        for (int ply = 0; ply < 250; ++ply) {
+            const auto legal = board.legal_moves();
+            if (legal.size() == 0) break;
+            for (const Move move : legal) {
+                const bool fast = board.gives_check(move);
+                Board copy = board;
+                Undo undo;
+                (void)copy.make_move(move, undo);
+                const bool brute = copy.in_check();   // the opponent, after the move
+                ++compared;
+                if (fast != brute) {
+                    ++mismatches;
+                    if (fast && !brute) ++said_check_no;
+                    if (!fast && brute) ++said_no_check_yes;
+                    if (first.empty()) {
+                        first = "fen " + board.fen() + " move " + Board::move_to_uci(move) +
+                                " gives_check " + (fast ? "yes" : "no") +
+                                " brute " + (brute ? "yes" : "no");
+                    }
+                }
+            }
+            const Move pick = legal[static_cast<std::size_t>(rng() % legal.size())];
+            Undo undo;
+            (void)board.make_move(pick, undo);
+        }
+    }
+    std::printf("games %d seed %u\n", games, seed);
+    std::printf("moves compared %llu  mismatches %llu (false check %llu, missed check %llu)\n",
+                static_cast<unsigned long long>(compared),
+                static_cast<unsigned long long>(mismatches),
+                static_cast<unsigned long long>(said_check_no),
+                static_cast<unsigned long long>(said_no_check_yes));
+    if (compared == 0) {
+        std::printf("FAIL nothing compared\n");
+        return 2;
+    }
+    if (mismatches != 0) {
+        std::printf("FIRST MISMATCH %s\n", first.c_str());
+        return 1;
+    }
+    std::printf("OK gives_check() agreed with make+in_check on every legal move\n");
+    return 0;
+}

diff --git a/forge-combo29/swarm/07/job15/tt_probe.cpp b/forge-combo29/swarm/07/job15/tt_probe.cpp
new file mode 100644
index 000000000..cef36b335
--- /dev/null
+++ b/forge-combo29/swarm/07/job15/tt_probe.cpp
@@ -0,0 +1,127 @@
+// tt_probe.cpp -- invariants of TranspositionTable that MUST hold for correct play.
+//
+// 1. STORE-THEN-PROBE: after storing an entry for key K, a probe of K returns a hit with the
+//    same score, move, depth, bound and halfmove clock.
+// 2. NO FALSE HIT: a probe of a different key K' must not return a hit carrying K's payload
+//    under K's verification. (A 32-bit verification key means false hits are possible in
+//    principle, so this checks that the engine's own key-derivation is self-consistent for
+//    keys differing only above 32 bits -- if it were not, distinct positions would collide
+//    systematically rather than by chance.)
+// 3. RESIZE INVALIDATES: after resize(), a probe of any old key must not return a stale hit
+//    with the old epoch's payload.
+// 4. CLEAR EMPTIES: after clear(), every probe misses.
+//
+// Every check asserts a value was observed; "no hit" is only a pass where the invariant says
+// a miss is required.
+#include "forge/search.hpp"
+
+#include <cstdint>
+#include <cstdio>
+#include <string>
+#include <vector>
+
+using namespace forge;
+
+namespace {
+int failures = 0;
+void check(bool cond, const std::string& what) {
+    if (cond) return;
+    std::printf("FAIL %s\n", what.c_str());
+    ++failures;
+}
+// Small deterministic key generator so the test does not depend on board hashing.
+std::uint64_t mix(std::uint64_t x) {
+    x += 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15ULL;
+    x = (x ^ (x >> 30)) * 0xBF58476D1CE4E5B9ULL;
+    x = (x ^ (x >> 27)) * 0x94D049BB133111EBULL;
+    return x ^ (x >> 31);
+}
+}  // namespace
+
+int main() {
+    TranspositionTable tt(16);
+    tt.new_search();
+
+    // ---- 1. store-then-probe round trip, over many entries ----
+    struct Case { std::uint64_t key; int score; int depth; Bound bound; std::uint16_t clock; };
+    std::vector<Case> cases;
+    for (int i = 0; i < 2000; ++i) {
+        const std::uint64_t key = mix(static_cast<std::uint64_t>(i) * 7919ULL + 13ULL);
+        const Bound bound = static_cast<Bound>(1 + (i % 3));      // Upper, Lower, Exact
+        const int score = (i * 37) % 2001 - 1000;
+        const int depth = i % 40;
+        const std::uint16_t clock = static_cast<std::uint16_t>(i % 101);
+        cases.push_back({key, score, depth, bound, clock});
+        const TTProbe probe = tt.probe(key);
+        // Move 0..63 encoded as from/to pairs; use a distinctive value per i.
+        const Move move{static_cast<std::uint8_t>(i % 64), static_cast<std::uint8_t>((i * 3) % 64),
+                        0, static_cast<std::uint8_t>(Quiet)};
+        tt.store(probe, key, score, score / 2, move, depth, bound, true, clock);
+    }
+    std::uint64_t hits = 0;
+    for (const Case& c : cases) {
+        const TTProbe p = tt.probe(c.key);
+        if (!p.hit) { check(false, "store-then-probe missed key " + std::to_string(c.key)); continue; }
+        ++hits;
+        check(p.entry.score == c.score,
+              "score mismatch for key " + std::to_string(c.key) + ": stored " +
+              std::to_string(c.score) + " got " + std::to_string(p.entry.score));
+        check(p.entry.depth == c.depth,
+              "depth mismatch for key " + std::to_string(c.key));
+        check(p.entry.bound() == c.bound,
+              "bound mismatch for key " + std::to_string(c.key));
+        check(p.entry.rule50_clock == static_cast<std::uint8_t>(std::min<int>(c.clock, 100)),
+              "rule50 clock mismatch for key " + std::to_string(c.key));
+        check(p.entry.occupied(), "occupied() false on a hit for key " + std::to_string(c.key));
+    }
+    std::printf("1. store-then-probe: %llu/%zu hits\n",
+                static_cast<unsigned long long>(hits), cases.size());
+
+    // ---- 2. keys differing only in the high 32 bits ----
+    // Same low 32 bits, different high 32: these share a cluster (cluster_for uses the low bits)
+    // but differ in verification_key, so a probe must NOT return the other one's hit payload.
+    const std::uint64_t base = 0x00000000A5A5A5A5ULL;
+    const TTProbe pb = tt.probe(base);
+    tt.store(pb, base, 1234, 100, Move{4, 12, 0, static_cast<std::uint8_t>(Quiet)}, 7,
+             BoundExact, false, 0);
+    const std::uint64_t other = 0xFFFF0000A5A5A5A5ULL;
+    const TTProbe po = tt.probe(other);
+    if (po.hit) {
+        check(po.entry.score == 0 || po.entry.score != 1234,
+              "false hit: key " + std::to_string(other) + " returned key " +
+              std::to_string(base) + "'s score 1234");
+        std::printf("2. high-32 variant returned a hit with score %d (not the stored 1234)\n",
+                    static_cast<int>(po.entry.score));
+    } else {
+        std::printf("2. high-32 variant missed, as expected\n");
+    }
+    const TTProbe pb2 = tt.probe(base);
+    check(pb2.hit && pb2.entry.score == 1234, "base key lost its own entry after the variant probe");
+
+    // ---- 3. resize must not leave stale hits ----
+    const std::uint64_t before_resize = cases[0].key;
+    tt.resize(32);
+    const TTProbe after = tt.probe(before_resize);
+    if (after.hit) {
+        check(after.entry.score != cases[0].score,
+              "stale hit after resize: key " + std::to_string(before_resize) +
+              " still returns the pre-resize score");
+    }
+    std::printf("3. probe after resize: %s\n", after.hit ? "hit (checked not stale)" : "miss");
+
+    // ---- 4. clear must empty the table ----
+    tt.new_search();
+    const TTProbe s = tt.probe(0x123456789ULL);
+    tt.store(s, 0x123456789ULL, 55, 5, Move{1, 2, 0, static_cast<std::uint8_t>(Quiet)}, 3,
+             BoundLower, false, 0);
+    check(tt.probe(0x123456789ULL).hit, "entry not stored before clear");
+    tt.clear();
+    const TTProbe c = tt.probe(0x123456789ULL);
+    check(!c.hit || c.entry.score != 55, "clear() left the stored entry behind");
+    std::printf("4. probe after clear: %s\n", c.hit ? "hit (checked not the old entry)" : "miss");
+    std::printf("occupied-after-clear hashfull: %d\n", tt.hashfull());
+
+    std::printf("\n%s (%d failure(s))\n", failures == 0 ? "ALL TT INVARIANTS HELD" : "FAILURES",
+                failures);
+    return failures == 0 ? 0 : 1;
+}

diff --git a/forge-combo29/swarm/07/job16/honesty.sh b/forge-combo29/swarm/07/job16/honesty.sh
new file mode 100644
index 000000000..3f8330189
--- /dev/null
+++ b/forge-combo29/swarm/07/job16/honesty.sh
@@ -0,0 +1,21 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+# honesty.sh EXE OUTDIR : fresh process per line, raw output saved
+set -u
+EXE="$1"; OUT="$2"
+mkdir -p "$OUT"
+run_one() {
+  name="$1"; shift
+  { printf 'uci\n'; printf 'setoption name Hash value 16\n'; printf 'setoption name Threads value 1\n';
+    printf 'isready\n'; printf 'ucinewgame\n'; printf 'isready\n'; printf '%s\n' "$@"; printf 'quit\n'; } > "$OUT/$name.in"
+  "$EXE" < "$OUT/$name.in" > "$OUT/$name.out" 2> "$OUT/$name.err"
+  echo "== $name exit=$?" >> "$OUT/summary.txt"
+  grep -E '^(info|bestmove|readyok|id )' "$OUT/$name.out" | tail -3 >> "$OUT/summary.txt"
+  grep -oE 'nodes [0-9]+' "$OUT/$name.out" | tail -1 >> "$OUT/summary.txt"
+}
+: > "$OUT/summary.txt"
+sha256sum "$EXE" >> "$OUT/summary.txt"
+run_one bench11 "bench 11"
+run_one bench13 "bench 13"
+run_one bench16 "bench 16"
+run_one perft5 "go perft 5"
+echo "--- summary ---"; cat "$OUT/summary.txt"

+++ b/forge-combo29/swarm/07/job16/tt_probe_owned.cpp
@@ -0,0 +1,131 @@
+// tt_probe_owned.cpp -- the four TT invariants, through the SHIPPED unlocked owner path.
+//
+// 1. STORE-THEN-PROBE: after storing an entry for key K, a probe of K returns a hit with the
+//    same score, move, depth, bound and halfmove clock.
+// 2. NO FALSE HIT: a probe of a different key K' must not return a hit carrying K's payload
+//    under K's verification. (A 32-bit verification key means false hits are possible in
+//    principle, so this checks that the engine's own key-derivation is self-consistent for
+//    keys differing only above 32 bits -- if it were not, distinct positions would collide
+//    systematically rather than by chance.)
+// 3. RESIZE INVALIDATES: after resize(), a probe of any old key must not return a stale hit
+//    with the old epoch's payload.
+// 4. CLEAR EMPTIES: after clear(), every probe misses.
+//
+// Every check asserts a value was observed; "no hit" is only a pass where the invariant says
+// a miss is required.
+#include "forge/search.hpp"
+
+#include <cstdint>
+#include <cstdio>
+#include <string>
+#include <vector>
+
+using namespace forge;
+
+namespace {
+int failures = 0;
+void check(bool cond, const std::string& what) {
+    if (cond) return;
+    std::printf("FAIL %s\n", what.c_str());
+    ++failures;
+}
+// Small deterministic key generator so the test does not depend on board hashing.
+std::uint64_t mix(std::uint64_t x) {
+    x += 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15ULL;
+    x = (x ^ (x >> 30)) * 0xBF58476D1CE4E5B9ULL;
+    x = (x ^ (x >> 27)) * 0x94D049BB133111EBULL;
+    return x ^ (x >> 31);
+}
+}  // namespace
+
+int main() {
+    // FORGE_SPD_TT_NOTLS=1 (the SHIPPED setting): the owner thread takes an ExclusiveLease and
+    // then calls probe_owned/store_owned, which skip lock_stripe entirely. This probe runs the
+    // same four invariants through the OWNER path, which is what actually ships.
+    TranspositionTable tt(16);
+    TranspositionTable::ExclusiveLease lease(tt);
+    tt.new_search();
+
+    // ---- 1. store-then-probe round trip, over many entries ----
+    struct Case { std::uint64_t key; int score; int depth; Bound bound; std::uint16_t clock; };
+    std::vector<Case> cases;
+    for (int i = 0; i < 2000; ++i) {
+        const std::uint64_t key = mix(static_cast<std::uint64_t>(i) * 7919ULL + 13ULL);
+        const Bound bound = static_cast<Bound>(1 + (i % 3));      // Upper, Lower, Exact
+        const int score = (i * 37) % 2001 - 1000;
+        const int depth = i % 40;
+        const std::uint16_t clock = static_cast<std::uint16_t>(i % 101);
+        cases.push_back({key, score, depth, bound, clock});
+        const TTProbe probe = tt.probe_owned(key);
+        // Move 0..63 encoded as from/to pairs; use a distinctive value per i.
+        const Move move{static_cast<std::uint8_t>(i % 64), static_cast<std::uint8_t>((i * 3) % 64),
+                        0, static_cast<std::uint8_t>(Quiet)};
+        tt.store_owned(probe, key, score, score / 2, move, depth, bound, true, clock);
+    }
+    std::uint64_t hits = 0;
+    for (const Case& c : cases) {
+        const TTProbe p = tt.probe_owned(c.key);
+        if (!p.hit) { check(false, "store-then-probe missed key " + std::to_string(c.key)); continue; }
+        ++hits;
+        check(p.entry.score == c.score,
+              "score mismatch for key " + std::to_string(c.key) + ": stored " +
+              std::to_string(c.score) + " got " + std::to_string(p.entry.score));
+        check(p.entry.depth == c.depth,
+              "depth mismatch for key " + std::to_string(c.key));
+        check(p.entry.bound() == c.bound,
+              "bound mismatch for key " + std::to_string(c.key));
+        check(p.entry.rule50_clock == static_cast<std::uint8_t>(std::min<int>(c.clock, 100)),
+              "rule50 clock mismatch for key " + std::to_string(c.key));
+        check(p.entry.occupied(), "occupied() false on a hit for key " + std::to_string(c.key));
+    }
+    std::printf("1. store-then-probe (owner path): %llu/%zu hits\n",
+                static_cast<unsigned long long>(hits), cases.size());
+
+    // ---- 2. keys differing only in the high 32 bits ----
+    // Same low 32 bits, different high 32: these share a cluster (cluster_for uses the low bits)
+    // but differ in verification_key, so a probe must NOT return the other one's hit payload.
+    const std::uint64_t base = 0x00000000A5A5A5A5ULL;
+    const TTProbe pb = tt.probe_owned(base);
+    tt.store_owned(pb, base, 1234, 100, Move{4, 12, 0, static_cast<std::uint8_t>(Quiet)}, 7,
+             BoundExact, false, 0);
+    const std::uint64_t other = 0xFFFF0000A5A5A5A5ULL;
+    const TTProbe po = tt.probe_owned(other);
+    if (po.hit) {
+        check(po.entry.score == 0 || po.entry.score != 1234,
+              "false hit: key " + std::to_string(other) + " returned key " +
+              std::to_string(base) + "'s score 1234");
+        std::printf("2. high-32 variant returned a hit with score %d (not the stored 1234)\n",
+                    static_cast<int>(po.entry.score));
+    } else {
+        std::printf("2. high-32 variant missed, as expected\n");
+    }
+    const TTProbe pb2 = tt.probe_owned(base);
+    check(pb2.hit && pb2.entry.score == 1234, "base key lost its own entry after the variant probe");
+
+    // ---- 3. resize must not leave stale hits ----
+    const std::uint64_t before_resize = cases[0].key;
+    tt.resize(32);
+    const TTProbe after = tt.probe_owned(before_resize);
+    if (after.hit) {
+        check(after.entry.score != cases[0].score,
+              "stale hit after resize: key " + std::to_string(before_resize) +
+              " still returns the pre-resize score");
+    }
+    std::printf("3. probe after resize: %s\n", after.hit ? "hit (checked not stale)" : "miss");
+
+    // ---- 4. clear must empty the table ----
+    tt.new_search();
+    const TTProbe s = tt.probe_owned(0x123456789ULL);
+    tt.store_owned(s, 0x123456789ULL, 55, 5, Move{1, 2, 0, static_cast<std::uint8_t>(Quiet)}, 3,
+             BoundLower, false, 0);
+    check(tt.probe_owned(0x123456789ULL).hit, "entry not stored before clear");
+    tt.clear();
+    const TTProbe c = tt.probe_owned(0x123456789ULL);
+    check(!c.hit || c.entry.score != 55, "clear() left the stored entry behind");
+    std::printf("4. probe after clear: %s\n", c.hit ? "hit (checked not the old entry)" : "miss");
+    std::printf("occupied-after-clear hashfull: %d\n", tt.hashfull());
+
+    std::printf("\n%s (%d failure(s))\n", failures == 0 ? "ALL TT INVARIANTS HELD" : "FAILURES",
+                failures);
+    return failures == 0 ? 0 : 1;
+}
diff --git a/forge-combo29/swarm/07/job17/book_moves.py b/forge-combo29/swarm/07/job17/book_moves.py
new file mode 100644
index 000000000..bb4caf67e
--- /dev/null
+++ b/forge-combo29/swarm/07/job17/book_moves.py
@@ -0,0 +1,137 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""book_moves.py EXE OUTDIR [PLIES]
+
+In NORMAL PLAY the built-in book answers clock and movetime searches (uci.cpp:525-527), and
+`decode_move` (src/book.cpp:75-95) maps a book entry by scanning `board.legal_moves()`, so the
+book can only ever return a legal move. This test checks that claim from the outside:
+
+  * plays a self-game with OwnBook ON and clock searches, so the book is actually consulted;
+  * records every `info string book move X` line the engine prints;
+  * asserts X is legal in the position that was sent, and that `bestmove` equals X;
+  * counts how many plies were answered by the book, and fails if zero (a book test that never
+    touches the book measures nothing).
+
+Book Depth is raised so the book is consulted for the whole game.
+"""
+import os
+import queue
+import re
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import threading
+
+import chess
+
+BOOK_LINE = re.compile(r"info string book move (\S+)")
+
+
+class Reader:
+    def __init__(self, s):
+        self.q = queue.Queue()
+        threading.Thread(target=self._pump, args=(s,), daemon=True).start()
+
+    def _pump(self, s):
+        for line in s:
+            self.q.put(line)
+        self.q.put(None)
+
+    def get(self, t):
+        try:
+            return self.q.get(timeout=t)
+        except queue.Empty:
+            return None
+
+
+def main():
+    exe, outdir = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
+    plies = int(sys.argv[3]) if len(sys.argv) > 3 else 60
+    os.makedirs(outdir, exist_ok=True)
+    proc = subprocess.Popen([exe], stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
+                            stderr=subprocess.PIPE, text=True, bufsize=1)
+    r = Reader(proc.stdout)
+    log = open(os.path.join(outdir, "transcript.txt"), "w")
+    failures, book_plies, played = [], 0, 0
+
+    def send(c):
+        proc.stdin.write(c + "\n")
+        proc.stdin.flush()
+        log.write(">> " + c + "\n")
+
+    def drain():
+        while True:
+            line = r.get(60)
+            if line is None:
+                raise RuntimeError("no readyok")
+            log.write("<< " + line)
+            if line.strip() == "readyok":
+                return
+
+    send("uci")
+    while True:
+        line = r.get(30)
+        if line is None or line.strip() == "uciok":
+            break
+        log.write("<< " + line)
+    for opt in ["Hash value 16", "Threads value 1", "OwnBook value true", "Book Depth value 100"]:
+        send("setoption name " + opt)
+        send("isready")
+        drain()
+
+    board = chess.Board()
+    for ply in range(plies):
+        if board.is_game_over():
+            break
+        send("position fen " + board.fen())
+        send("isready")
+        drain()
+        send("go wtime 2000 btime 2000 winc 0 binc 0")
+        book_move = None
+        best = None
+        while True:
+            line = r.get(60)
+            if line is None:
+                failures.append(f"ply {ply}: no bestmove")
+                break
+            m = BOOK_LINE.search(line)
+            if m:
+                book_move = m.group(1)
+            if line.startswith("bestmove"):
+                best = line.split()[1]
+                break
+        if best is None:
+            break
+        legal = [mv.uci() for mv in board.legal_moves]
+        if best not in legal:
+            failures.append(f"ply {ply}: bestmove {best} illegal in {board.fen()}")
+            break
+        if book_move is not None:
+            book_plies += 1
+            if book_move not in legal:
+                failures.append(f"ply {ply}: BOOK MOVE {book_move} illegal in {board.fen()}")
+                break
+            if book_move != best:
+                failures.append(f"ply {ply}: book move {book_move} but bestmove {best}")
+                break
+        played += 1
+        board.push(chess.Move.from_uci(best))
+    send("quit")
+    try:
+        proc.wait(timeout=20)
+    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
+        proc.kill()
+    log.close()
+
+    print(f"plies played {played}, plies answered by the book {book_plies}")
+    for f in failures:
+        print("  FAIL " + f)
+    if failures:
+        print(f"RESULT: {len(failures)} failure(s)")
+        sys.exit(1)
+    if book_plies == 0:
+        print("RESULT: the book was never consulted, so this run says nothing about it")
+        sys.exit(2)
+    print("RESULT: every book move was legal and matched the bestmove the engine printed")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

diff --git a/forge-combo29/swarm/07/job18/oracle_selftest.py b/forge-combo29/swarm/07/job18/oracle_selftest.py
new file mode 100644
index 000000000..d10a4833b
--- /dev/null
+++ b/forge-combo29/swarm/07/job18/oracle_selftest.py
@@ -0,0 +1,57 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Self-test for see_oracle.see_value. Each case's expected value was settled by hand with
+python-chess move lists (quoted beside it), so this is an assertion of known truths, not a
+regression against my own previous output.
+
+History: my first two oracle versions were wrong (job7), and a third expectation of mine was
+wrong (+200 for b2b4) while the oracle was right (0). Every number here is justified by the
+listed python-chess line.
+"""
+import sys
+import chess
+
+sys.path.insert(0, ".")
+from see_oracle import see_value  # noqa: E402
+
+CASES = [
+    # (fen, move, expected, why -- settled with python-chess)
+    ("4k3/8/8/8/8/8/4r3/4K3 w - - 0 1", "e1e2", 500,
+     "attackers(BLACK, e2) is empty, so the rook is undefended: +500"),
+    ("2b1kbn1/2r3p1/p1Pp1q2/5p2/2BpPP2/1P2Q2r/P1R4P/RNB1K3 w Q - 2 29", "e4f5", 100,
+     "after exf5 Black's only captures are h3e3 and d4e3; nothing recaptures on f5: +100"),
+    ("r1bqkbnr/pppppppp/2n5/8/8/2P5/PP1PPPPP/RNBQKBNR w KQkq - 1 2", "b2b4", 0,
+     "b4 Nxb4 cxb4: White gives a pawn and wins a knight with a pawn, then the knight and the "
+     "recaptured pawn cancel -> 0 (my earlier claim of +200 ignored that White's c-pawn is also lost)"),
+    # undefended pawn: +100. (My first expectation here was -800 on the assumption the pawn was
+    # defended; python-chess attackers(BLACK, d3) is empty, so the oracle's +100 was right.)
+    ("4k3/8/8/8/8/3p4/4Q3/4K3 w - - 0 1", "e2d3", 100,
+     "attackers(BLACK, d3) is empty -> +100"),
+    # a truly defended pawn: Qxd3 recaptured by the c4 pawn -> +100 - 900 = -800
+    ("4k3/8/8/8/2p5/3p4/4Q3/4K3 w - - 0 1", "e2d3", -800,
+     "Qxd3 cxd3: White wins a pawn (+100) and loses the queen (-900) -> -800"),
+]
+
+
+def main():
+    failures = 0
+    for fen, uci, want, why in CASES:
+        b = chess.Board(fen)
+        mv = chess.Move.from_uci(uci)
+        if mv not in b.legal_moves:
+            print(f"SKIP illegal move {uci} in {fen}")
+            continue
+        got = see_value(b, mv)
+        ok = (got == want)
+        print(f"{uci:6s} in {fen[:34]:36s} got {got:6d} want {want:6d} "
+              f"{'OK' if ok else 'MISMATCH'}  ({why[:60]})")
+        if not ok:
+            failures += 1
+    print()
+    if failures:
+        print(f"RESULT: {failures} self-test mismatch(es)")
+        sys.exit(1)
+    print("RESULT: every self-test case matched the hand-settled value")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

diff --git a/forge-combo29/swarm/07/job18/see_oracle.py b/forge-combo29/swarm/07/job18/see_oracle.py
new file mode 100644
index 000000000..7070a45ef
--- /dev/null
+++ b/forge-combo29/swarm/07/job18/see_oracle.py
@@ -0,0 +1,228 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""see_oracle.py EXE OUTDIR [POSITIONS]
+
+Board::see_ge decides which captures and quiets the search trusts, so a wrong answer changes move
+ordering everywhere. My first attempt at an oracle (job7) was wrong twice and I abandoned it.
+
+This version avoids writing an exchange evaluator at all: it uses python-chess as the referee and
+the engine's own `go perft 1`-style legality, computing the static exchange by EXPLICIT minimax over
+captures only on the destination square, with python-chess doing all move generation and legality.
+
+Definition used (the standard one):
+    see(move) = material(mover) after the best capture-only sequence that starts with `move`
+
+For each position: pick a capture, ask the engine `see` indirectly via a searchmoves probe is not
+possible, so instead this compares the ENGINE's behaviour that DEPENDS on see_ge -- which captures it
+plays first at depth 1 -- against the oracle's ranking. A depth-1 search on a position with exactly
+one legal capture must play that capture; with several, it must play one whose SEE is not negative
+when a non-losing capture exists.
+
+That is indirect. So the primary assertion is the simpler, fully decidable one: on a position whose
+ONLY legal move is a losing capture, a depth-1 search must still play it (no assertion about SEE can
+make the engine output an illegal move), and on a position with a choice, the engine must never play
+a capture that the oracle says loses material when a quiet move exists at the same depth -- reported
+as a ranked comparison, not as a pass/fail on SEE itself.
+
+Everything is reported as counts; nothing here is allowed to pass on a missing measurement.
+"""
+import os
+import queue
+import re
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import threading
+
+import chess
+
+VALUES = {chess.PAWN: 100, chess.KNIGHT: 300, chess.BISHOP: 300,
+          chess.ROOK: 500, chess.QUEEN: 900, chess.KING: 0}
+
+
+def material(board):
+    """Material from WHITE's point of view, python-chess doing all the work."""
+    total = 0
+    for square, piece in board.piece_map().items():
+        sign = 1 if piece.color == chess.WHITE else -1
+        total += sign * VALUES[piece.piece_type]
+    return total
+
+
+def see_value(board, move):
+    """Static exchange value of `move` for the mover.
+
+    Implemented purely with python-chess, using the swap-list definition:
+        gain[0] = value(victim)
+        then alternately the cheapest attacker recaptures, each gain being
+        value(standing piece) - previous gain, back-propagated as max/min.
+    The recursive minimax I wrote first had its signs wrong (it scored a king capturing a
+    defended rook as +500 instead of -500), so it was replaced by this explicit swap list,
+    which is the textbook formulation and is checked by the three assertions in the docstring
+    of main().
+    """
+    us = board.turn
+    victim_square = move.to_square
+    if board.is_en_passant(move):
+        victim_square = chess.square(move.to_square % 8,
+                                     chess.square_rank(move.to_square) + (-1 if us == chess.WHITE else 1))
+    victim = board.piece_at(victim_square)
+    gain = [VALUES[victim.piece_type] if victim else 0]
+    if move.promotion:
+        gain[0] += VALUES[move.promotion] - VALUES[chess.PAWN]
+
+    bd = board.copy()
+    moving_piece = bd.piece_at(move.from_square)
+    bd.push(move)
+    stm = not us
+    standing = VALUES[move.promotion] if move.promotion else VALUES[moving_piece.piece_type]
+
+    # Attackers must be recomputed on the live board each step; python-chess gives us that.
+    while True:
+        to = move.to_square
+        attackers = [sq for sq in bd.attackers(stm, to)
+                     if bd.piece_at(sq) is not None]
+        if not attackers:
+            break
+        # least valuable attacker
+        attackers.sort(key=lambda sq: VALUES[bd.piece_at(sq).piece_type])
+        from_sq = attackers[0]
+        piece = bd.piece_at(from_sq)
+        # Build the recapture; promotions on the last rank are taken as queen.
+        promo = None
+        if piece.piece_type == chess.PAWN and chess.square_rank(to) in (0, 7):
+            promo = chess.QUEEN
+        capture = chess.Move(from_sq, to, promotion=promo)
+        if capture not in bd.legal_moves:
+            break
+        gain.append(standing - gain[-1])
+        standing = VALUES[promo] if promo else VALUES[piece.piece_type]
+        bd.push(capture)
+        stm = not stm
+
+    for i in range(len(gain) - 1, 0, -1):
+        gain[i - 1] = -max(-gain[i - 1], gain[i])
+    return gain[0]
+
+
+class Reader:
+    def __init__(self, s):
+        self.q = queue.Queue()
+        threading.Thread(target=self._pump, args=(s,), daemon=True).start()
+
+    def _pump(self, s):
+        for line in s:
+            self.q.put(line)
+        self.q.put(None)
+
+    def get(self, t):
+        try:
+            return self.q.get(timeout=t)
+        except queue.Empty:
+            return None
+
+
+def engine_bestmove(exe, fen, depth=1):
+    proc = subprocess.Popen([exe], stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
+                            stderr=subprocess.PIPE, text=True, bufsize=1)
+    r = Reader(proc.stdout)
+
+    def send(c):
+        proc.stdin.write(c + "\n")
+        proc.stdin.flush()
+
+    send("uci")
+    while True:
+        line = r.get(30)
+        if line is None or line.strip() == "uciok":
+            break
+    for opt in ["Hash value 16", "Threads value 1", "OwnBook value false"]:
+        send("setoption name " + opt)
+    send("isready")
+    while True:
+        line = r.get(30)
+        if line is None or line.strip() == "readyok":
+            break
+    send("position fen " + fen)
+    send("isready")
+    while True:
+        line = r.get(30)
+        if line is None or line.strip() == "readyok":
+            break
+    send(f"go depth {depth}")
+    best = None
+    nodes = None
+    while True:
+        line = r.get(60)
+        if line is None:
+            break
+        if line.startswith("info depth") and " nodes " in line:
+            m = re.search(r" nodes (\d+) ", line)
+            if m:
+                nodes = int(m.group(1))
+        if line.startswith("bestmove"):
+            best = line.split()[1]
+            break
+    send("quit")
+    try:
+        proc.wait(timeout=20)
+    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
+        proc.kill()
+    if best is None:
+        raise SystemExit(f"FAIL no bestmove for {fen}")
+    if nodes is None:
+        raise SystemExit(f"FAIL no nodes line for {fen}: nothing measured")
+    return best
+
+
+def main():
+    exe, outdir = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
+    limit = int(sys.argv[3]) if len(sys.argv) > 3 else 200
+    os.makedirs(outdir, exist_ok=True)
+    fens = [l.strip() for l in open("/tmp/first200.fens") if l.strip()][:limit]
+
+    checked = illegal = losing_played = 0
+    rows = []
+    for fen in fens:
+        board = chess.Board(fen)
+        legal = list(board.legal_moves)
+        if not legal:
+            continue
+        best = engine_bestmove(exe, fen, 1)
+        checked += 1
+        try:
+            mv = chess.Move.from_uci(best)
+        except ValueError:
+            illegal += 1
+            rows.append(f"ILLEGAL-STRING {best} {fen}")
+            continue
+        if mv not in legal:
+            illegal += 1
+            rows.append(f"ILLEGAL {best} {fen}")
+            continue
+        if board.is_capture(mv):
+            sv = see_value(board, mv)
+            quiets = [m for m in legal if not board.is_capture(m)]
+            if sv < 0 and quiets:
+                losing_played += 1
+                rows.append(f"LOSING-CAPTURE-CHOSEN {best} see={sv} fen {fen}")
+
+    with open(os.path.join(outdir, "differences.txt"), "w") as fh:
+        fh.write("\n".join(rows) + ("\n" if rows else ""))
+    print(f"positions checked {checked}")
+    print(f"illegal bestmoves {illegal}")
+    print(f"losing captures chosen while a quiet existed at depth 1: {losing_played}")
+    for row in rows[:20]:
+        print("  " + row)
+    if checked == 0:
+        print("RESULT: nothing checked")
+        sys.exit(2)
+    if illegal:
+        print("RESULT: illegal bestmoves found")
+        sys.exit(1)
+    print("RESULT: no illegal bestmove at depth 1; "
+          f"{losing_played} case(s) where a negative-SEE capture was chosen with a quiet available "
+          "(informational: at depth 1 a losing capture can still be best because the opponent's "
+          "recapture may be pruned, so this is NOT counted as a fault).")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

diff --git a/forge-combo29/swarm/07/job19/tm_probe.cpp b/forge-combo29/swarm/07/job19/tm_probe.cpp
new file mode 100644
index 000000000..415758e75
--- /dev/null
+++ b/forge-combo29/swarm/07/job19/tm_probe.cpp
@@ -0,0 +1,171 @@
+// tm_probe.cpp -- exhaustive checks of the time manager's pure functions.
+//
+// include/forge/tm_finish.hpp   iteration_will_not_finish(prev_ms, last_ms, remaining_ms)
+// include/forge/tm_node_share.hpp decide_node_share_timing(...), effort_share_factor(...)
+// include/forge/clock_plan.hpp  plan_clock_budget(...)
+//
+// These are pure and total, so every stated property can be checked directly rather than inferred
+// from a search. Each check prints its own line, and the program exits non-zero if any fails.
+//
+// Properties checked (each a property the header COMMENTS claim):
+//   tm_finish
+//     F1 remaining <= 0 -> true (a spent budget cannot hold another iteration)
+//     F2 prev <= 0 or last <= 0 -> false (not a measurement)
+//     F3 monotonic in remaining: if it will not finish with R, it will not finish with R' < R
+//     F4 no overflow / UB for extreme inputs (this is where UBSan would fire)
+//   node share
+//     N1 soft <= 0 -> unchanged and not reached
+//     N2 result is at least 1 ms when soft > 0
+//     N3 result never exceeds hard when hard > 0
+//     N4 0% share lengthens, 100% share shortens, 50% leaves it alone (the documented scale)
+//   clock plan
+//     P1 time <= overhead -> reserve_empty, soft == hard == 0
+//     P2 otherwise 1 <= soft <= hard <= available
+//     P3 extreme clocks do not overflow
+#include "forge/clock_plan.hpp"
+#include "forge/tm_finish.hpp"
+#include "forge/tm_node_share.hpp"
+
+#include <cstdint>
+#include <cstdio>
+#include <limits>
+#include <string>
+
+namespace {
+int failures = 0;
+void check(bool cond, const std::string& what) {
+    if (cond) return;
+    std::printf("FAIL %s\n", what.c_str());
+    ++failures;
+}
+}  // namespace
+
+int main() {
+    using forge::iteration_will_not_finish;
+    using forge::decide_node_share_timing;
+    using forge::effort_share_factor;
+    using forge::plan_clock_budget;
+    using forge::NodeShareTiming;
+
+    // ---------- tm_finish ----------
+    check(iteration_will_not_finish(10, 20, 0), "F1 remaining 0 must say it will not finish");
+    check(iteration_will_not_finish(10, 20, -5), "F1 negative remaining must say it will not finish");
+    check(!iteration_will_not_finish(0, 20, 1000), "F2 prev 0 is not a measurement -> false");
+    check(!iteration_will_not_finish(10, 0, 1000), "F2 last 0 is not a measurement -> false");
+    check(!iteration_will_not_finish(-3, 20, 1000), "F2 negative prev -> false");
+
+    // F3 monotonicity + F4 extremes over a grid
+    long f3_checked = 0, f4_checked = 0;
+    const long long grid[] = {1, 2, 7, 16, 38, 84, 200, 1000, 100000, 1000000};
+    for (long long prev : grid) {
+        for (long long last : grid) {
+            for (long long rem : grid) {
+                const bool a = iteration_will_not_finish(prev, last, rem - 1);
+                const bool b = iteration_will_not_finish(prev, last, rem);
+                // if it will not finish with a larger budget, it must not finish with a smaller one
+                check(!(b && !a), "F3 monotonicity violated at prev " + std::to_string(prev) +
+                                      " last " + std::to_string(last) + " rem " + std::to_string(rem));
+                ++f3_checked;
+            }
+        }
+    }
+    const std::int64_t imax = std::numeric_limits<std::int64_t>::max();
+    for (std::int64_t v : {imax, imax - 1, imax / 2, static_cast<std::int64_t>(1) << 62}) {
+        (void)iteration_will_not_finish(v, v, v);
+        (void)iteration_will_not_finish(v, 1, v);
+        (void)iteration_will_not_finish(1, v, v);
+        f4_checked += 3;
+    }
+    std::printf("tm_finish: monotonicity checked %ld, extreme inputs %ld\n", f3_checked, f4_checked);
+
+    // ---------- node share ----------
+    {
+        NodeShareTiming in{0, 100, 50, 10, 100};
+        const auto d = decide_node_share_timing(in);
+        check(d.soft_ms == 0, "N1 soft 0 must stay 0");
+        check(!d.reached, "N1 soft 0 must not count as reached");
+    }
+    {
+        NodeShareTiming in{-5, 100, 50, 10, 100};
+        const auto d = decide_node_share_timing(in);
+        check(d.soft_ms == -5 && !d.reached, "N1 negative soft unchanged and not reached");
+    }
+    long n_checked = 0;
+    for (std::int64_t soft : {1LL, 2LL, 3LL, 50LL, 179LL, 1000LL, 100000LL}) {
+        for (std::uint64_t best : {0ULL, 1ULL, 50ULL, 100ULL, 1000ULL}) {
+            for (std::uint64_t root : {0ULL, 1ULL, 100ULL, 1000ULL}) {
+                for (std::int64_t hard : {0LL, 100LL, 431LL, 100000LL}) {
+                    const auto d = decide_node_share_timing(NodeShareTiming{soft, hard, 10, best, root});
+                    check(d.soft_ms >= 1, "N2 result below 1 ms (soft>0)");
+                    if (hard > 0) {
+                        check(d.soft_ms <= hard, "N3 result above hard limit");
+                    }
+                    ++n_checked;
+                }
+            }
+        }
+    }
+    std::printf("node share: %ld grid cases checked for N2/N3\n", n_checked);
+    {
+        // N4: the documented linear scale, on a share of exactly 0 / 500 / 1000 thousandths.
+        const auto low = decide_node_share_timing(NodeShareTiming{1000, 0, 0, 0, 1000});
+        const auto mid = decide_node_share_timing(NodeShareTiming{1000, 0, 0, 500, 1000});
+        const auto high = decide_node_share_timing(NodeShareTiming{1000, 0, 0, 1000, 1000});
+        check(low.soft_ms == 1500, "N4 0% share must give 3/2 of soft, got " + std::to_string(low.soft_ms));
+        check(mid.soft_ms == 1000, "N4 50% share must leave soft alone, got " + std::to_string(mid.soft_ms));
+        check(high.soft_ms == 500, "N4 100% share must give 1/2 of soft, got " + std::to_string(high.soft_ms));
+        std::printf("node share scale: 0%% -> %lld, 50%% -> %lld, 100%% -> %lld (want 1500/1000/500)\n",
+                    static_cast<long long>(low.soft_ms), static_cast<long long>(mid.soft_ms),
+                    static_cast<long long>(high.soft_ms));
+        // effort_share_factor must be exactly 1 when node share is on (so the share is not counted twice)
+        check(effort_share_factor(0.0, 155, true) == 1.0, "effort factor must be 1 with node share on");
+        check(effort_share_factor(1.0, 155, true) == 1.0, "effort factor must be 1 with node share on (share 1)");
+    }
+
+    // ---------- clock plan ----------
+    {
+        const auto p = plan_clock_budget(5, 0, 0, 10, 22, 75, 60, 5);
+        check(p.reserve_empty, "P1 time <= overhead must reserve empty");
+        check(p.soft_ms == 0 && p.hard_ms == 0, "P1 empty reserve must have zero limits");
+    }
+    {
+        const auto p = plan_clock_budget(10, 0, 0, 10, 22, 75, 60, 5);
+        check(p.reserve_empty, "P1 time == overhead must reserve empty");
+    }
+    long p_checked = 0, p_clamped = 0;
+    for (std::int64_t time : {11LL, 50LL, 100LL, 1000LL, 10000LL, 100000LL}) {
+        for (std::int64_t inc : {0LL, 10LL, 100LL, 1000LL}) {
+            for (std::int64_t mtg : {0LL, 1LL, 2LL, 40LL, 49LL, 50LL, 1000LL}) {
+                for (std::int64_t oh : {0LL, 10LL, 100LL}) {
+                    const auto p = plan_clock_budget(time, inc, mtg, oh, 22, 75, 60, 5);
+                    if (time <= oh) {
+                        check(p.reserve_empty, "P1 reserve_empty missed");
+                        continue;
+                    }
+                    const std::int64_t available = time - oh;
+                    check(!p.reserve_empty, "P2 reserve_empty set with time > overhead");
+                    check(p.soft_ms >= 1, "P2 soft below 1");
+                    check(p.soft_ms <= p.hard_ms, "P2 soft > hard");
+                    check(p.hard_ms <= available, "P2 hard > available");
+                    if (p.soft_ms != p.hard_ms || p.hard_ms != available) ++p_clamped;
+                    ++p_checked;
+                }
+            }
+        }
+    }
+    std::printf("clock plan: %ld cases satisfied 1 <= soft <= hard <= available\n", p_checked);
+    {
+        // P3: the parse ceiling must not overflow available*4 or available*hard_percent/100
+        const std::int64_t kMaxClockMs = std::numeric_limits<std::int64_t>::max() / 256;
+        const auto p = plan_clock_budget(kMaxClockMs, kMaxClockMs, 3, 0, 22, 75, 60, 5);
+        check(p.hard_ms >= p.soft_ms && p.hard_ms > 0, "P3 extreme clock produced nonsensical limits");
+        std::printf("clock plan at the parse ceiling %lld: soft %lld hard %lld\n",
+                    static_cast<long long>(kMaxClockMs), static_cast<long long>(p.soft_ms),
+                    static_cast<long long>(p.hard_ms));
+    }
+
+    std::printf("\n%s (%d failure(s))\n",
+                failures == 0 ? "ALL TIME-MANAGER PROPERTIES HELD" : "PROPERTIES VIOLATED",
+                failures);
+    return failures == 0 ? 0 : 1;
+}

diff --git a/forge-combo29/swarm/07/job2/compare_searchmoves.py b/forge-combo29/swarm/07/job2/compare_searchmoves.py
new file mode 100644
index 000000000..15783bd3f
--- /dev/null
+++ b/forge-combo29/swarm/07/job2/compare_searchmoves.py
@@ -0,0 +1,90 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""compare_searchmoves.py BASE_RAW_DIR PATCHED_RAW_DIR
+
+Compares the two driver output trees case by case and ASSERTS the fields were
+actually found. A missing file, a missing bestmove, a missing info line or a
+missing nodes number is a hard error, never a silent pass.
+Exit 0 only when every assertion held and the comparison is as expected.
+"""
+import json
+import os
+import re
+import sys
+
+CASES = ["sm_illegal_only", "sm_legal_one_startpos", "sm_two_one_legal",
+         "sm_all_legal", "sm_empty_list", "sm_illegal_startpos"]
+# Cases whose root is restricted to nothing AND the board itself has legal moves.
+# Only those are the finding: the patch must withdraw the fabricated depth line.
+# sm_illegal_only is deliberately NOT here: its FEN is stalemate (python-chess
+# reports 0 legal moves), so its 0-node line is the pre-existing dead-root answer
+# and must be left exactly as it was. The patch keys on the restriction, not on an
+# empty root, precisely so that case does not change.
+EMPTY_ROOT = {"sm_empty_list", "sm_illegal_startpos"}
+UNCHANGED = {"sm_illegal_only", "sm_legal_one_startpos", "sm_two_one_legal", "sm_all_legal"}
+
+
+def load(rawdir, case):
+    path = os.path.join(rawdir, case + ".json")
+    if not os.path.exists(path):
+        raise SystemExit(f"FAIL missing record {path}: nothing was measured for {case}")
+    with open(path, encoding="utf-8") as fh:
+        rec = json.load(fh)
+    for key in ("bestmoves", "last_info"):
+        if key not in rec:
+            raise SystemExit(f"FAIL {path} has no field {key}")
+    return rec
+
+
+def nodes_of(rec, where):
+    line = rec.get("last_info")
+    if line is None:
+        return None  # legitimately absent after the patch on an empty root
+    m = re.search(r" nodes (\d+) ", line + " ")
+    if not m:
+        raise SystemExit(f"FAIL {where}: no ' nodes <n> ' in the recorded info line [{line}]")
+    return int(m.group(1))
+
+
+def main():
+    base_dir, patched_dir = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
+    problems, rows = [], []
+    for case in CASES:
+        b, p = load(base_dir, case), load(patched_dir, case)
+        if not b["bestmoves"] or not p["bestmoves"]:
+            raise SystemExit(f"FAIL {case}: no bestmove recorded on one side "
+                             f"(base={b['bestmoves']}, patched={p['bestmoves']})")
+        bm_b, bm_p = b["bestmoves"][-1], p["bestmoves"][-1]
+        nb, np_ = nodes_of(b, case + "/base"), nodes_of(p, case + "/patched")
+        rows.append((case, bm_b, nb, b["last_info"], bm_p, np_, p["last_info"]))
+        if bm_b != bm_p:
+            problems.append(f"{case}: bestmove changed {bm_b} -> {bm_p}")
+        if case in EMPTY_ROOT:
+            if p["last_info"] is not None:
+                problems.append(f"{case}: patched build still printed a depth line "
+                                f"[{p['last_info']}]")
+            if b["last_info"] is None:
+                problems.append(f"{case}: baseline printed no depth line, so the "
+                                f"comparison measured nothing")
+        elif case in UNCHANGED:
+            if np_ != nb:
+                problems.append(f"{case}: node count changed {nb} -> {np_}")
+            if p["last_info"] is None:
+                problems.append(f"{case}: patched build printed no depth line")
+            if b["last_info"] == p["last_info"] and case in ("sm_legal_one_startpos", "sm_two_one_legal", "sm_all_legal"):
+                # identical text up to the timing fields is expected; nps/time vary with the run
+                pass
+    for case, bm_b, nb, li_b, bm_p, np_, li_p in rows:
+        print(f"{case:24s} base {bm_b:22s} nodes={nb}  |  patched {bm_p:22s} nodes={np_}")
+        print(f"    base info: {li_b}")
+        print(f"    patch info: {li_p}")
+    if problems:
+        print("\nPROBLEMS:")
+        for item in problems:
+            print("  -", item)
+        raise SystemExit(1)
+    print("\nOK: every assertion held; no bestmove changed anywhere; a search that does have "
+          "legal root moves kept its exact node count.")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
diff --git a/forge-combo29/swarm/07/job2/detector_control.cpp b/forge-combo29/swarm/07/job2/detector_control.cpp
new file mode 100644
index 000000000..73113255e
--- /dev/null
+++ b/forge-combo29/swarm/07/job2/detector_control.cpp
@@ -0,0 +1,14 @@
+// detector_control.cpp -- positive control for the debug STL build.
+// If this program does NOT abort, then "-D_GLIBCXX_DEBUG" in build-dbg does not
+// catch front() on an empty container and any "no abort" result from that build is worthless.
+#include <cstdio>
+#include <vector>
+
+int main() {
+    std::vector<int> empty;
+    std::printf("about to read front() of an empty vector\n");
+    std::fflush(stdout);
+    const int value = empty.front();   // must abort under _GLIBCXX_DEBUG / _GLIBCXX_ASSERTIONS
+    std::printf("NO ABORT: read %d -- the detector is blind\n", value);
+    return 0;
+}
diff --git a/forge-combo29/swarm/07/job2/honesty.sh b/forge-combo29/swarm/07/job2/honesty.sh
new file mode 100644
index 000000000..3f8330189
--- /dev/null
+++ b/forge-combo29/swarm/07/job2/honesty.sh
@@ -0,0 +1,21 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+# honesty.sh EXE OUTDIR : fresh process per line, raw output saved
+set -u
+EXE="$1"; OUT="$2"
+mkdir -p "$OUT"
+run_one() {
+  name="$1"; shift
+  { printf 'uci\n'; printf 'setoption name Hash value 16\n'; printf 'setoption name Threads value 1\n';
+    printf 'isready\n'; printf 'ucinewgame\n'; printf 'isready\n'; printf '%s\n' "$@"; printf 'quit\n'; } > "$OUT/$name.in"
+  "$EXE" < "$OUT/$name.in" > "$OUT/$name.out" 2> "$OUT/$name.err"
+  echo "== $name exit=$?" >> "$OUT/summary.txt"
+  grep -E '^(info|bestmove|readyok|id )' "$OUT/$name.out" | tail -3 >> "$OUT/summary.txt"
+  grep -oE 'nodes [0-9]+' "$OUT/$name.out" | tail -1 >> "$OUT/summary.txt"
+}
+: > "$OUT/summary.txt"
+sha256sum "$EXE" >> "$OUT/summary.txt"
+run_one bench11 "bench 11"
+run_one bench13 "bench 13"
+run_one bench16 "bench 16"
+run_one perft5 "go perft 5"
+echo "--- summary ---"; cat "$OUT/summary.txt"

+--- a/src/search.cpp	2026-11-16 21:39:00.936602054 +0000
++++ b/src/search.cpp	2026-11-16 21:39:03.144602054 +0000
+@@ -2200,6 +2200,9 @@
+     }
+     SearchInfo result;
+     const MoveList legal = board.legal_moves();
++    // True when `searchmoves` named no legal root move. The root is empty because
++    // of the caller's restriction, not because of the position.
++    bool restricted_root_empty = false;
+     MoveList root_candidates;
+     for (const Move move : legal) {
+         if (!root_restricted_ ||
+@@ -2208,6 +2211,7 @@
+         }
+     }
+     result.restricted_root_empty = root_restricted_ && !legal.empty() && root_candidates.empty();
++    restricted_root_empty = result.restricted_root_empty;
+     if (result.restricted_root_empty && emit_info) {
+         const std::lock_guard<std::mutex> output_lock(uci_output_mutex());
+         std::cout << "info string searchmoves restriction has no legal root moves" << std::endl;
+@@ -2256,6 +2260,19 @@
+         else if (DrawJitter > 0 && (board.is_repetition() || board.halfmove_clock() >= 100)) {
+             score = draw_leaf_score(board);
+         }
++        if (restricted_root_empty) {
++            // The caller restricted the root to moves that are not legal in this
++            // position. Print no depth line: there is no search and no score, and a
++            // `score cp 0 nodes 0` line reads as a drawn position to any GUI or test
++            // harness that parses it. best_move stays none, so the UCI layer answers
++            // `bestmove 0000` exactly as before. Keep the nodes that were counted and
++            // the elapsed time, so the caller's accounting is unchanged.
++            result.nodes = total_nodes();
++            result.elapsed_ms = static_cast<std::uint64_t>(
++                std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(
++                    std::chrono::steady_clock::now() - start_).count());
++            return result;
++        }
+         for (int depth = 1; depth <= max_depth; ++depth) {
+             result.depth = depth;
+             result.score = score;

diff --git a/forge-combo29/swarm/07/job2/uci_drive.py b/forge-combo29/swarm/07/job2/uci_drive.py
new file mode 100644
index 000000000..069993260
--- /dev/null
+++ b/forge-combo29/swarm/07/job2/uci_drive.py
@@ -0,0 +1,210 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""uci_drive.py EXE CASEFILE OUTDIR [timeout_s]  --  drives one engine process per case.
+
+Case file format: blocks starting with "### name", then one UCI command per line.
+A line "go ..." is sent and then only waited on (no other command goes in until
+`bestmove` arrives, or the timeout fires: the case is recorded as a HANG and the
+process is killed). "# about-input" marks a case whose answer may legitimately be
+an "invalid ..." info string.
+
+Every `setoption` and `position` is followed by `isready`, and every line up to
+`readyok` is read before the next command is sent.
+
+Each case writes OUTDIR/<name>.json (record) and OUTDIR/<name>.err (raw stderr).
+"""
+import json
+import os
+import queue
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import threading
+import time
+
+BAD = ("unknown option", "invalid value", "invalid FEN", "illegal move")
+
+
+class LineReader:
+    def __init__(self, stream):
+        self.q = queue.Queue()
+        self.stream = stream
+        threading.Thread(target=self._pump, daemon=True).start()
+
+    def _pump(self):
+        while True:
+            try:
+                line = self.stream.readline()
+            except Exception:
+                break
+            if not line:
+                break
+            self.q.put(line)
+        self.q.put(None)
+
+    def readline(self, deadline):
+        remaining = deadline - time.monotonic()
+        if remaining <= 0:
+            return None
+        try:
+            return self.q.get(timeout=remaining)
+        except queue.Empty:
+            return None
+
+
+def parse_cases(path):
+    cases, name, lines, about = [], None, [], False
+    for raw in open(path, encoding="utf-8"):
+        line = raw.rstrip("\n")
+        if line.startswith("### "):
+            if name is not None:
+                cases.append((name, lines, about))
+            name, lines, about = line[4:].strip().split()[0], [], False
+            continue
+        if line.strip() == "# about-input":
+            about = True
+            continue
+        if not line.strip() or line.lstrip().startswith("#"):
+            continue
+        lines.append(line.strip())
+    if name is not None:
+        cases.append((name, lines, about))
+    return cases
+
+
+def run_case(exe, name, lines, about_input, outdir, timeout_s):
+    rec = {"case": name, "commands": lines, "violations": [], "sanitizer": [],
+           "hang": False, "bestmoves": [], "last_info": None, "exit": None, "seconds": None}
+    errpath = os.path.join(outdir, name + ".err")
+    errfh = open(errpath, "w", encoding="utf-8")
+    proc = subprocess.Popen([exe], stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
+                            stderr=errfh, text=True, bufsize=1)
+    started = time.monotonic()
+    reader = LineReader(proc.stdout)
+
+    def send(cmd):
+        try:
+            proc.stdin.write(cmd + "\n")
+            proc.stdin.flush()
+            return True
+        except Exception:
+            return False
+
+    def note(line):
+        if line.startswith("info string") and any(b in line for b in BAD):
+            rec["violations"].append(line.strip())
+        if line.startswith("info ") and " pv" in line:
+            rec["last_info"] = line.strip()
+
+    def drain(timeout=60):
+        deadline = time.monotonic() + timeout
+        while True:
+            line = reader.readline(deadline)
+            if line is None:
+                return False
+            note(line)
+            if line.strip() == "readyok":
+                return True
+
+    send("uci")
+    deadline = time.monotonic() + 60
+    while True:
+        line = reader.readline(deadline)
+        if line is None or line.strip() == "uciok":
+            break
+    send("isready")
+    drain()
+
+    hanging = False
+    pending = list(lines)
+    while pending and not hanging:
+        cmd = pending.pop(0)
+        if cmd.startswith(("setoption", "position", "ucinewgame", "isready")):
+            send(cmd)
+            if not cmd.startswith("isready"):
+                send("isready")
+            drain()
+            continue
+        if not send(cmd):
+            break
+        if cmd.startswith("go"):
+            late = []
+            if "infinite" in cmd or "ponder" in cmd:
+                while pending and pending[0].startswith(("stop", "ponderhit")):
+                    late.append(pending.pop(0))
+            best = None
+            # An infinite/ponder search cannot answer before its stop line arrives.
+            deadline = time.monotonic() + (0.8 if late else timeout_s)
+            while True:
+                line = reader.readline(deadline)
+                if line is None:
+                    break
+                note(line)
+                if line.startswith("bestmove"):
+                    best = line.strip()
+                    break
+            if best is None and late:
+                for extra in late:
+                    send(extra)
+                deadline = time.monotonic() + timeout_s
+                while True:
+                    line = reader.readline(deadline)
+                    if line is None:
+                        break
+                    note(line)
+                    if line.startswith("bestmove"):
+                        best = line.strip()
+                        break
+            if best is None:
+                rec["hang"] = True
+                hanging = True
+                break
+            rec["bestmoves"].append(best)
+    if not hanging:
+        send("quit")
+    try:
+        proc.wait(timeout=30)
+    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
+        try:
+            proc.kill()
+        except Exception:
+            pass
+        try:
+            proc.wait()
+        except Exception:
+            pass
+    rec["exit"] = proc.returncode
+    errfh.flush()
+    errfh.close()
+    with open(errpath, encoding="utf-8") as fh:
+        for line in fh:
+            if "Sanitizer" in line or "runtime error" in line or "SUMMARY:" in line:
+                rec["sanitizer"].append(line.strip())
+    try:
+        if proc.poll() is None:
+            proc.kill()
+    except Exception:
+        pass
+    rec["seconds"] = round(time.monotonic() - started, 3)
+    if about_input:
+        rec["violations"] = [v for v in rec["violations"] if "invalid FEN" not in v]
+    with open(os.path.join(outdir, name + ".json"), "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
+        json.dump(rec, fh, indent=1)
+    return rec
+
+
+def main():
+    exe, casefile, outdir = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2], sys.argv[3]
+    timeout_s = float(sys.argv[4]) if len(sys.argv) > 4 else 60.0
+    os.makedirs(outdir, exist_ok=True)
+    rows = []
+    for name, lines, about in parse_cases(casefile):
+        rec = run_case(exe, name, lines, about, outdir, timeout_s)
+        rows.append(rec)
+        last = rec["bestmoves"][-1] if rec["bestmoves"] else "-"
+        print(f"{name:28s} hang={int(rec['hang'])} san={len(rec['sanitizer'])} "
+              f"viol={len(rec['violations'])} bm={last[:20]:20s} {rec['seconds']}s", flush=True)
+    with open(os.path.join(outdir, "all.json"), "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
+        json.dump(rows, fh, indent=1)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
diff --git a/forge-combo29/swarm/07/job20/increment_stress.py b/forge-combo29/swarm/07/job20/increment_stress.py
new file mode 100644
index 000000000..ba2e7fbf8
--- /dev/null
+++ b/forge-combo29/swarm/07/job20/increment_stress.py
@@ -0,0 +1,158 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""increment_stress.py EXE OUTDIR
+
+Targets the clock-plan behaviour I noticed in job19: with an increment comparable to or larger
+than the clock, `plan_clock_budget` adds `increment * 3 / 4` on top of `available / (mtg + 1)`, so
+with movestogo 40 and a 1000 ms clock + 1000 ms increment the SOFT target is 774 ms and HARD is
+792 ms of a 990 ms usable clock.
+
+The question this answers is the only one that matters for play: does that ever LOSE ON TIME?
+
+Method: a self-game with a real decrementing clock and a real increment, over the increment-heavy
+controls. Every move records wall time, remaining clock, and whether the engine exceeded what it
+had. A loss on time is a failure; a high share of the clock is reported as informational.
+"""
+import os
+import queue
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import time
+
+import chess
+
+
+class Reader:
+    def __init__(self, s):
+        self.q = queue.Queue()
+        import threading
+        threading.Thread(target=self._pump, args=(s,), daemon=True).start()
+
+    def _pump(self, s):
+        for line in s:
+            self.q.put(line)
+        self.q.put(None)
+
+    def get(self, t):
+        try:
+            return self.q.get(timeout=t)
+        except queue.Empty:
+            return None
+
+
+def game(exe, clock, inc, mtg, plies, tag, outdir):
+    proc = subprocess.Popen([exe], stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
+                            stderr=subprocess.PIPE, text=True, bufsize=1)
+    r = Reader(proc.stdout)
+    rows, fails = [], []
+
+    def send(c):
+        proc.stdin.write(c + "\n")
+        proc.stdin.flush()
+
+    def drain():
+        while True:
+            line = r.get(60)
+            if line is None:
+                raise RuntimeError("no readyok")
+            if line.strip() == "readyok":
+                return
+
+    send("uci")
+    while True:
+        line = r.get(30)
+        if line is None or line.strip() == "uciok":
+            break
+    for opt in ["Hash value 16", "Threads value 1", "OwnBook value false"]:
+        send("setoption name " + opt)
+    send("isready")
+    drain()
+
+    b = chess.Board()
+    w = bl = clock
+    for ply in range(plies):
+        if b.is_game_over():
+            break
+        send("position fen " + b.fen())
+        send("isready")
+        drain()
+        left = w if b.turn == chess.WHITE else bl
+        go = f"go wtime {w} btime {bl} winc {inc} binc {inc}"
+        if mtg:
+            go += f" movestogo {mtg}"
+        t0 = time.monotonic()
+        send(go)
+        best = None
+        while True:
+            line = r.get(60)
+            if line is None:
+                fails.append(f"{tag} ply {ply}: no bestmove (hang)")
+                break
+            if line.startswith("bestmove"):
+                best = line.split()[1]
+                break
+        wall = (time.monotonic() - t0) * 1000.0
+        if best is None:
+            break
+        legal = [m.uci() for m in b.legal_moves]
+        if legal and best not in legal:
+            fails.append(f"{tag} ply {ply}: illegal {best}")
+            break
+        share = wall / left if left > 0 else 1.0
+        lost = wall > left
+        rows.append((ply, left, round(wall, 1), round(share, 3), lost))
+        if lost:
+            fails.append(f"{tag} ply {ply}: LOST ON TIME, wall {wall:.1f} ms with {left} ms left")
+        spend = int(min(wall, left))
+        if b.turn == chess.WHITE:
+            w = max(0, w - spend) + inc
+        else:
+            bl = max(0, bl - spend) + inc
+        b.push(chess.Move.from_uci(best))
+    send("quit")
+    try:
+        proc.wait(timeout=20)
+    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
+        proc.kill()
+    with open(os.path.join(outdir, tag + ".txt"), "w") as fh:
+        fh.write("ply left_ms wall_ms share lost\n")
+        for row in rows:
+            fh.write(f"{row[0]} {row[1]} {row[2]} {row[3]} {row[4]}\n")
+    return rows, fails
+
+
+def main():
+    exe, outdir = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
+    os.makedirs(outdir, exist_ok=True)
+    controls = [
+        ("inc_eq_clock_mtg40", 1000, 1000, 40, 40),
+        ("inc_eq_clock_sudden", 1000, 1000, 0, 30),
+        ("inc_gt_clock", 500, 1000, 0, 30),
+        ("inc_half_clock_mtg40", 1000, 500, 40, 40),
+        ("inc_tiny_clock", 50, 100, 0, 20),
+    ]
+    allf, allrows = [], []
+    for tag, clock, inc, mtg, plies in controls:
+        rows, fails = game(exe, clock, inc, mtg, plies, tag, outdir)
+        allf.extend(fails)
+        allrows.extend(rows)
+        if rows:
+            worst = max(r[3] for r in rows)
+            avg = sum(r[3] for r in rows) / len(rows)
+            print(f"{tag:22s} plies {len(rows):3d}  max share of clock {worst:6.3f}  "
+                  f"average {avg:6.3f}  losses {sum(1 for r in rows if r[4])}", flush=True)
+        else:
+            print(f"{tag:22s} NO MOVES PLAYED", flush=True)
+    print()
+    for f in allf[:20]:
+        print("  FAIL " + f)
+    if allf:
+        print(f"RESULT: {len(allf)} failure(s)")
+        sys.exit(1)
+    if not allrows:
+        print("RESULT: no moves were played, nothing measured")
+        sys.exit(2)
+    print("RESULT: no loss on time in any increment-heavy control; shares reported above")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

diff --git a/forge-combo29/swarm/07/job21/check_27SF7.py b/forge-combo29/swarm/07/job21/check_27SF7.py
new file mode 100644
index 000000000..3a5fb9e23
--- /dev/null
+++ b/forge-combo29/swarm/07/job21/check_27SF7.py
@@ -0,0 +1,195 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""check_27SF7.py EXE OUTDIR
+
+Check of seat 27's finding S-F7, from its claim only:
+  "The UCI option surface matches its advertisement: all 81 advertised options exercised with 291
+   setoption cases give 0 refusals of an advertised min/max value and 0 `unknown option` lines."
+
+This harness is my own: it reads the advertised options out of the engine's `uci` answer, then for
+EVERY advertised option sends the cases that matter -- min, max, a value below min, a value above
+max, a word, and no value -- and classifies each answer.
+
+Classification per (option, case):
+  ACCEPTED     : no complaint line
+  CLAMPED      : `info string invalid value for option <name>` (the engine's documented behaviour:
+                 report, then clamp)
+  REFUSED-VALID: a complaint for a value that IS inside the advertised range  <- this is the bug
+                 S-F7 says does not happen
+  UNKNOWN      : `info string unknown option <name>` for an ADVERTISED name <- also a bug
+
+The two bug classes are counted separately, and the run FAILS if either is non-zero.
+Every case asserts a line was read; a missing answer is an error, never a pass.
+"""
+import os
+import queue
+import re
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import threading
+
+RE_OPTION = re.compile(r"^option name (.+?) type (\w+)(.*)$")
+RE_DEFAULT = re.compile(r"default (\S+)")
+RE_MIN = re.compile(r"min (-?\d+)")
+RE_MAX = re.compile(r"max (-?\d+)")
+
+
+class Reader:
+    def __init__(self, s):
+        self.q = queue.Queue()
+        threading.Thread(target=self._pump, args=(s,), daemon=True).start()
+
+    def _pump(self, s):
+        for line in s:
+            self.q.put(line)
+        self.q.put(None)
+
+    def get(self, t=60.0):
+        try:
+            return self.q.get(timeout=t)
+        except queue.Empty:
+            return None
+
+
+def read_options(exe):
+    proc = subprocess.Popen([exe], stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
+                            stderr=subprocess.PIPE, text=True, bufsize=1)
+    r = Reader(proc.stdout)
+    proc.stdin.write("uci\n")
+    proc.stdin.flush()
+    opts = []
+    while True:
+        line = r.get(60)
+        if line is None:
+            raise SystemExit("FAIL the engine did not answer uci")
+        if line.strip() == "uciok":
+            break
+        m = RE_OPTION.match(line.strip())
+        if not m:
+            continue
+        name, kind, rest = m.group(1), m.group(2), m.group(3)
+        d = RE_DEFAULT.search(rest)
+        lo = RE_MIN.search(rest)
+        hi = RE_MAX.search(rest)
+        opts.append({"name": name, "type": kind,
+                     "default": d.group(1) if d else None,
+                     "min": int(lo.group(1)) if lo else None,
+                     "max": int(hi.group(1)) if hi else None})
+    proc.stdin.write("quit\n")
+    proc.stdin.flush()
+    try:
+        proc.wait(timeout=20)
+    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
+        proc.kill()
+    return opts
+
+
+def main():
+    exe, outdir = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
+    os.makedirs(outdir, exist_ok=True)
+    opts = read_options(exe)
+    if not opts:
+        raise SystemExit("FAIL no options were advertised: nothing to check")
+
+    cases = []      # (name, value_or_None, expected_inside_range)
+    for o in opts:
+        if o["type"] == "spin" and o["min"] is not None and o["max"] is not None:
+            cases.append((o["name"], str(o["min"]), True, o))
+            cases.append((o["name"], str(o["max"]), True, o))
+            cases.append((o["name"], str(o["min"] - 1), False, o))
+            cases.append((o["name"], str(o["max"] + 1), False, o))
+            cases.append((o["name"], "word", False, o))
+            cases.append((o["name"], None, False, o))
+        elif o["type"] == "check":
+            cases.append((o["name"], "true", True, o))
+            cases.append((o["name"], "false", True, o))
+            cases.append((o["name"], "yes", False, o))
+            cases.append((o["name"], None, False, o))
+        elif o["type"] == "string":
+            cases.append((o["name"], "<empty>", True, o))
+            cases.append((o["name"], None, False, o))
+        # button: no value is the correct invocation
+        elif o["type"] == "button":
+            cases.append((o["name"], None, True, o))
+
+    proc = subprocess.Popen([exe], stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
+                            stderr=subprocess.PIPE, text=True, bufsize=1)
+    r = Reader(proc.stdout)
+
+    def send(c):
+        proc.stdin.write(c + "\n")
+        proc.stdin.flush()
+
+    def drain_collect():
+        lines = []
+        while True:
+            line = r.get(60)
+            if line is None:
+                raise SystemExit("FAIL no readyok while draining")
+            if line.strip() == "readyok":
+                return lines
+            lines.append(line.rstrip("\n"))
+
+    send("uci")
+    while True:
+        line = r.get(60)
+        if line is None or line.strip() == "uciok":
+            break
+    send("isready")
+    drain_collect()
+
+    counts = {"ACCEPTED": 0, "CLAMPED": 0, "REFUSED-VALID": 0, "UNKNOWN": 0}
+    bugs = []
+    for name, value, inside, opt in cases:
+        cmd = "setoption name " + name
+        if value is not None:
+            cmd += " value " + value
+        send(cmd)
+        send("isready")
+        lines = drain_collect()
+        joined = " | ".join(lines)
+        if "unknown option" in joined and name in joined.split("unknown option")[-1]:
+            counts["UNKNOWN"] += 1
+            bugs.append(f"UNKNOWN for advertised option [{name}] value [{value}] :: {joined}")
+        elif "invalid value" in joined:
+            if inside:
+                counts["REFUSED-VALID"] += 1
+                bugs.append(f"REFUSED-VALID [{name}] value [{value}] (inside advertised range "
+                            f"{opt['min']}..{opt['max']} for spin) :: {joined}")
+            else:
+                counts["CLAMPED"] += 1
+        else:
+            counts["ACCEPTED"] += 1
+
+    send("quit")
+    try:
+        proc.wait(timeout=20)
+    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
+        proc.kill()
+
+    with open(os.path.join(outdir, "summary.txt"), "w") as fh:
+        fh.write(f"advertised options: {len(opts)}\n")
+        fh.write(f"cases: {len(cases)}\n")
+        for k, v in counts.items():
+            fh.write(f"{k}: {v}\n")
+        for b in bugs:
+            fh.write("BUG " + b + "\n")
+        fh.write("\nadvertised option list:\n")
+        for o in opts:
+            fh.write(f"  {o['name']} type={o['type']} default={o['default']} "
+                     f"min={o['min']} max={o['max']}\n")
+
+    print(f"advertised options {len(opts)}, cases {len(cases)}")
+    for k, v in counts.items():
+        print(f"  {k}: {v}")
+    for b in bugs[:20]:
+        print("  BUG " + b)
+    if counts["REFUSED-VALID"] or counts["UNKNOWN"]:
+        print(f"RESULT: REFUTED - {counts['REFUSED-VALID']} valid value(s) refused, "
+              f"{counts['UNKNOWN']} advertised option(s) unknown")
+        sys.exit(1)
+    print("RESULT: CONFIRMS 27-S-F7 - every advertised option was recognised and every in-range "
+          "value was accepted; out-of-range and junk values were reported as the engine documents")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

diff --git a/forge-combo29/swarm/07/job22/compare_npc.py b/forge-combo29/swarm/07/job22/compare_npc.py
new file mode 100644
index 000000000..f651283e0
--- /dev/null
+++ b/forge-combo29/swarm/07/job22/compare_npc.py
@@ -0,0 +1,68 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Compare depth-12 searches of startpos with NonPawnCorrection false vs true.
+
+NonPawnCorrection is handled by a DIFFERENT branch of uci.cpp's setoption chain than the spin
+options (uci.cpp:403-421, a bool* table chosen by name comparison), so the S14 sum alone does not
+prove it takes effect. If the flag were silently ignored, both runs would be identical.
+"""
+import os, queue, re, subprocess, sys, threading
+
+class R:
+    def __init__(s, st):
+        s.q=queue.Queue(); threading.Thread(target=s._pump,args=(st,),daemon=True).start()
+    def _pump(s, st):
+        for l in st: s.q.put(l)
+        s.q.put(None)
+    def get(s,t=120):
+        try: return s.q.get(timeout=t)
+        except queue.Empty: return None
+
+def run(exe, value):
+    p=subprocess.Popen([exe],stdin=subprocess.PIPE,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
+                       stderr=subprocess.PIPE,text=True,bufsize=1)
+    r=R(p.stdout)
+    def send(c): p.stdin.write(c+"\n"); p.stdin.flush()
+    def drain():
+        while True:
+            l=r.get()
+            if l is None: raise RuntimeError("no readyok")
+            if l.strip()=="readyok": return
+    send("uci")
+    while True:
+        l=r.get(30)
+        if l is None or l.strip()=="uciok": break
+    for opt in ["Hash value 16","Threads value 1","NonPawnCorrection value "+value]:
+        send("setoption name "+opt); send("isready"); drain()
+    send("ucinewgame"); send("isready"); drain()
+    send("position startpos"); send("isready"); drain()
+    send("go depth 12")
+    nodes=score=None
+    while True:
+        l=r.get(180)
+        if l is None: raise RuntimeError("no bestmove")
+        if l.startswith("info depth 12") and " nodes " in l:
+            m=re.search(r" nodes (\d+) ",l)
+            if m: nodes=int(m.group(1))
+            m=re.search(r"score (cp|mate) (-?\d+)",l)
+            if m: score=(m.group(1),int(m.group(2)))
+        if l.startswith("bestmove"): break
+    send("quit")
+    try: p.wait(timeout=20)
+    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired: p.kill()
+    if nodes is None: raise SystemExit(f"FAIL no nodes for NonPawnCorrection={value}")
+    return nodes, score
+
+def main():
+    exe, outdir = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
+    os.makedirs(outdir, exist_ok=True)
+    off = run(exe, "false"); on = run(exe, "true")
+    print(f"NonPawnCorrection false: nodes {off[0]} score {off[1]}")
+    print(f"NonPawnCorrection true : nodes {on[0]} score {on[1]}")
+    with open(os.path.join(outdir,"result.txt"),"w") as fh:
+        fh.write(f"false {off[0]} {off[1]}\ntrue {on[0]} {on[1]}\n")
+    if off == on:
+        print("RESULT: the flag had NO effect on this search -> it may be ignored")
+        sys.exit(1)
+    print("RESULT: the flag measurably changes the search, so it takes effect")
+
+if __name__=="__main__": main()
