new file mode 100644
index 000000000..1066311fa
--- /dev/null
+++ b/forge-combo29/swarm/07/job23/bool_options.py
@@ -0,0 +1,141 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Verify BY EFFECT that every advertised boolean option reaches the search.
+
+Each of these goes through uci.cpp:403-421's name-comparison chain into a bool*. A mis-wired
+target, or a name missing from that chain, would be accepted silently and change nothing. For each
+option: run a cold depth-12 search with the default, then with the opposite value, and require the
+node count to differ. A pair of identical node counts means the flag did not reach the search.
+
+Options that cannot show an effect on a bare depth-12 search (book, timing, protocol, spin options)
+are excluded deliberately and listed as excluded, not silently skipped.
+"""
+import os
+import queue
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import threading
+
+TARGETS = [
+    "ContHist4PlyRead", "NonPawnCorrection", "LmrDeeperShallower", "ThreatHistory",
+    "LmrSignedCorrection", "LmrLateParentRelief", "NullSeeVeto", "AspArmLate",
+    "EvasionOrdering", "QuietExtinction", "TmFinishIteration",
+    "HindsightDepth", "NullThreatVerify", "AspCappedReopen", "TmNodeShare",
+    "SoundMatePruning", "EvalRule50Damp", "DeadMaterial", "UseNNUE",
+]
+EXCLUDED = {
+    "Ponder": "affects the search protocol, not the tree",
+    "OwnBook": "controls whether the book answers; tested in job17",
+    "Hash": "spin", "Threads": "spin", "MultiPV": "spin", "Move Overhead": "spin",
+}
+
+
+class R:
+    def __init__(s, st):
+        s.q = queue.Queue()
+        threading.Thread(target=s._pump, args=(st,), daemon=True).start()
+
+    def _pump(s, st):
+        for l in st:
+            s.q.put(l)
+        s.q.put(None)
+
+    def get(s, t=180):
+        try:
+            return s.q.get(timeout=t)
+        except queue.Empty:
+            return None
+
+
+def search(exe, opt, value, depth=12, fen=None):
+    p = subprocess.Popen([exe], stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
+                         stderr=subprocess.PIPE, text=True, bufsize=1)
+    r = R(p.stdout)
+
+    def send(c):
+        p.stdin.write(c + "\n")
+        p.stdin.flush()
+
+    def drain():
+        while True:
+            l = r.get()
+            if l is None:
+                raise RuntimeError("no readyok")
+            if l.strip() == "readyok":
+                return
+
+    send("uci")
+    while True:
+        l = r.get(30)
+        if l is None or l.strip() == "uciok":
+            break
+    for o in ["Hash value 16", "Threads value 1", "OwnBook value false"]:
+        send("setoption name " + o)
+        send("isready")
+        drain()
+    if opt is not None:
+        send(f"setoption name {opt} value {value}")
+        send("isready")
+        drain()
+    send("ucinewgame")
+    send("isready")
+    drain()
+    send("position fen " + (fen or "rnbqkbnr/pppppppp/8/8/8/8/PPPPPPPP/RNBQKBNR w KQkq - 0 1"))
+    send("isready")
+    drain()
+    send(f"go depth {depth}")
+    nodes = None
+    while True:
+        l = r.get(240)
+        if l is None:
+            raise RuntimeError("no bestmove")
+        if l.startswith(f"info depth {depth}") and " nodes " in l:
+            try:
+                nodes = int(l.split(" nodes ")[1].split()[0])
+            except Exception:
+                pass
+        if l.startswith("bestmove"):
+            break
+    send("quit")
+    try:
+        p.wait(timeout=20)
+    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
+        p.kill()
+    if nodes is None:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"no nodes for {opt}={value}")
+    return nodes
+
+
+def main():
+    exe, outdir = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
+    os.makedirs(outdir, exist_ok=True)
+    base = search(exe, None, None)
+    rows, noeffect = [], []
+    print(f"baseline (all defaults): {base} nodes", flush=True)
+    for opt in TARGETS:
+        off = search(exe, opt, "false")
+        on = search(exe, opt, "true")
+        same = (off == on)
+        rows.append((opt, off, on, same))
+        print(f"{opt:24s} false {off:7d}  true {on:7d}  "
+              f"{'NO EFFECT' if same else 'differs'}", flush=True)
+        if same:
+            noeffect.append(opt)
+    with open(os.path.join(outdir, "result.txt"), "w") as fh:
+        fh.write(f"baseline {base}\n")
+        fh.write("excluded (deliberate):\n")
+        for k, v in EXCLUDED.items():
+            fh.write(f"  {k}: {v}\n")
+        fh.write("option false true no_effect\n")
+        for opt, off, on, same in rows:
+            fh.write(f"{opt} {off} {on} {same}\n")
+    print()
+    if noeffect:
+        print("NO-EFFECT options (" + ", ".join(noeffect) + "): either they do not reach the "
+              "search, or their effect on startpos at this depth coincides with the other value")
+        print(f"RESULT: {len(noeffect)} option(s) showed no effect")
+        sys.exit(1)
+    print(f"RESULT: all {len(rows)} boolean options measurably changed the search")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

diff --git a/forge-combo29/swarm/07/job24/lmrdead.cpp b/forge-combo29/swarm/07/job24/lmrdead.cpp
new file mode 100644
index 000000000..c589aa149
--- /dev/null
+++ b/forge-combo29/swarm/07/job24/lmrdead.cpp
@@ -0,0 +1,32 @@
+// Is LmrSignedCorrection capable of any effect at all?
+// correction = clamp(..., -CorrectionLimit, CorrectionLimit) = [-8192, 8192]
+// static_eval = raw + correction / CorrectionGrain      (CorrectionGrain = 256)
+// correction_cp = static_eval - raw_eval = correction/256 in [-32, 32]
+// delta = correction_cp / 64   (integer division)
+#include <cstdio>
+constexpr int CorrectionLimit = 32 * 256;
+constexpr int CorrectionGrain = 256;
+int apply(int r, int correction_cp) {
+    int delta = correction_cp / 64;
+    if (delta > 1) delta = 1;
+    if (delta < -1) delta = -1;
+    const int adjusted = r - delta;
+    return adjusted > 0 ? adjusted : 0;
+}
+int main() {
+    int nonzero_delta = 0, changed = 0, total = 0;
+    for (int correction = -CorrectionLimit; correction <= CorrectionLimit; ++correction) {
+        const int correction_cp = correction / CorrectionGrain;
+        const int delta = correction_cp / 64;
+        if (delta != 0) ++nonzero_delta;
+        for (int r = 0; r <= 30; ++r) {
+            ++total;
+            if (apply(r, correction_cp) != r) ++changed;
+        }
+    }
+    std::printf("correction range [-%d, %d]\n", CorrectionLimit, CorrectionLimit);
+    std::printf("correction_cp range [%d, %d]\n", -CorrectionLimit/CorrectionGrain, CorrectionLimit/CorrectionGrain);
+    std::printf("values of correction giving a NONZERO delta: %d\n", nonzero_delta);
+    std::printf("(reduction, correction) pairs where the reduction CHANGES: %d of %d\n", changed, total);
+    return 0;
+}

+++ b/forge-combo29/swarm/07/job25/correction_boundary.cpp
@@ -0,0 +1,37 @@
+// Where 07-F2 went wrong, and the corrected bound.
+// 07-F2 enumerated ONE correction table and concluded correction_cp is bounded to +-32 cp, so
+// correction_cp/64 is always 0. But corrected_eval (src/search.cpp:1217-1226) builds `correction`
+// as a SUM:  pawn table  +  material table (when MaterialCorrectionWeight > 0)  +  optionally
+// (np_w + np_b)/2 when NonPawnCorrection is on. Each table is clamped to +-CorrectionLimit, so the
+// sum is what matters, and it crosses the 64 cp threshold that produces delta = 1.
+#include <cstdio>
+constexpr int Grain = 256;
+constexpr int Limit = 32 * Grain;      // per table, in table units = 32 cp
+constexpr int TableCp() { return Limit / Grain; }   // 32 cp per table
+
+int apply(int r, int cp) {
+    int delta = cp / 64;
+    if (delta > 1) delta = 1;
+    if (delta < -1) delta = -1;
+    const int adjusted = r - delta;
+    return adjusted > 0 ? adjusted : 0;
+}
+
+int main() {
+    const int per = TableCp();
+    std::printf("per-table cap: %d cp\n", per);
+    std::printf("default tables summed (pawn + material): %d cp\n", 2 * per);
+    std::printf("with NonPawnCorrection (pawn + material + avg of 2 nonpawn): %d cp\n", 3 * per);
+    int changes = 0, total = 0;
+    for (int cp = -3 * per; cp <= 3 * per; ++cp) {
+        for (int r = 0; r <= 30; ++r) {
+            ++total;
+            if (apply(r, cp) != r) ++changes;
+        }
+    }
+    std::printf("reachable (reduction, correction_cp) pairs where the reduction CHANGES: %d of %d\n",
+                changes, total);
+    std::printf("=> the option is NOT inert; it is inert only on trees where the tables do not\n"
+                "   saturate in the same direction (REPORT_r3_03.md line 87 says exactly this).\n");
+    return 0;
+}

diff --git a/forge-combo29/swarm/07/job26/pc_pins.py b/forge-combo29/swarm/07/job26/pc_pins.py
new file mode 100644
index 000000000..b5579d330
--- /dev/null
+++ b/forge-combo29/swarm/07/job26/pc_pins.py
@@ -0,0 +1,185 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""pc_pins.py EXE OUTDIR [--s14] [--pc20]
+
+Checks the PC r15 build against the numbers FABLE_TO_swarm_5.md publishes, in the three regimes it
+distinguishes (file 4 also warns that mixing regimes produces false mismatches):
+
+  none : a fresh engine, NO setoption at all  -> bench 11 = 312866, bench 13 = 862329,
+                                                 bench 16 = 3024920, go perft 5 = 4865609
+  S14  : the 14 file-1 settings, then the bench -> bench 11 = 242796, bench 13 = 656517
+  PC20 : S14 + the six settings below           -> bench 11 = 278024, bench 13 = 587276
+
+PC20 = S14, then CuckooRep true, HistRework 2, TtPruneV2 true, CorrHistV2 true,
+       MateAlphaGuard true, OwnBook false.  Threads 1 and Hash 16 everywhere.
+
+Every figure is parsed and asserted present; a missing bench line fails loudly. Any `unknown option`,
+`invalid value` or `ERROR` line is a hard failure (file 5 says to stop on them).
+"""
+import json
+import os
+import queue
+import re
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import threading
+
+S14 = [
+    "LmrQuietBase value 93", "LmrQuietDivisor value 205", "LmrNoisyBase value 13",
+    "LmrNoisyDivisor value 333", "LmrHistoryDivisor value 5643", "NullMoveBase value 5",
+    "LmpBase value 8", "HistoryPruneMultiplier value 2220",
+    "HistoryBonusQuadratic value 24", "HistoryBonusLinear value 54",
+    "HistoryBonusMax value 2212", "SingularDepth value 6", "IirDepth value 2",
+    "NonPawnCorrection value true",
+]
+PC20_EXTRA = [
+    "CuckooRep value true", "HistRework value 2", "TtPruneV2 value true",
+    "CorrHistV2 value true", "MateAlphaGuard value true", "OwnBook value false",
+]
+EXPECTED = {
+    "none": {"bench11": 312866, "bench13": 862329, "bench16": 3024920, "perft5": 4865609},
+    "S14": {"bench11": 242796, "bench13": 656517},
+    "PC20": {"bench11": 278024, "bench13": 587276},
+}
+
+
+class Reader:
+    def __init__(s, st):
+        s.q = queue.Queue()
+        threading.Thread(target=s._pump, args=(st,), daemon=True).start()
+
+    def _pump(s, st):
+        for l in st:
+            s.q.put(l)
+        s.q.put(None)
+
+    def get(s, t=300):
+        try:
+            return s.q.get(timeout=t)
+        except queue.Empty:
+            return None
+
+
+def one_run(exe, options, commands):
+    """One fresh process. Returns (list of output lines, list of bad lines)."""
+    p = subprocess.Popen([exe], stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
+                         stderr=subprocess.PIPE, text=True, bufsize=1)
+    r = Reader(p.stdout)
+    bad = []
+
+    def send(c):
+        p.stdin.write(c + "\n")
+        p.stdin.flush()
+
+    def drain():
+        while True:
+            l = r.get()
+            if l is None:
+                raise RuntimeError("no readyok")
+            low = l.lower()
+            if "unknown option" in low or "invalid value" in low or "error" in low:
+                bad.append(l.strip())
+            if l.strip() == "readyok":
+                return
+
+    send("uci")
+    while True:
+        l = r.get(60)
+        if l is None or l.strip() == "uciok":
+            break
+    for opt in options:
+        send("setoption name " + opt)
+        send("isready")
+        drain()
+    if options:
+        send("ucinewgame")
+        send("isready")
+        drain()
+    out = []
+    for cmd in commands:
+        send(cmd)
+        # bench and perft both answer with lines we must read; perft ends with "nodes N",
+        # bench with "info string bench ...".
+        deadline_after = None
+        while True:
+            l = r.get(600)
+            if l is None:
+                raise RuntimeError(f"no answer to {cmd}")
+            out.append(l.rstrip("\n"))
+            low = l.lower()
+            if "unknown option" in low or "invalid value" in low or "error" in low:
+                bad.append(l.strip())
+            if l.startswith("info string bench"):
+                break
+            if l.startswith("nodes "):
+                break
+        send("isready")
+        drain()
+    send("quit")
+    try:
+        p.wait(timeout=30)
+    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
+        p.kill()
+    return out, bad
+
+
+def parse(out, kind):
+    if kind == "bench":
+        for l in out:
+            m = re.match(r"info string bench depth (\d+) nodes (\d+)", l)
+            if m:
+                return int(m.group(2))
+    else:
+        for l in reversed(out):
+            m = re.match(r"^nodes (\d+)$", l)
+            if m:
+                return int(m.group(1))
+    raise SystemExit(f"FAIL could not parse a {kind} node count from: {out[-3:]}")
+
+
+def main():
+    exe, outdir = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
+    want_s14 = "--s14" in sys.argv or "--pc20" in sys.argv
+    want_pc20 = "--pc20" in sys.argv
+    os.makedirs(outdir, exist_ok=True)
+    results, failures = {}, []
+
+    regimes = ["none"]
+    if want_s14:
+        regimes.append("S14")
+    if want_pc20:
+        regimes.append("PC20")
+
+    for regime in regimes:
+        opts = [] if regime == "none" else (S14 if regime == "S14" else S14 + PC20_EXTRA)
+        got = {}
+        # benches and perft, each its own fresh process (the brief's rule)
+        for depth in (11, 13, 16):
+            out, bad = one_run(exe, opts, [f"bench {depth}"])
+            got[f"bench{depth}"] = parse(out, "bench")
+            if bad:
+                failures.append(f"{regime} bench {depth}: {bad[:3]}")
+        out, bad = one_run(exe, opts, ["go perft 5"])
+        got["perft5"] = parse(out, "perft")
+        if bad:
+            failures.append(f"{regime} perft 5: {bad[:3]}")
+        results[regime] = got
+
+        for key, want in EXPECTED[regime].items():
+            have = got.get(key)
+            status = "OK" if have == want else "MISMATCH"
+            print(f"{regime:5s} {key:8s} got {have:>9} want {want:>9}  {status}", flush=True)
+            if have != want:
+                failures.append(f"{regime} {key}: got {have} want {want}")
+
+    json.dump(results, open(os.path.join(outdir, "pc_pins.json"), "w"), indent=1)
+    print()
+    if failures:
+        for f in failures:
+            print("  FAIL " + str(f))
+        print(f"RESULT: {len(failures)} mismatch(es) or bad option line(s)")
+        sys.exit(1)
+    print("RESULT: every published PC r15 number matched in every regime checked")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

diff --git a/forge-combo29/swarm/07/job27/rerun_f1_on_pc.py b/forge-combo29/swarm/07/job27/rerun_f1_on_pc.py
new file mode 100644
index 000000000..97b9c69e9
--- /dev/null
+++ b/forge-combo29/swarm/07/job27/rerun_f1_on_pc.py
@@ -0,0 +1,168 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""rerun_f1_on_pc.py BASE_EXE PC_EXE OUTDIR
+
+Re-runs this seat's find 07-F1 on the PC r15 build under PC20, and on the base build for comparison.
+
+07-F1: `position ... ` + `go depth N searchmoves <names with no legal root move>` on a board that
+HAS legal moves emits a fabricated `info depth N ... score cp 0 nodes 0` line before `bestmove 0000`.
+
+A finding that is gone on the PC build is "repaired on the PC"; one that survives is worth more.
+
+Settings PC20 = the 14 S14 settings, then CuckooRep true, HistRework 2, TtPruneV2 true,
+CorrHistV2 true, MateAlphaGuard true, OwnBook false, with Threads 1 and Hash 16.
+
+Every case is one fresh process, driven by never sending a command while a `go` is running: the
+driver reads stdout until `bestmove`.
+"""
+import os
+import queue
+import re
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import threading
+
+S14 = [
+    "LmrQuietBase value 93", "LmrQuietDivisor value 205", "LmrNoisyBase value 13",
+    "LmrNoisyDivisor value 333", "LmrHistoryDivisor value 5643", "NullMoveBase value 5",
+    "LmpBase value 8", "HistoryPruneMultiplier value 2220",
+    "HistoryBonusQuadratic value 24", "HistoryBonusLinear value 54",
+    "HistoryBonusMax value 2212", "SingularDepth value 6", "IirDepth value 2",
+    "NonPawnCorrection value true",
+]
+PC20 = S14 + ["CuckooRep value true", "HistRework value 2", "TtPruneV2 value true",
+              "CorrHistV2 value true", "MateAlphaGuard value true", "OwnBook value false"]
+
+# (name, position command, go command, expectation) -- the same cases as job2 plus the controls.
+CASES = [
+    ("no_legal_name_has_moves", "position startpos", "go depth 4 searchmoves e2e5"),
+    ("empty_list", "position startpos", "go depth 4 searchmoves"),
+    ("black_to_move_wrong_colour", "position startpos moves e2e4", "go depth 4 searchmoves e2e5"),
+    ("one_legal_name_control", "position startpos", "go depth 6 searchmoves e2e4"),
+    ("two_names_one_legal", "position startpos", "go depth 6 searchmoves e2e4 e2e5"),
+    ("stalemate_root_control", "position fen 7k/5Q2/6K1/8/8/8/8/8 b - - 0 1", "go depth 3 searchmoves a1a2"),
+    ("plain_search_control", "position startpos", "go depth 4"),
+]
+
+
+class Reader:
+    def __init__(s, st):
+        s.q = queue.Queue()
+        threading.Thread(target=s._pump, args=(st,), daemon=True).start()
+
+    def _pump(s, st):
+        for l in st:
+            s.q.put(l)
+        s.q.put(None)
+
+    def get(s, t=180):
+        try:
+            return s.q.get(timeout=t)
+        except queue.Empty:
+            return None
+
+
+def run(exe, options, position, go):
+    p = subprocess.Popen([exe], stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
+                         stderr=subprocess.PIPE, text=True, bufsize=1)
+    r = Reader(p.stdout)
+
+    def send(c):
+        p.stdin.write(c + "\n")
+        p.stdin.flush()
+
+    def drain():
+        while True:
+            l = r.get()
+            if l is None:
+                raise RuntimeError("no readyok")
+            if l.strip() == "readyok":
+                return
+
+    send("uci")
+    while True:
+        l = r.get(60)
+        if l is None or l.strip() == "uciok":
+            break
+    for opt in ["Hash value 16", "Threads value 1"] + options:
+        send("setoption name " + opt)
+        send("isready")
+        drain()
+    send("ucinewgame")
+    send("isready")
+    drain()
+    send(position)
+    send("isready")
+    drain()
+    send(go)
+    depth_lines, best, bad = [], None, []
+    while True:
+        l = r.get(300)
+        if l is None:
+            raise RuntimeError("no bestmove")
+        if l.startswith("info depth"):
+            depth_lines.append(l.strip())
+        if "unknown option" in l.lower() or "invalid value" in l.lower() or "error" in l.lower():
+            bad.append(l.strip())
+        if l.startswith("bestmove"):
+            best = l.split()[1]
+            break
+    send("quit")
+    try:
+        p.wait(timeout=30)
+    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
+        p.kill()
+    if bad:
+        raise SystemExit(f"FAIL bad option/error line: {bad[:3]}")
+    return depth_lines, best
+
+
+def summarise(depth_lines, best):
+    """The observable 07-F1 signature: a depth line whose nodes is 0, plus bestmove 0000."""
+    zero_nodes = []
+    last_nodes = None
+    for l in depth_lines:
+        m = re.search(r" nodes (\d+) ", l + " ")
+        if m:
+            last_nodes = int(m.group(1))
+            if last_nodes == 0:
+                zero_nodes.append(l)
+    return {"depth_lines": len(depth_lines), "zero_node_lines": len(zero_nodes),
+            "last_nodes": last_nodes, "bestmove": best,
+            "fabricated": bool(zero_nodes) and best == "0000"}
+
+
+def main():
+    base_exe, pc_exe, outdir = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2], sys.argv[3]
+    os.makedirs(outdir, exist_ok=True)
+    print(f"{'case':30s} {'BASE(default)':>26s}   {'PC r15 (PC20)':>26s}")
+    rows = []
+    for name, pos, go in CASES:
+        bd, bb = run(base_exe, [], pos, go)
+        pd, pb = run(pc_exe, PC20, pos, go)
+        bs, ps = summarise(bd, bb), summarise(pd, pb)
+        rows.append({"case": name, "position": pos, "go": go, "base": bs, "pc20": ps})
+        print(f"{name:30s} {bs['bestmove']:>12s} zero={bs['zero_node_lines']} "
+              f"last={bs['last_nodes']}   {ps['bestmove']:>12s} zero={ps['zero_node_lines']} "
+              f"last={ps['last_nodes']}", flush=True)
+    import json
+    json.dump(rows, open(os.path.join(outdir, "rerun_f1.json"), "w"), indent=1)
+    print()
+    f1_base = [r for r in rows if r["case"] in ("no_legal_name_has_moves", "empty_list",
+                                                "black_to_move_wrong_colour") and r["base"]["fabricated"]]
+    f1_pc = [r for r in rows if r["case"] in ("no_legal_name_has_moves", "empty_list",
+                                              "black_to_move_wrong_colour") and r["pc20"]["fabricated"]]
+    print(f"07-F1 reproduced on BASE: {len(f1_base)}/3 cases")
+    print(f"07-F1 reproduced on PC r15 under PC20: {len(f1_pc)}/3 cases")
+    # controls must search
+    for r in rows:
+        if r["case"].endswith("control") or r["case"] == "plain_search_control":
+            if r["pc20"]["bestmove"] == "0000":
+                print(f"  WARNING control {r['case']} answered 0000 on the PC build")
+    if f1_pc:
+        print("RESULT: 07-F1 SURVIVES on the PC build -> worth more now")
+    else:
+        print("RESULT: 07-F1 is REPAIRED on the PC build (not present under PC20)")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

@@ -0,0 +1,158 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""discriminate_paths.py PC_EXE OUTDIR
+
+Three symptoms were reported. Cases 1 and 3 (this seat's 07-F1, and the no-match case with a node
+budget) both print depth lines with `nodes 0`. Case 2 (19-F12, `go depth 12` + immediate quit) prints
+NO depth lines and answers a legal move. That difference suggests a different code path, and this
+script tests it discriminatorily rather than by reading alone.
+
+Discriminating experiment for case 2: if the answer comes from
+`if (result.best_move.is_none()) result.best_move = root_candidates.front();` (src/search.cpp:3017),
+then restricting the root changes the answer to the FIRST move of the restricted set. So:
+
+  go depth 12                       + quit at t=0  -> a2a3  (first of all 20 legal moves)
+  go depth 12 searchmoves d2d4      + quit at t=0  -> d2d4  (first of the restricted set)
+  go depth 12 searchmoves h2h4      + quit at t=0  -> h2h4
+
+If all three follow `root_candidates.front()`, case 2 is that fallback and NOT the same path as
+cases 1/3 (where root_candidates is EMPTY and the early return at 2581 fires).
+
+For contrast, case 1 is re-run with the same restriction so the two can be compared directly.
+"""
+import os
+import queue
+import re
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import threading
+import time
+
+S14 = [
+    "LmrQuietBase value 93", "LmrQuietDivisor value 205", "LmrNoisyBase value 13",
+    "LmrNoisyDivisor value 333", "LmrHistoryDivisor value 5643", "NullMoveBase value 5",
+    "LmpBase value 8", "HistoryPruneMultiplier value 2220",
+    "HistoryBonusQuadratic value 24", "HistoryBonusLinear value 54",
+    "HistoryBonusMax value 2212", "SingularDepth value 6", "IirDepth value 2",
+    "NonPawnCorrection value true",
+]
+PC20 = S14 + ["CuckooRep value true", "HistRework value 2", "TtPruneV2 value true",
+              "CorrHistV2 value true", "MateAlphaGuard value true", "OwnBook value false"]
+
+
+class Reader:
+    def __init__(s, st):
+        s.q = queue.Queue()
+        threading.Thread(target=s._pump, args=(st,), daemon=True).start()
+
+    def _pump(s, st):
+        for l in st:
+            s.q.put(l)
+        s.q.put(None)
+
+    def get(s, t=60):
+        try:
+            return s.q.get(timeout=t)
+        except queue.Empty:
+            return None
+
+
+def run(exe, go, quit_immediately):
+    p = subprocess.Popen([exe], stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
+                         stderr=subprocess.PIPE, text=True, bufsize=1)
+    r = Reader(p.stdout)
+
+    def send(c):
+        p.stdin.write(c + "\n")
+        p.stdin.flush()
+
+    def drain():
+        while True:
+            l = r.get()
+            if l is None:
+                raise RuntimeError("no readyok")
+            if l.strip() == "readyok":
+                return
+
+    send("uci")
+    while True:
+        l = r.get(60)
+        if l is None or l.strip() == "uciok":
+            break
+    for opt in ["Hash value 16", "Threads value 1"] + PC20:
+        send("setoption name " + opt); send("isready"); drain()
+    send("ucinewgame"); send("isready"); drain()
+    send("position startpos"); send("isready"); drain()
+    send(go)
+    if quit_immediately:
+        send("quit")
+    lines, best = [], None
+    deadline = time.monotonic() + 60
+    while time.monotonic() < deadline:
+        line = r.get(2.0)
+        if line is None:
+            break
+        lines.append(line.rstrip("\n"))
+        if line.startswith("bestmove"):
+            best = line.split()[1]
+            break
+    try:
+        p.wait(timeout=10)
+    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
+        p.kill()
+    depth = [l for l in lines if l.startswith("info depth")]
+    nodes = None
+    if depth:
+        m = re.search(r" nodes (\d+) ", depth[-1] + " ")
+        if m:
+            nodes = int(m.group(1))
+    return {"go": go, "quit_immediately": quit_immediately, "bestmove": best,
+            "depth_lines": len(depth), "last_nodes": nodes}
+
+
+def main():
+    exe, outdir = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
+    os.makedirs(outdir, exist_ok=True)
+    cases = [
+        ("2a_no_restriction",      "go depth 12", False),
+        ("2b_restrict_d2d4",       "go depth 12 searchmoves d2d4", False),
+        ("2c_restrict_h2h4",       "go depth 12 searchmoves h2h4", False),
+        ("2d_restrict_multi",      "go depth 12 searchmoves h2h4 g2g3", False),
+        ("1_empty_root",           "go searchmoves e2e5", False),
+        ("1_empty_root_with_nb",   "go nodes 100000 searchmoves e2e5", False),
+    ]
+    rows = []
+    print(f"{'case':24s} {'quit@t0':>8s} {'bestmove':>10s} {'depthlines':>10s} {'nodes':>10s}")
+    for name, go, qi in cases:
+        rec = run(exe, go, qi)
+        rec["case"] = name
+        rows.append(rec)
+        print(f"{name:24s} {str(qi):>8s} {str(rec['bestmove']):>10s} "
+              f"{rec['depth_lines']:>10d} {str(rec['last_nodes']):>10s}", flush=True)
+
+    # The discriminating runs: same go, but quit fired immediately.
+    print()
+    print("--- the same three searches with `quit` sent immediately (the 19-F12 shape) ---")
+    for name, go in [("2a_q", "go depth 12"),
+                     ("2b_q", "go depth 12 searchmoves d2d4"),
+                     ("2c_q", "go depth 12 searchmoves h2h4"),
+                     ("2d_q", "go depth 12 searchmoves h2h4 g2g3")]:
+        rec = run(exe, go, True)
+        rec["case"] = name + "_quit_t0"
+        rec["quit_immediately"] = True
+        rows.append(rec)
+        print(f"{name:24s} {'True':>8s} {str(rec['bestmove']):>10s} "
+              f"{rec['depth_lines']:>10d} {str(rec['last_nodes']):>10s}", flush=True)
+
+    import json
+    json.dump(rows, open(os.path.join(outdir, "discriminate.json"), "w"), indent=1)
+    print()
+    followed = [r for r in rows if r["case"].startswith(("2a_q", "2b_q", "2c_q", "2d_q"))]
+    print("If every *_quit_t0 answer equals the FIRST move of its own restriction, the abort case is")
+    print("the `root_candidates.front()` fallback and a DIFFERENT path from the empty-root cases.")
+    for r in followed:
+        print(f"  {r['case']:22s} go=[{r['go']}] -> {r['bestmove']} "
+              f"(depth lines {r['depth_lines']}, nodes {r['last_nodes']})")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

@@ -0,0 +1,195 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""three_symptoms.py PC_EXE OUTDIR
+
+Runs the three reported symptoms SIDE BY SIDE on the PC r15 build under PC20, Threads 1, Hash 16,
+one fresh process per case, and then decides from the CODE whether they share one path.
+
+  1. 07-F1        `go searchmoves` naming nothing legal (board HAS legal moves)
+  2. 19-F12       `go depth 12` followed by an immediate `quit` (aborted search)
+  3. no-match+NB  `go nodes 100000 searchmoves <illegal>`
+
+For each: record every info line, the bestmove (if any), whether the reported nodes are 0, and
+whether the move is legal for the position. A case that never answers is recorded as ABSENT, not as
+a pass.
+
+This script does NOT send anything while a `go` is running except in case 2, where the early `quit`
+IS the phenomenon under test; that is stated in the output so nobody mistakes it for the harness bug
+seat 19 warned about.
+"""
+import os
+import queue
+import re
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import threading
+
+import chess
+
+S14 = [
+    "LmrQuietBase value 93", "LmrQuietDivisor value 205", "LmrNoisyBase value 13",
+    "LmrNoisyDivisor value 333", "LmrHistoryDivisor value 5643", "NullMoveBase value 5",
+    "LmpBase value 8", "HistoryPruneMultiplier value 2220",
+    "HistoryBonusQuadratic value 24", "HistoryBonusLinear value 54",
+    "HistoryBonusMax value 2212", "SingularDepth value 6", "IirDepth value 2",
+    "NonPawnCorrection value true",
+]
+PC20 = S14 + ["CuckooRep value true", "HistRework value 2", "TtPruneV2 value true",
+              "CorrHistV2 value true", "MateAlphaGuard value true", "OwnBook value false"]
+
+
+class Reader:
+    def __init__(s, st):
+        s.q = queue.Queue()
+        threading.Thread(target=s._pump, args=(st,), daemon=True).start()
+
+    def _pump(s, st):
+        for l in st:
+            s.q.put(l)
+        s.q.put(None)
+
+    def get(s, t=120):
+        try:
+            return s.q.get(timeout=t)
+        except queue.Empty:
+            return None
+
+
+def session(exe):
+    p = subprocess.Popen([exe], stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
+                         stderr=subprocess.PIPE, text=True, bufsize=1)
+    r = Reader(p.stdout)
+
+    def send(c):
+        p.stdin.write(c + "\n")
+        p.stdin.flush()
+
+    def drain():
+        while True:
+            l = r.get()
+            if l is None:
+                raise RuntimeError("no readyok")
+            if l.strip() == "readyok":
+                return
+
+    send("uci")
+    while True:
+        l = r.get(60)
+        if l is None or l.strip() == "uciok":
+            break
+    for opt in ["Hash value 16", "Threads value 1"] + PC20:
+        send("setoption name " + opt)
+        send("isready")
+        drain()
+    return p, r, send, drain
+
+
+def collect(r, send, deadline_s=60.0, early_quit_at=None):
+    """Read lines until bestmove. If early_quit_at is set, send `quit` after that many seconds
+    (case 2 only: the early quit is the phenomenon)."""
+    import time
+    t0 = time.monotonic()
+    quit_sent = False
+    lines = []
+    while True:
+        if early_quit_at is not None and not quit_sent and time.monotonic() - t0 >= early_quit_at:
+            send("quit")
+            quit_sent = True
+        line = r.get(1.0)
+        if line is None:
+            if time.monotonic() - t0 > deadline_s:
+                return lines, None
+            continue
+        lines.append(line.rstrip("\n"))
+        if line.startswith("bestmove"):
+            return lines, line.split()[1]
+
+
+def analyse(lines, best, fen):
+    zero, last_nodes, infos = 0, None, []
+    for l in lines:
+        if l.startswith("info depth"):
+            infos.append(l)
+            m = re.search(r" nodes (\d+) ", l + " ")
+            if m:
+                last_nodes = int(m.group(1))
+                if last_nodes == 0:
+                    zero += 1
+    legal_ok = None
+    if best is not None and fen:
+        try:
+            b = chess.Board(fen)
+            legal = [m.uci() for m in b.legal_moves]
+            legal_ok = (best == "0000" and not legal) or (best in legal)
+        except ValueError:
+            legal_ok = None
+    return {"depth_lines": len(infos), "zero_node_lines": zero,
+            "last_nodes": last_nodes, "bestmove": best,
+            "bestmove_legal": legal_ok,
+            "fabricated": zero > 0}
+
+
+def main():
+    exe, outdir = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
+    os.makedirs(outdir, exist_ok=True)
+    results = {}
+
+    # ---- case 1: 07-F1 ----
+    p, r, send, drain = session(exe)
+    send("ucinewgame"); send("isready"); drain()
+    send("position startpos"); send("isready"); drain()
+    send("go searchmoves e2e5")
+    lines, best = collect(r, send)
+    results["1_07F1_searchmoves_no_legal_name"] = analyse(
+        lines, best, chess.Board().fen())
+    send("quit")
+    try: p.wait(timeout=20)
+    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired: p.kill()
+
+    # ---- case 2: 19-F12 aborted search ----
+    p, r, send, drain = session(exe)
+    send("ucinewgame"); send("isready"); drain()
+    send("position startpos"); send("isready"); drain()
+    send("go depth 12")
+    lines, best = collect(r, send, deadline_s=30.0, early_quit_at=0.0)
+    results["2_19F12_aborted_search"] = analyse(lines, best, chess.Board().fen())
+    try: p.wait(timeout=20)
+    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired: p.kill()
+
+    # ---- case 3: no-match searchmoves with a node budget ----
+    p, r, send, drain = session(exe)
+    send("ucinewgame"); send("isready"); drain()
+    send("position startpos"); send("isready"); drain()
+    send("go nodes 100000 searchmoves e2e5")
+    lines, best = collect(r, send)
+    results["3_nomatch_node_budget"] = analyse(lines, best, chess.Board().fen())
+    send("quit")
+    try: p.wait(timeout=20)
+    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired: p.kill()
+
+    # ---- control: the same three shapes but with a legal target / no restriction ----
+    p, r, send, drain = session(exe)
+    send("ucinewgame"); send("isready"); drain()
+    send("position startpos"); send("isready"); drain()
+    send("go searchmoves e2e4")
+    lines, best = collect(r, send)
+    results["control_searchmoves_legal"] = analyse(lines, best, chess.Board().fen())
+    send("quit")
+    try: p.wait(timeout=20)
+    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired: p.kill()
+
+    import json
+    json.dump(results, open(os.path.join(outdir, "three_symptoms.json"), "w"), indent=1)
+
+    print(f"{'case':38s} {'bestmove':>10s} {'depthlines':>10s} {'zeronodes':>10s} {'last_nodes':>11s} legal")
+    for k, v in results.items():
+        print(f"{k:38s} {str(v['bestmove']):>10s} {v['depth_lines']:>10d} {v['zero_node_lines']:>10d} "
+              f"{str(v['last_nodes']):>11s} {v['bestmove_legal']}")
+    zeros = [k for k, v in results.items() if v["fabricated"]]
+    print()
+    print("cases with a zero-node report: " + (", ".join(zeros) if zeros else "none"))
+    print("NOTE: case 2 sends `quit` deliberately at t=0; that early quit is the phenomenon 19-F12")
+    print("      describes, not the harness bug seat 19 warned everyone about.")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

@@ -0,0 +1,158 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""discriminate_paths.py PC_EXE OUTDIR
+
+Three symptoms were reported. Cases 1 and 3 (this seat's 07-F1, and the no-match case with a node
+budget) both print depth lines with `nodes 0`. Case 2 (19-F12, `go depth 12` + immediate quit) prints
+NO depth lines and answers a legal move. That difference suggests a different code path, and this
+script tests it discriminatorily rather than by reading alone.
+
+Discriminating experiment for case 2: if the answer comes from
+`if (result.best_move.is_none()) result.best_move = root_candidates.front();` (src/search.cpp:3017),
+then restricting the root changes the answer to the FIRST move of the restricted set. So:
+
+  go depth 12                       + quit at t=0  -> a2a3  (first of all 20 legal moves)
+  go depth 12 searchmoves d2d4      + quit at t=0  -> d2d4  (first of the restricted set)
+  go depth 12 searchmoves h2h4      + quit at t=0  -> h2h4
+
+If all three follow `root_candidates.front()`, case 2 is that fallback and NOT the same path as
+cases 1/3 (where root_candidates is EMPTY and the early return at 2581 fires).
+
+For contrast, case 1 is re-run with the same restriction so the two can be compared directly.
+"""
+import os
+import queue
+import re
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import threading
+import time
+
+S14 = [
+    "LmrQuietBase value 93", "LmrQuietDivisor value 205", "LmrNoisyBase value 13",
+    "LmrNoisyDivisor value 333", "LmrHistoryDivisor value 5643", "NullMoveBase value 5",
+    "LmpBase value 8", "HistoryPruneMultiplier value 2220",
+    "HistoryBonusQuadratic value 24", "HistoryBonusLinear value 54",
+    "HistoryBonusMax value 2212", "SingularDepth value 6", "IirDepth value 2",
+    "NonPawnCorrection value true",
+]
+PC20 = S14 + ["CuckooRep value true", "HistRework value 2", "TtPruneV2 value true",
+              "CorrHistV2 value true", "MateAlphaGuard value true", "OwnBook value false"]
+
+
+class Reader:
+    def __init__(s, st):
+        s.q = queue.Queue()
+        threading.Thread(target=s._pump, args=(st,), daemon=True).start()
+
+    def _pump(s, st):
+        for l in st:
+            s.q.put(l)
+        s.q.put(None)
+
+    def get(s, t=60):
+        try:
+            return s.q.get(timeout=t)
+        except queue.Empty:
+            return None
+
+
+def run(exe, go, quit_immediately):
+    p = subprocess.Popen([exe], stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
+                         stderr=subprocess.PIPE, text=True, bufsize=1)
+    r = Reader(p.stdout)
+
+    def send(c):
+        p.stdin.write(c + "\n")
+        p.stdin.flush()
+
+    def drain():
+        while True:
+            l = r.get()
+            if l is None:
+                raise RuntimeError("no readyok")
+            if l.strip() == "readyok":
+                return
+
+    send("uci")
+    while True:
+        l = r.get(60)
+        if l is None or l.strip() == "uciok":
+            break
+    for opt in ["Hash value 16", "Threads value 1"] + PC20:
+        send("setoption name " + opt); send("isready"); drain()
+    send("ucinewgame"); send("isready"); drain()
+    send("position startpos"); send("isready"); drain()
+    send(go)
+    if quit_immediately:
+        send("quit")
+    lines, best = [], None
+    deadline = time.monotonic() + 60
+    while time.monotonic() < deadline:
+        line = r.get(2.0)
+        if line is None:
+            break
+        lines.append(line.rstrip("\n"))
+        if line.startswith("bestmove"):
+            best = line.split()[1]
+            break
+    try:
+        p.wait(timeout=10)
+    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
+        p.kill()
+    depth = [l for l in lines if l.startswith("info depth")]
+    nodes = None
+    if depth:
+        m = re.search(r" nodes (\d+) ", depth[-1] + " ")
+        if m:
+            nodes = int(m.group(1))
+    return {"go": go, "quit_immediately": quit_immediately, "bestmove": best,
+            "depth_lines": len(depth), "last_nodes": nodes}
+
+
+def main():
+    exe, outdir = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
+    os.makedirs(outdir, exist_ok=True)
+    cases = [
+        ("2a_no_restriction",      "go depth 12", False),
+        ("2b_restrict_d2d4",       "go depth 12 searchmoves d2d4", False),
+        ("2c_restrict_h2h4",       "go depth 12 searchmoves h2h4", False),
+        ("2d_restrict_multi",      "go depth 12 searchmoves h2h4 g2g3", False),
+        ("1_empty_root",           "go searchmoves e2e5", False),
+        ("1_empty_root_with_nb",   "go nodes 100000 searchmoves e2e5", False),
+    ]
+    rows = []
+    print(f"{'case':24s} {'quit@t0':>8s} {'bestmove':>10s} {'depthlines':>10s} {'nodes':>10s}")
+    for name, go, qi in cases:
+        rec = run(exe, go, qi)
+        rec["case"] = name
+        rows.append(rec)
+        print(f"{name:24s} {str(qi):>8s} {str(rec['bestmove']):>10s} "
+              f"{rec['depth_lines']:>10d} {str(rec['last_nodes']):>10s}", flush=True)
+
+    # The discriminating runs: same go, but quit fired immediately.
+    print()
+    print("--- the same three searches with `quit` sent immediately (the 19-F12 shape) ---")
+    for name, go in [("2a_q", "go depth 12"),
+                     ("2b_q", "go depth 12 searchmoves d2d4"),
+                     ("2c_q", "go depth 12 searchmoves h2h4"),
+                     ("2d_q", "go depth 12 searchmoves h2h4 g2g3")]:
+        rec = run(exe, go, True)
+        rec["case"] = name + "_quit_t0"
+        rec["quit_immediately"] = True
+        rows.append(rec)
+        print(f"{name:24s} {'True':>8s} {str(rec['bestmove']):>10s} "
+              f"{rec['depth_lines']:>10d} {str(rec['last_nodes']):>10s}", flush=True)
+
+    import json
+    json.dump(rows, open(os.path.join(outdir, "discriminate.json"), "w"), indent=1)
+    print()
+    followed = [r for r in rows if r["case"].startswith(("2a_q", "2b_q", "2c_q", "2d_q"))]
+    print("If every *_quit_t0 answer equals the FIRST move of its own restriction, the abort case is")
+    print("the `root_candidates.front()` fallback and a DIFFERENT path from the empty-root cases.")
+    for r in followed:
+        print(f"  {r['case']:22s} go=[{r['go']}] -> {r['bestmove']} "
+              f"(depth lines {r['depth_lines']}, nodes {r['last_nodes']})")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
diff --git a/forge-combo29/swarm/07/job29/job29_pc_searchmoves_empty_root.patch.txt b/forge-combo29/swarm/07/job29/job29_pc_searchmoves_empty_root.patch.txt
new file mode 100644
index 000000000..2927dabde
--- /dev/null
+++ b/forge-combo29/swarm/07/job29/job29_pc_searchmoves_empty_root.patch.txt
@@ -0,0 +1,104 @@
+# PC-TREE PATCH for 07-F1 -- searchmoves naming no legal root move
+#
+# Build: PC r15 (6b98f217 + pc_r15.patch, sha256 d6bd72c5...) from FABLE_TO_swarm_5.md.
+# Apply:  cd forge-combo29 && patch -p1 --fuzz=0 < job29_pc_searchmoves_empty_root.patch.txt
+#         (verified: exit 0, three hunks, no rejects)
+# Built:  cmake -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DCMAKE_CXX_FLAGS=-DFORGE_MATE_ALPHA_GUARD=1
+# Threads 1, Hash 16 in every measurement below.
+#
+# THE DEFECT
+#   search.cpp:2531 already computes `result.restricted_root_empty` -- the engine KNOWS the root is
+#   empty because the caller's restriction matched nothing. It even prints
+#   `info string searchmoves restriction has no legal root moves`. Then the early branch at 2581
+#   falls into the depth loop at 2591 and emits `info depth D ... score cp 0 nodes 0` once per depth,
+#   i.e. 64 fabricated score lines, before `bestmove 0000`.
+#
+# WHAT THIS PATCH DOES
+#   Returns from that branch before the depth loop, only when restricted_root_empty. No score line is
+#   printed. `result.nodes` and `result.elapsed_ms` are still filled, and `best_move` is left none, so
+#   the UCI layer keeps answering exactly as before.
+#
+# ============================================================================
+# DESIGN CHOICE, STATED: what `bestmove 0000` means here and what I recommend
+# ============================================================================
+# This patch KEEPS `bestmove 0000`. That is deliberate and it is also the part I am least sure the
+# owner wants, so the reasoning is written out. UCI gives `0000` the meaning "there is no legal move"
+# (checkmate / stalemate). Here there are 20 legal moves, so a GUI that acts on that meaning may
+# resign, adjudicate, or refuse the move. Measured options, on startpos with 20 legal moves,
+# `go depth 6 searchmoves e2e5` (Threads 1):
+#
+#   A  today (unpatched)   bestmove 0000 + SIX depth lines all `score cp 0 nodes 0`   nodes 0
+#   B  this patch          bestmove 0000 + ONE honest info string, no score line        nodes 0
+#   C  full-root search    bestmove d2d4 + six real depth lines                         nodes 1703
+#   D  no answer at all    GUI waits for a bestmove that never comes                    --
+#
+#   A is the worst: it invents a drawn score for a position it never searched.
+#   D is rejected: a search never answered is worse than a poor answer, and seat 12 rejected it for
+#     the same reason in its abort fix (S-F11).
+#   B is what this patch implements: honest, and it changes nothing a GUI does today, because the
+#     GUI already received `0000` in case A. The patch removes the false score, not the move.
+#   C is what I would recommend as the REAL fix, and I did not implement it: the engine would ignore
+#     the caller's restriction and search the full root, returning d2d4 with real numbers. That is
+#     the only option that gives a GUI a playable move. Its cost is that it silently disobeys
+#     `searchmoves`, which is also a lie, just a louder one -- and `searchmoves` exists precisely so
+#     a caller can forbid moves.
+#
+# RECOMMENDATION, in one sentence: keep B (this patch) as the correctness fix, because a fabricated
+# score is a defect and an honest `0000` is not; and if the owner wants a playable answer, that is a
+# SEPARATE decision that must also state that the restriction was ignored -- `bestmove d2d4` plus
+# `info string searchmoves matched no legal move; searched the full root` -- because a GUI must never
+# be handed a move outside the set it asked for without being told.
+#
+# CONSEQUENCE FOR A GUI of shipping only B: unchanged behaviour from today, minus the false score.
+# No GUI needs changing, and no GUI gains a playable move. A GUI driving the engine with
+# `searchmoves` must already handle `0000` today; this patch makes that answer honest rather than
+# silently wrong.
+#
+# VERIFIED ON THE PATCHED BUILD (PC r15 + this patch, PC20, Threads 1, Hash 16):
+#   none-regime pins  312866 / 862329 / 3024920 / 4865609   (all unchanged)
+#   S14 pins          242796 / 656517                        (all unchanged)
+#   PC20 pins         278024 / 587276                        (all unchanged)
+#   empty-root cases  64 zero-node depth lines -> 0, `bestmove 0000` still returned
+#   controls          searchmoves e2e4: 33 depth lines, 50,224,817 nodes (identical before/after)
+#   19-F12 path       `go depth 12` + immediate quit -> a2a3, 0 depth lines (UNTOUCHED, different path)
+#   one-candidate      searchmoves leaving exactly one LEGAL candidate still searches:
+#                      base 138 nodes / PC20 175 nodes -> the early branch is correctly not taken
+# ============================================================================
+--- pcpatch_a/src/search.cpp	2026-11-16 22:23:43.728602054 +0000
++++ pcpatch_b/src/search.cpp	2026-11-16 22:23:43.736602054 +0000
+@@ -2521,6 +2521,9 @@
+     }
+     SearchInfo result;
+     const MoveList legal = board.legal_moves();
++    // True when `searchmoves` named no legal root move. The root is empty because
++    // of the caller's restriction, not because of the position.
++    bool restricted_root_empty = false;
+     MoveList root_candidates;
+     for (const Move move : legal) {
+         if (!root_restricted_ ||
+@@ -2529,6 +2532,7 @@
+         }
+     }
+     result.restricted_root_empty = root_restricted_ && !legal.empty() && root_candidates.empty();
++    restricted_root_empty = result.restricted_root_empty;
+     if (result.restricted_root_empty && emit_info) {
+         const std::lock_guard<std::mutex> output_lock(uci_output_mutex());
+         std::cout << "info string searchmoves restriction has no legal root moves" << std::endl;
+@@ -2586,6 +2590,17 @@
+             score = draw_leaf_score(board);
+         }
+ #endif
++        if (restricted_root_empty) {
++            // The caller restricted the root to moves that are not legal here. Print no
++            // depth line: there is no search and no score, and a `score cp 0 nodes 0` line
++            // reads as a drawn position to any GUI or harness that parses it. best_move
++            // stays none, so the UCI layer answers `bestmove 0000` exactly as before.
++            result.nodes = total_nodes();
++            result.elapsed_ms = static_cast<std::uint64_t>(
++                std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(
++                    std::chrono::steady_clock::now() - start_).count());
++            return result;
++        }
+         for (int depth = 1; depth <= max_depth; ++depth) {
+             result.depth = depth;
+             result.score = score;
diff --git a/forge-combo29/swarm/07/job29/pc_pins.py b/forge-combo29/swarm/07/job29/pc_pins.py
new file mode 100644
index 000000000..b5579d330
--- /dev/null
+++ b/forge-combo29/swarm/07/job29/pc_pins.py
@@ -0,0 +1,185 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""pc_pins.py EXE OUTDIR [--s14] [--pc20]
+
+Checks the PC r15 build against the numbers FABLE_TO_swarm_5.md publishes, in the three regimes it
+distinguishes (file 4 also warns that mixing regimes produces false mismatches):
+
+  none : a fresh engine, NO setoption at all  -> bench 11 = 312866, bench 13 = 862329,
+                                                 bench 16 = 3024920, go perft 5 = 4865609
+  S14  : the 14 file-1 settings, then the bench -> bench 11 = 242796, bench 13 = 656517
+  PC20 : S14 + the six settings below           -> bench 11 = 278024, bench 13 = 587276
+
+PC20 = S14, then CuckooRep true, HistRework 2, TtPruneV2 true, CorrHistV2 true,
+       MateAlphaGuard true, OwnBook false.  Threads 1 and Hash 16 everywhere.
+
+Every figure is parsed and asserted present; a missing bench line fails loudly. Any `unknown option`,
+`invalid value` or `ERROR` line is a hard failure (file 5 says to stop on them).
+"""
+import json
+import os
+import queue
+import re
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import threading
+
+S14 = [
+    "LmrQuietBase value 93", "LmrQuietDivisor value 205", "LmrNoisyBase value 13",
+    "LmrNoisyDivisor value 333", "LmrHistoryDivisor value 5643", "NullMoveBase value 5",
+    "LmpBase value 8", "HistoryPruneMultiplier value 2220",
+    "HistoryBonusQuadratic value 24", "HistoryBonusLinear value 54",
+    "HistoryBonusMax value 2212", "SingularDepth value 6", "IirDepth value 2",
+    "NonPawnCorrection value true",
+]
+PC20_EXTRA = [
+    "CuckooRep value true", "HistRework value 2", "TtPruneV2 value true",
+    "CorrHistV2 value true", "MateAlphaGuard value true", "OwnBook value false",
+]
+EXPECTED = {
+    "none": {"bench11": 312866, "bench13": 862329, "bench16": 3024920, "perft5": 4865609},
+    "S14": {"bench11": 242796, "bench13": 656517},
+    "PC20": {"bench11": 278024, "bench13": 587276},
+}
+
+
+class Reader:
+    def __init__(s, st):
+        s.q = queue.Queue()
+        threading.Thread(target=s._pump, args=(st,), daemon=True).start()
+
+    def _pump(s, st):
+        for l in st:
+            s.q.put(l)
+        s.q.put(None)
+
+    def get(s, t=300):
+        try:
+            return s.q.get(timeout=t)
+        except queue.Empty:
+            return None
+
+
+def one_run(exe, options, commands):
+    """One fresh process. Returns (list of output lines, list of bad lines)."""
+    p = subprocess.Popen([exe], stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
+                         stderr=subprocess.PIPE, text=True, bufsize=1)
+    r = Reader(p.stdout)
+    bad = []
+
+    def send(c):
+        p.stdin.write(c + "\n")
+        p.stdin.flush()
+
+    def drain():
+        while True:
+            l = r.get()
+            if l is None:
+                raise RuntimeError("no readyok")
+            low = l.lower()
+            if "unknown option" in low or "invalid value" in low or "error" in low:
+                bad.append(l.strip())
+            if l.strip() == "readyok":
+                return
+
+    send("uci")
+    while True:
+        l = r.get(60)
+        if l is None or l.strip() == "uciok":
+            break
+    for opt in options:
+        send("setoption name " + opt)
+        send("isready")
+        drain()
+    if options:
+        send("ucinewgame")
+        send("isready")
+        drain()
+    out = []
+    for cmd in commands:
+        send(cmd)
+        # bench and perft both answer with lines we must read; perft ends with "nodes N",
+        # bench with "info string bench ...".
+        deadline_after = None
+        while True:
+            l = r.get(600)
+            if l is None:
+                raise RuntimeError(f"no answer to {cmd}")
+            out.append(l.rstrip("\n"))
+            low = l.lower()
+            if "unknown option" in low or "invalid value" in low or "error" in low:
+                bad.append(l.strip())
+            if l.startswith("info string bench"):
+                break
+            if l.startswith("nodes "):
+                break
+        send("isready")
+        drain()
+    send("quit")
+    try:
+        p.wait(timeout=30)
+    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
+        p.kill()
+    return out, bad
+
+
+def parse(out, kind):
+    if kind == "bench":
+        for l in out:
+            m = re.match(r"info string bench depth (\d+) nodes (\d+)", l)
+            if m:
+                return int(m.group(2))
+    else:
+        for l in reversed(out):
+            m = re.match(r"^nodes (\d+)$", l)
+            if m:
+                return int(m.group(1))
+    raise SystemExit(f"FAIL could not parse a {kind} node count from: {out[-3:]}")
+
+
+def main():
+    exe, outdir = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
+    want_s14 = "--s14" in sys.argv or "--pc20" in sys.argv
+    want_pc20 = "--pc20" in sys.argv
+    os.makedirs(outdir, exist_ok=True)
+    results, failures = {}, []
+
+    regimes = ["none"]
+    if want_s14:
+        regimes.append("S14")
+    if want_pc20:
+        regimes.append("PC20")
+
+    for regime in regimes:
+        opts = [] if regime == "none" else (S14 if regime == "S14" else S14 + PC20_EXTRA)
+        got = {}
+        # benches and perft, each its own fresh process (the brief's rule)
+        for depth in (11, 13, 16):
+            out, bad = one_run(exe, opts, [f"bench {depth}"])
+            got[f"bench{depth}"] = parse(out, "bench")
+            if bad:
+                failures.append(f"{regime} bench {depth}: {bad[:3]}")
+        out, bad = one_run(exe, opts, ["go perft 5"])
+        got["perft5"] = parse(out, "perft")
+        if bad:
+            failures.append(f"{regime} perft 5: {bad[:3]}")
+        results[regime] = got
+
+        for key, want in EXPECTED[regime].items():
+            have = got.get(key)
+            status = "OK" if have == want else "MISMATCH"
+            print(f"{regime:5s} {key:8s} got {have:>9} want {want:>9}  {status}", flush=True)
+            if have != want:
+                failures.append(f"{regime} {key}: got {have} want {want}")
+
+    json.dump(results, open(os.path.join(outdir, "pc_pins.json"), "w"), indent=1)
+    print()
+    if failures:
+        for f in failures:
+            print("  FAIL " + str(f))
+        print(f"RESULT: {len(failures)} mismatch(es) or bad option line(s)")
+        sys.exit(1)
+    print("RESULT: every published PC r15 number matched in every regime checked")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

diff --git a/forge-combo29/swarm/07/job29/three_symptoms.py b/forge-combo29/swarm/07/job29/three_symptoms.py
new file mode 100644
index 000000000..14f2139b4
--- /dev/null
+++ b/forge-combo29/swarm/07/job29/three_symptoms.py
@@ -0,0 +1,195 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""three_symptoms.py PC_EXE OUTDIR
+
+Runs the three reported symptoms SIDE BY SIDE on the PC r15 build under PC20, Threads 1, Hash 16,
+one fresh process per case, and then decides from the CODE whether they share one path.
+
+  1. 07-F1        `go searchmoves` naming nothing legal (board HAS legal moves)
+  2. 19-F12       `go depth 12` followed by an immediate `quit` (aborted search)
+  3. no-match+NB  `go nodes 100000 searchmoves <illegal>`
+
+For each: record every info line, the bestmove (if any), whether the reported nodes are 0, and
+whether the move is legal for the position. A case that never answers is recorded as ABSENT, not as
+a pass.
+
+This script does NOT send anything while a `go` is running except in case 2, where the early `quit`
+IS the phenomenon under test; that is stated in the output so nobody mistakes it for the harness bug
+seat 19 warned about.
+"""
+import os
+import queue
+import re
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import threading
+
+import chess
+
+S14 = [
+    "LmrQuietBase value 93", "LmrQuietDivisor value 205", "LmrNoisyBase value 13",
+    "LmrNoisyDivisor value 333", "LmrHistoryDivisor value 5643", "NullMoveBase value 5",
+    "LmpBase value 8", "HistoryPruneMultiplier value 2220",
+    "HistoryBonusQuadratic value 24", "HistoryBonusLinear value 54",
+    "HistoryBonusMax value 2212", "SingularDepth value 6", "IirDepth value 2",
+    "NonPawnCorrection value true",
+]
+PC20 = S14 + ["CuckooRep value true", "HistRework value 2", "TtPruneV2 value true",
+              "CorrHistV2 value true", "MateAlphaGuard value true", "OwnBook value false"]
+
+
+class Reader:
+    def __init__(s, st):
+        s.q = queue.Queue()
+        threading.Thread(target=s._pump, args=(st,), daemon=True).start()
+
+    def _pump(s, st):
+        for l in st:
+            s.q.put(l)
+        s.q.put(None)
+
+    def get(s, t=120):
+        try:
+            return s.q.get(timeout=t)
+        except queue.Empty:
+            return None
+
+
+def session(exe):
+    p = subprocess.Popen([exe], stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
+                         stderr=subprocess.PIPE, text=True, bufsize=1)
+    r = Reader(p.stdout)
+
+    def send(c):
+        p.stdin.write(c + "\n")
+        p.stdin.flush()
+
+    def drain():
+        while True:
+            l = r.get()
+            if l is None:
+                raise RuntimeError("no readyok")
+            if l.strip() == "readyok":
+                return
+
+    send("uci")
+    while True:
+        l = r.get(60)
+        if l is None or l.strip() == "uciok":
+            break
+    for opt in ["Hash value 16", "Threads value 1"] + PC20:
+        send("setoption name " + opt)
+        send("isready")
+        drain()
+    return p, r, send, drain
+
+
+def collect(r, send, deadline_s=60.0, early_quit_at=None):
+    """Read lines until bestmove. If early_quit_at is set, send `quit` after that many seconds
+    (case 2 only: the early quit is the phenomenon)."""
+    import time
+    t0 = time.monotonic()
+    quit_sent = False
+    lines = []
+    while True:
+        if early_quit_at is not None and not quit_sent and time.monotonic() - t0 >= early_quit_at:
+            send("quit")
+            quit_sent = True
+        line = r.get(1.0)
+        if line is None:
+            if time.monotonic() - t0 > deadline_s:
+                return lines, None
+            continue
+        lines.append(line.rstrip("\n"))
+        if line.startswith("bestmove"):
+            return lines, line.split()[1]
+
+
+def analyse(lines, best, fen):
+    zero, last_nodes, infos = 0, None, []
+    for l in lines:
+        if l.startswith("info depth"):
+            infos.append(l)
+            m = re.search(r" nodes (\d+) ", l + " ")
+            if m:
+                last_nodes = int(m.group(1))
+                if last_nodes == 0:
+                    zero += 1
+    legal_ok = None
+    if best is not None and fen:
+        try:
+            b = chess.Board(fen)
+            legal = [m.uci() for m in b.legal_moves]
+            legal_ok = (best == "0000" and not legal) or (best in legal)
+        except ValueError:
+            legal_ok = None
+    return {"depth_lines": len(infos), "zero_node_lines": zero,
+            "last_nodes": last_nodes, "bestmove": best,
+            "bestmove_legal": legal_ok,
+            "fabricated": zero > 0}
+
+
+def main():
+    exe, outdir = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
+    os.makedirs(outdir, exist_ok=True)
+    results = {}
+
+    # ---- case 1: 07-F1 ----
+    p, r, send, drain = session(exe)
+    send("ucinewgame"); send("isready"); drain()
+    send("position startpos"); send("isready"); drain()
+    send("go searchmoves e2e5")
+    lines, best = collect(r, send)
+    results["1_07F1_searchmoves_no_legal_name"] = analyse(
+        lines, best, chess.Board().fen())
+    send("quit")
+    try: p.wait(timeout=20)
+    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired: p.kill()
+
+    # ---- case 2: 19-F12 aborted search ----
+    p, r, send, drain = session(exe)
+    send("ucinewgame"); send("isready"); drain()
+    send("position startpos"); send("isready"); drain()
+    send("go depth 12")
+    lines, best = collect(r, send, deadline_s=30.0, early_quit_at=0.0)
+    results["2_19F12_aborted_search"] = analyse(lines, best, chess.Board().fen())
+    try: p.wait(timeout=20)
+    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired: p.kill()
+
+    # ---- case 3: no-match searchmoves with a node budget ----
+    p, r, send, drain = session(exe)
+    send("ucinewgame"); send("isready"); drain()
+    send("position startpos"); send("isready"); drain()
+    send("go nodes 100000 searchmoves e2e5")
+    lines, best = collect(r, send)
+    results["3_nomatch_node_budget"] = analyse(lines, best, chess.Board().fen())
+    send("quit")
+    try: p.wait(timeout=20)
+    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired: p.kill()
+
+    # ---- control: the same three shapes but with a legal target / no restriction ----
+    p, r, send, drain = session(exe)
+    send("ucinewgame"); send("isready"); drain()
+    send("position startpos"); send("isready"); drain()
+    send("go searchmoves e2e4")
+    lines, best = collect(r, send)
+    results["control_searchmoves_legal"] = analyse(lines, best, chess.Board().fen())
+    send("quit")
+    try: p.wait(timeout=20)
+    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired: p.kill()
+
+    import json
+    json.dump(results, open(os.path.join(outdir, "three_symptoms.json"), "w"), indent=1)
+
+    print(f"{'case':38s} {'bestmove':>10s} {'depthlines':>10s} {'zeronodes':>10s} {'last_nodes':>11s} legal")
+    for k, v in results.items():
+        print(f"{k:38s} {str(v['bestmove']):>10s} {v['depth_lines']:>10d} {v['zero_node_lines']:>10d} "
+              f"{str(v['last_nodes']):>11s} {v['bestmove_legal']}")
+    zeros = [k for k, v in results.items() if v["fabricated"]]
+    print()
+    print("cases with a zero-node report: " + (", ".join(zeros) if zeros else "none"))
+    print("NOTE: case 2 sends `quit` deliberately at t=0; that early quit is the phenomenon 19-F12")
+    print("      describes, not the harness bug seat 19 warned everyone about.")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

diff --git a/forge-combo29/swarm/07/job3/check_17SF2.py b/forge-combo29/swarm/07/job3/check_17SF2.py
new file mode 100644
index 000000000..066f0e179
--- /dev/null
+++ b/forge-combo29/swarm/07/job3/check_17SF2.py
@@ -0,0 +1,75 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""check_17SF2.py EXE OUTDIR
+
+Checks seat 17's finding S-F2 by its own claim, not by its script:
+  "src/search.cpp:2640 `if (result.best_move.is_none()) result.best_move =
+   root_candidates.front();` reads front() of an EMPTY MoveList when root_candidates is
+   empty but legal moves exist".
+
+Two independent instruments, each with a positive control so a "no crash" result means
+something:
+
+ A. The claim under a container-checking STL: EXE must be built with -D_GLIBCXX_DEBUG.
+    Control: the same binary must abort on `searchmoves` with an illegal name IF the claim
+    is true. Pass/fail is read from exit status and stderr, not from a grepped number.
+
+ B. Reachability: a scratch build that prints a marker at 2640 with root_candidates.size().
+    If 2640 runs with size 0 anywhere, the claim is CONFIRMED; if it only ever runs with a
+    non-zero size, or never runs for the empty-root cases, the claim is REFUTED because
+    the code path cannot exist.
+
+Both are driven by uci_drive.py, which never pipelines a command behind `go`.
+
+Every assertion is explicit: a missing record, a missing bestmove or a missing marker file
+is an error, never a pass.
+"""
+import json
+import os
+import re
+import subprocess
+import sys
+
+HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
+sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(HERE), "job2"))
+from uci_drive import parse_cases, run_case  # noqa: E402
+
+# Cases: the empty-root ones are the claim; startpos_legal_control is the sanity control.
+CASES_PATH = os.path.join(HERE, "cases_17sf2.txt")
+
+
+def drive(exe, outdir, timeout=60):
+    os.makedirs(outdir, exist_ok=True)
+    return [run_case(exe, n, l, a, outdir, timeout) for n, l, a in parse_cases(CASES_PATH)]
+
+
+def main():
+    exe, outdir = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
+    os.makedirs(outdir, exist_ok=True)
+    rows = drive(exe, outdir)
+    print(f"{'case':32s} {'bestmove':12s} {'depthlines':10s} {'aborted':8s}")
+    any_abort = False
+    for rec in rows:
+        err = os.path.join(outdir, rec["case"] + ".err")
+        if not os.path.exists(err):
+            raise SystemExit(f"FAIL no stderr file for {rec['case']}: nothing measured")
+        text = open(err, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace").read()
+        aborted = ("attempt to access an element in an empty container" in text
+                   or "Assertion" in text or "Aborted" in text)
+        any_abort = any_abort or aborted
+        # depth lines are only visible as the last info line here; count from stderr+json
+        depth = 1 if rec.get("last_info") else 0
+        print(f"{rec['case']:32s} {(rec['bestmoves'][-1] if rec['bestmoves'] else '-'):12s} "
+              f"{depth:<10d} {str(aborted):8s}")
+        if not rec["bestmoves"] and not aborted:
+            raise SystemExit(f"FAIL {rec['case']}: no bestmove and no abort -- the run measured nothing")
+    print()
+    print(f"container-check abort seen anywhere: {any_abort}")
+    print("VERDICT A (debug-STL): " +
+          ("claim SUPPORTED by the container check" if any_abort
+           else "claim NOT supported: front() of an empty container was never reached"))
+    with open(os.path.join(outdir, "verdict.txt"), "w") as fh:
+        fh.write(f"any_abort={any_abort}\n")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

diff --git a/forge-combo29/swarm/07/job3/reach_2640.py b/forge-combo29/swarm/07/job3/reach_2640.py
new file mode 100644
index 000000000..1d74670a9
--- /dev/null
+++ b/forge-combo29/swarm/07/job3/reach_2640.py
@@ -0,0 +1,65 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""reach_2640.py EXE_WITH_MARKER OUTDIR
+
+Reads the REACHED-LINE-2640 markers a scratch build writes to stderr and decides whether
+search.cpp:2640 ever executes with an empty root_candidates.
+
+The marker line is `REACHED-LINE-2640 root_candidates=<n>` (see the scratch copy at
+/tmp/reach/src/search.cpp, built the same way as build-dbg). If the marker string is not
+present in the binary at all, this script fails loudly instead of reporting "no markers"
+(the mistake seat 19 warned about: parsing a line the engine never prints).
+"""
+import json
+import os
+import re
+import subprocess
+import sys
+
+HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
+sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(HERE), "job2"))
+from uci_drive import parse_cases, run_case  # noqa: E402
+
+CASES = os.path.join(HERE, "cases_17sf2.txt")
+MARKER = "REACHED-LINE-2640"
+PATTERN = re.compile(r"REACHED-LINE-2640 root_candidates=(\d+)")
+
+
+def main():
+    exe, outdir = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
+    os.makedirs(outdir, exist_ok=True)
+
+    # Precondition: the marker must actually exist in this binary.
+    dumped = subprocess.run(["strings", exe], capture_output=True, text=True)
+    if dumped.returncode != 0:
+        raise SystemExit(f"FAIL 'strings {exe}' failed: cannot verify the instrument exists")
+    if MARKER not in dumped.stdout:
+        raise SystemExit(f"FAIL {exe} does not contain the marker {MARKER}: "
+                         f"a 'no marker found' result would be meaningless")
+
+    zero_sizes, rows = [], []
+    for name, lines, about in parse_cases(CASES):
+        rec = run_case(exe, name, lines, about, outdir, 60)
+        errpath = os.path.join(outdir, name + ".err")
+        if not os.path.exists(errpath):
+            raise SystemExit(f"FAIL no stderr for {name}")
+        text = open(errpath, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace").read()
+        sizes = [int(m) for m in PATTERN.findall(text)]
+        rows.append((name, rec["bestmoves"][-1] if rec["bestmoves"] else "-", sizes))
+        zero_sizes.extend((name, s) for s in sizes if s == 0)
+    for name, bm, sizes in rows:
+        print(f"{name:34s} bestmove={bm:16s} marker hits={len(sizes)} sizes={sizes}")
+    total = sum(len(s) for _, _, s in rows)
+    print()
+    print(f"total marker hits: {total}")
+    if total == 0:
+        raise SystemExit("FAIL the marker never fired at all, so this run shows nothing either way")
+    if zero_sizes:
+        print("RESULT: CONFIRMED - line 2640 was reached with an EMPTY root at:",
+              zero_sizes)
+        return
+    print("RESULT: REFUTED - line 2640 never ran with root_candidates.size()==0 in any case; "
+          "every hit had a non-empty root.")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

diff --git a/forge-combo29/swarm/07/job30/pc20_sums.py b/forge-combo29/swarm/07/job30/pc20_sums.py
new file mode 100644
index 000000000..664f874bd
--- /dev/null
+++ b/forge-combo29/swarm/07/job30/pc20_sums.py
@@ -0,0 +1,137 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""pc20_sums.py PC_EXE FENS OUTDIR DEPTH [--pc20|--s14]
+
+Re-runs this seat's known-sum checks on the PC r15 build under a chosen regime.
+
+Why this matters: on the BASE tree all four published S14 sums reproduced exactly (07-C3/C4/C6/C8).
+The PC build changes search behaviour (FORGE_FIX_* switches and four new options), so the same sums
+CANNOT be expected to reproduce under S14 — file 5 publishes PC20 bench numbers instead, and only
+those. This job therefore establishes what the PC build's own sums are, as a reproducible baseline
+for later re-checks, rather than asserting a number it was never published for.
+
+Rules honoured: Threads 1, Hash 16, `ucinewgame` + `isready` before EVERY `go`, one fresh process
+per position (so nothing can be warm), and every node figure is parsed and asserted present.
+"""
+import json
+import os
+import queue
+import re
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import threading
+
+S14 = [
+    "LmrQuietBase value 93", "LmrQuietDivisor value 205", "LmrNoisyBase value 13",
+    "LmrNoisyDivisor value 333", "LmrHistoryDivisor value 5643", "NullMoveBase value 5",
+    "LmpBase value 8", "HistoryPruneMultiplier value 2220",
+    "HistoryBonusQuadratic value 24", "HistoryBonusLinear value 54",
+    "HistoryBonusMax value 2212", "SingularDepth value 6", "IirDepth value 2",
+    "NonPawnCorrection value true",
+]
+PC20 = S14 + ["CuckooRep value true", "HistRework value 2", "TtPruneV2 value true",
+              "CorrHistV2 value true", "MateAlphaGuard value true", "OwnBook value false"]
+
+
+class Reader:
+    def __init__(s, st):
+        s.q = queue.Queue()
+        threading.Thread(target=s._pump, args=(st,), daemon=True).start()
+
+    def _pump(s, st):
+        for l in st:
+            s.q.put(l)
+        s.q.put(None)
+
+    def get(s, t=300):
+        try:
+            return s.q.get(timeout=t)
+        except queue.Empty:
+            return None
+
+
+def go_once(exe, options, fen, depth):
+    p = subprocess.Popen([exe], stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
+                         stderr=subprocess.PIPE, text=True, bufsize=1)
+    r = Reader(p.stdout)
+
+    def send(c):
+        p.stdin.write(c + "\n")
+        p.stdin.flush()
+
+    def drain(tag):
+        while True:
+            l = r.get()
+            if l is None:
+                raise RuntimeError(f"no readyok after {tag}")
+            if l.strip() == "readyok":
+                return
+
+    send("uci")
+    while True:
+        l = r.get(60)
+        if l is None or l.strip() == "uciok":
+            break
+    for opt in ["Hash value 16", "Threads value 1"] + options:
+        send("setoption name " + opt)
+        send("isready")
+        drain(opt)
+    send("ucinewgame")
+    send("isready")
+    drain("ucinewgame")
+    send("position fen " + fen)
+    send("isready")
+    drain("position")
+    send(f"go depth {depth}")
+    nodes, score, best = None, None, None
+    while True:
+        l = r.get(600)
+        if l is None:
+            raise RuntimeError(f"no bestmove for {fen}")
+        if l.startswith(f"info depth {depth}") and " nodes " in l:
+            m = re.search(r" nodes (\d+) ", l)
+            if m:
+                nodes = int(m.group(1))
+            m = re.search(r"score (cp|mate) (-?\d+)", l)
+            if m:
+                score = f"{m.group(1)} {m.group(2)}"
+        if l.startswith("bestmove"):
+            best = l.split()[1]
+            break
+    send("quit")
+    try:
+        p.wait(timeout=30)
+    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
+        p.kill()
+    if nodes is None:
+        raise SystemExit(f"FAIL no nodes parsed for {fen} at depth {depth}")
+    return nodes, score, best
+
+
+def main():
+    # positional args are the first four; any --flag may appear anywhere after them
+    positional = [a for a in sys.argv[1:] if not a.startswith("--")]
+    flags = [a for a in sys.argv[1:] if a.startswith("--")]
+    exe, fens_path, outdir, depth = positional[0], positional[1], positional[2], int(positional[3])
+    regime = "PC20" if "--pc20" in flags else ("S14" if "--s14" in flags else "none")
+    options = {"none": [], "S14": S14, "PC20": PC20}[regime]
+    os.makedirs(outdir, exist_ok=True)
+    fens = [l.strip() for l in open(fens_path, encoding="utf-8") if l.strip()]
+    rows, total = [], 0
+    for i, fen in enumerate(fens):
+        nodes, score, best = go_once(exe, options, fen, depth)
+        rows.append({"i": i, "fen": fen, "nodes": nodes, "score": score, "best": best})
+        total += nodes
+        if i < 3:
+            print(f"  first{i+1}: nodes {nodes} score {score} best {best}", flush=True)
+        if (i + 1) % 50 == 0:
+            print(f"  ...{i+1}/{len(fens)} running sum {total}", flush=True)
+    print(f"positions {len(rows)} depth {depth} regime {regime}")
+    print(f"SUM {total}")
+    json.dump({"regime": regime, "depth": depth, "fens": fens_path, "rows": rows, "sum": total},
+              open(os.path.join(outdir, f"sum_{regime}_d{depth}.json"), "w"), indent=1)
+    if total == 0:
+        raise SystemExit("FAIL sum is zero: nothing measured")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
