diff --git a/forge-combo29/swarm/07/job31/answer_0000.py b/forge-combo29/swarm/07/job31/answer_0000.py
new file mode 100644
index 000000000..2e3af0b71
--- /dev/null
+++ b/forge-combo29/swarm/07/job31/answer_0000.py
@@ -0,0 +1,164 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""answer_0000.py BASE_EXE PC_EXE OUTDIR
+
+Answers the design question asked of this seat: when `searchmoves` names no legal root move on a board
+that HAS legal moves, what should the engine answer?
+
+Three candidates, measured rather than argued:
+
+  A  `bestmove 0000` plus a diagnostic info string   (what the patched build does today)
+  B  a real move chosen by searching the full legal root, with an info string explaining the
+     restriction was ignored                                     (NOT implemented; measured by asking
+                                                                 the same engine for an unrestricted
+                                                                 `go` on the same position, which is
+                                                                 exactly the answer B would give)
+  C  `bestmove 0000` with NO info line                (what the unpatched build effectively gives,
+                                                       plus its fabricated score lines)
+
+The point of measuring B this way: B's move is by definition what `go` without `searchmoves` returns,
+so no new engine is needed to state its consequence — only to state that it IS this move.
+
+Also checks the boundary case this seat was asked about: `searchmoves` naming a move that IS legal but
+leaves exactly ONE candidate, on both builds.
+"""
+import os
+import queue
+import re
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import threading
+
+import chess
+
+S14 = [
+    "LmrQuietBase value 93", "LmrQuietDivisor value 205", "LmrNoisyBase value 13",
+    "LmrNoisyDivisor value 333", "LmrHistoryDivisor value 5643", "NullMoveBase value 5",
+    "LmpBase value 8", "HistoryPruneMultiplier value 2220",
+    "HistoryBonusQuadratic value 24", "HistoryBonusLinear value 54",
+    "HistoryBonusMax value 2212", "SingularDepth value 6", "IirDepth value 2",
+    "NonPawnCorrection value true",
+]
+PC20 = S14 + ["CuckooRep value true", "HistRework value 2", "TtPruneV2 value true",
+              "CorrHistV2 value true", "MateAlphaGuard value true", "OwnBook value false"]
+
+
+class Reader:
+    def __init__(s, st):
+        s.q = queue.Queue()
+        threading.Thread(target=s._pump, args=(st,), daemon=True).start()
+
+    def _pump(s, st):
+        for l in st:
+            s.q.put(l)
+        s.q.put(None)
+
+    def get(s, t=180):
+        try:
+            return s.q.get(timeout=t)
+        except queue.Empty:
+            return None
+
+
+def ask(exe, options, position, go):
+    p = subprocess.Popen([exe], stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
+                         stderr=subprocess.PIPE, text=True, bufsize=1)
+    r = Reader(p.stdout)
+
+    def send(c):
+        p.stdin.write(c + "\n")
+        p.stdin.flush()
+
+    def drain():
+        while True:
+            l = r.get()
+            if l is None:
+                raise RuntimeError("no readyok")
+            if l.strip() == "readyok":
+                return
+
+    send("uci")
+    while True:
+        l = r.get(60)
+        if l is None or l.strip() == "uciok":
+            break
+    for opt in ["Hash value 16", "Threads value 1"] + options:
+        send("setoption name " + opt); send("isready"); drain()
+    send("ucinewgame"); send("isready"); drain()
+    send(position); send("isready"); drain()
+    send(go)
+    infos, infostrings, best = [], [], None
+    while True:
+        l = r.get(300)
+        if l is None:
+            raise RuntimeError("no bestmove")
+        if l.startswith("info depth"):
+            infos.append(l.strip())
+        elif l.startswith("info string"):
+            infostrings.append(l.strip())
+        if l.startswith("bestmove"):
+            best = l.split()[1]
+            break
+    send("quit")
+    try: p.wait(timeout=20)
+    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired: p.kill()
+    nodes = None
+    if infos:
+        m = re.search(r" nodes (\d+) ", infos[-1] + " ")
+        if m: nodes = int(m.group(1))
+    return {"bestmove": best, "depth_lines": len(infos), "nodes": nodes,
+            "info_strings": infostrings}
+
+
+def main():
+    base_exe, pc_exe, outdir = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2], sys.argv[3]
+    os.makedirs(outdir, exist_ok=True)
+    results = {}
+
+    # ---------- the design question ----------
+    # A: what the patched PC build answers (0000 + info string).
+    a = ask(pc_exe, [], "position startpos", "go depth 6 searchmoves e2e5")
+    # B: measured as the unrestricted search's answer -- that IS what B would play.
+    b = ask(pc_exe, [], "position startpos", "go depth 6")
+    # C: the unpatched base build, for the record.
+    c = ask(base_exe, [], "position startpos", "go depth 6 searchmoves e2e5")
+    results["A_0000_plus_info_patched_pc"] = a
+    results["B_unrestricted_search_answer"] = b
+    results["C_unpatched_base"] = c
+
+    print("Design question -- what to answer when searchmoves names nothing legal (startpos, 20 legal moves)")
+    print(f"  A  0000 + info string (patched PC) : bestmove {a['bestmove']}, "
+          f"{a['depth_lines']} depth lines, info strings {a['info_strings']}")
+    print(f"  B  full-root search answer         : bestmove {b['bestmove']}, "
+          f"{b['depth_lines']} depth lines, nodes {b['nodes']}")
+    print(f"  C  unpatched base                  : bestmove {c['bestmove']}, "
+          f"{c['depth_lines']} depth lines (all nodes 0), nodes {c['nodes']}")
+
+    # ---------- the boundary case ----------
+    print()
+    print("Boundary case: searchmoves naming a move that IS legal, leaving exactly ONE candidate")
+    boundary = [
+        ("one_legal_candidate_startpos", "position startpos", "go depth 6 searchmoves e2e4"),
+        # White to move, and Nxe5 is a real capture: the restriction leaves exactly ONE candidate
+        # that is legal and non-trivial. (My first version of this line used a position where it was
+        # BLACK to move, so f3e5 was never legal and the test was measuring nothing -- caught by
+        # checking with python-chess before believing the warning.)
+        ("one_candidate_capture", "position startpos moves e2e4 e7e5 g1f3 b8c6",
+         "go depth 6 searchmoves f3e5"),
+    ]
+    for name, pos, go in boundary:
+        rb = ask(base_exe, [], pos, go)
+        rp = ask(pc_exe, PC20, pos, go)
+        results[name] = {"base": rb, "pc20": rp}
+        print(f"  {name:32s} base {rb['bestmove']:6s} dlines {rb['depth_lines']:3d} "
+              f"nodes {rb['nodes']}   |  PC20 {rp['bestmove']:6s} dlines {rp['depth_lines']:3d} "
+              f"nodes {rp['nodes']}", flush=True)
+        if rb["nodes"] == 0 or rp["nodes"] == 0:
+            print(f"    WARNING: a zero-node answer on a ONE-candidate legal restriction -> "
+                  f"the early branch is taken even when a legal candidate exists")
+
+    import json
+    json.dump(results, open(os.path.join(outdir, "answer_0000.json"), "w"), indent=1)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

--- /dev/null
+++ b/forge-combo29/swarm/07/job31/raw/answer_0000.json
@@ -0,0 +1,52 @@
+{
+ "A_0000_plus_info_patched_pc": {
+  "bestmove": "0000",
+  "depth_lines": 0,
+  "nodes": null,
+  "info_strings": [

diff --git a/forge-combo29/swarm/07/job32/rerun_cseries.sh b/forge-combo29/swarm/07/job32/rerun_cseries.sh
new file mode 100644
index 000000000..07ac5ddb4
--- /dev/null
+++ b/forge-combo29/swarm/07/job32/rerun_cseries.sh
@@ -0,0 +1,57 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+# rerun_cseries.sh -- re-runs this seat's board-level checks against the PC r15 tree.
+#
+# Why: every check below was written against the BASE tree (6b98f217). The PC build changes search
+# extensively, so any of them could plausibly have been broken there. Each is compiled against the
+# PC tree's OWN src/ and include/, so the code under test is the PC engine's, not a mix.
+#
+# Every program carries its own positive control (a planted fault in a scratch copy), run in the
+# same script, so a zero from the real build means something. See job32/CONTROLS.txt for the control
+# runs recorded in this job.
+set -u
+PC=/agent/repos/pcbase/forge-combo29
+OUT=/agent/repos/dwqww/forge-combo29/swarm/07/job32
+DEFS='-DFORGE_EXPOSE_TUNABLES=1 -DFORGE_NNUE_HIDDEN=256 -DFORGE_SEARCH_SPEED2=1 -DFORGE_SPD_NNUE_ZMM=1 -DFORGE_SPD_NO_ZERO_MOVELISTS=2 -DFORGE_SPD_PREFETCH_EARLY=1 -DFORGE_SPD_SLIDER_PEXT=1 -DFORGE_SPD_KING_LINES=1 -DFORGE_MATE_ALPHA_GUARD=1 -DNDEBUG'
+INC="-I$PC/include"
+
+echo "=== 1. key_after vs make_move (PC tree) ==="
+g++-13 -std=c++20 -O2 -march=x86-64-v4 $DEFS $INC \
+    /agent/repos/dwqww/forge-combo29/swarm/07/job6/key_after_test.cpp \
+    $PC/src/board.cpp $PC/src/bitboard.cpp -o /tmp/pc_keytest 2>&1 | head -5
+/tmp/pc_keytest 200 701 | tee "$OUT/key_after_pc.txt"
+
+echo "=== 2. board probes: castling / ep / king across null (PC tree) ==="
+g++-13 -std=c++20 -O2 -march=x86-64-v4 $DEFS $INC \
+    /agent/repos/dwqww/forge-combo29/swarm/07/job6/board_probes.cpp \
+    $PC/src/board.cpp $PC/src/bitboard.cpp -o /tmp/pc_boardprobes 2>&1 | head -5
+/tmp/pc_boardprobes | tee "$OUT/board_probes_pc.txt"
+
+echo "=== 3. fast legality path vs brute force (PC tree) ==="
+g++-13 -std=c++20 -O2 -march=x86-64-v4 $DEFS $INC \
+    /agent/repos/dwqww/forge-combo29/swarm/07/job13/is_legal_probe.cpp \
+    $PC/src/board.cpp $PC/src/bitboard.cpp -o /tmp/pc_islegal 2>&1 | head -5
+/tmp/pc_islegal 40 701 | tee "$OUT/is_legal_pc.txt"
+
+echo "=== 4. gives_check vs make+in_check (PC tree) ==="
+g++-13 -std=c++20 -O2 -march=x86-64-v4 $DEFS $INC \
+    /agent/repos/dwqww/forge-combo29/swarm/07/job14/gives_check_probe.cpp \
+    $PC/src/board.cpp $PC/src/bitboard.cpp -o /tmp/pc_gcprobe 2>&1 | head -5
+/tmp/pc_gcprobe 40 701 | tee "$OUT/gives_check_pc.txt"
+
+echo "=== 5. has_legal_move vs python-chess (PC tree) ==="
+g++-13 -std=c++20 -O2 -march=x86-64-v4 $DEFS $INC \
+    /agent/repos/dwqww/forge-combo29/swarm/07/job8/legal_move_probe.cpp \
+    $PC/src/board.cpp $PC/src/bitboard.cpp -o /tmp/pc_legalprobe 2>&1 | head -5
+cd /agent/repos/dwqww/forge-combo29/swarm/07/job32 && \
+  timeout 600 python3 -u ../job8/check_legal_move.py /tmp/pc_legalprobe 2>&1 | tee "$OUT/has_legal_move_pc.txt"
+
+echo "=== 6. repetition vs python-chess (PC tree) ==="
+g++-13 -std=c++20 -O2 -march=x86-64-v4 $DEFS $INC \
+    /agent/repos/dwqww/forge-combo29/swarm/07/job7/repetition_probe.cpp \
+    $PC/src/board.cpp $PC/src/bitboard.cpp -o /tmp/pc_repprobe 2>&1 | head -5
+cd /agent/repos/dwqww/forge-combo29/swarm/07/job32 && \
+  timeout 600 python3 -u ../job7/check_repetition.py /tmp/pc_repprobe 2>&1 | tee "$OUT/repetition_pc.txt"
+
+echo "=== 7. perft vs python-chess on the 14 special positions (PC exe) ==="
+cd /agent/repos/dwqww/forge-combo29/swarm/07/job32 && \
+  timeout 900 python3 -u ../job4/perft_board.py "$PC/build-pc/forge" perft_pc 2>&1 | tee "$OUT/perft_pc.txt"

diff --git a/forge-combo29/swarm/07/job33/differential.py b/forge-combo29/swarm/07/job33/differential.py
new file mode 100644
index 000000000..4dd0b6a80
--- /dev/null
+++ b/forge-combo29/swarm/07/job33/differential.py
@@ -0,0 +1,223 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""differential.py BASE_EXE PC_EXE OUTDIR
+
+Finds where the PC build behaves DIFFERENTLY from the base tree, because those are the only
+differences that can change what the owner does — a PC answer that matches base is either "no change"
+or "the same bug", and neither is decision-relevant.
+
+For each case the two builds are driven identically (Threads 1, Hash 16, OwnBook false, one fresh
+process per case, never sending anything while a `go` is running) and these are compared:
+
+    bestmove, legal-in-position, number of depth lines, last nodes, score, and whether the run
+    reported anything invalid.
+
+Differences are then CLASSIFIED:
+  * expected : matches one of the FORGE_FIX_* switches file 5 lists, or a search change from the four
+               new options. I only claim "expected" where I can name the switch or option.
+  * unexplained : everything else. These are what matter.
+
+The case set deliberately includes things file 3 and file 5 say were CHANGED on the PC (drawn root,
+go-parse, bare-king endings) as well as things they do not mention, so a difference that shows up in
+an unmentioned area is visible.
+"""
+import os
+import queue
+import re
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import threading
+
+import chess
+
+# Position/move cases. Each is (name, position command, go command, note)
+CASES = [
+    # --- things file 3 / file 5 say the PC REPAIRED: a difference here is expected ---
+    ("drawn_root_repetition", "position startpos moves e2e4 e7e5 e1e2 e8e7 e2e1 e7e8 "
+                              "e1e2 e8e7 e2e1 e7e8", "go depth 8", "FORGE_FIX_ROOT_DRAWN"),
+    ("drawn_root_halfmove", "position fen 8/8/8/4k3/8/8/4K3/R7 w - - 100 80", "go depth 6",
+     "FORGE_FIX_ROOT_DRAWN"),
+    ("bare_king_vs_king", "position fen 8/8/8/4k3/8/8/4K3/8 w - - 0 1", "go depth 10",
+     "FORGE_FIX_BARE_KING_*"),
+    ("bare_king_and_rook", "position fen 8/8/8/4k3/8/8/4K3/R7 w - - 0 1", "go depth 10",
+     "FORGE_FIX_BARE_KING_*"),
+    ("go_keyword_as_value", "position startpos", "go depth nodes", "FORGE_FIX_GO_PARSE"),
+    ("go_trailing_keyword", "position startpos", "go nodes 100000 depth", "FORGE_FIX_GO_PARSE"),
+    # --- things NOT listed as changed: a difference here is UNEXPLAINED and worth reporting ---
+    ("plain_depth8", "position startpos", "go depth 8", "unlisted"),
+    ("plain_depth12", "position startpos", "go depth 12", "unlisted"),
+    ("middlegame_depth10", "position fen r1bq1rk1/pp2bppp/2n1pn2/3p4/2PP4/2N1PN2/PP3PPP/R2QKB1R w KQ - 0 8",
+     "go depth 10", "unlisted"),
+    ("endgame_depth12", "position fen 8/2p5/3p4/KP5r/1R3p1k/8/4P1P1/8 w - - 0 1", "go depth 12",
+     "unlisted"),
+    ("mate_in_one", "position fen 7k/6Q1/6K1/8/8/8/8/8 b - - 0 1", "go depth 5", "unlisted"),
+    ("stalemate_root", "position fen 7k/5Q2/6K1/8/8/8/8/8 b - - 0 1", "go depth 5", "unlisted"),
+    ("nodes_budget", "position startpos", "go nodes 50000", "unlisted"),
+    ("nodes_tiny", "position startpos", "go nodes 30", "unlisted"),
+    ("multipv2", "setoption name MultiPV value 2\nposition startpos", "go depth 8", "unlisted"),
+    ("searchmoves_legal", "position startpos", "go depth 8 searchmoves e2e4", "unlisted"),
+    ("searchmoves_none_legal", "position startpos", "go depth 8 searchmoves e2e5",
+     "07-F1 -- the PC must still show it"),
+    ("fifty_move_99", "position fen 8/8/8/4k3/8/8/4K3/R7 w - - 99 80", "go depth 8", "unlisted"),
+    ("check_evasion", "position fen 4k3/8/8/8/8/8/4r3/4K3 w - - 0 1", "go depth 8", "unlisted"),
+    ("promotion_race", "position fen 8/P6k/8/8/8/8/8/K7 w - - 0 1", "go depth 10", "unlisted"),
+]
+
+
+class Reader:
+    def __init__(s, st):
+        s.q = queue.Queue()
+        threading.Thread(target=s._pump, args=(st,), daemon=True).start()
+
+    def _pump(s, st):
+        for l in st:
+            s.q.put(l)
+        s.q.put(None)
+
+    def get(s, t=240):
+        try:
+            return s.q.get(timeout=t)
+        except queue.Empty:
+            return None
+
+
+def run(exe, pre_lines, go):
+    """pre_lines may include setoption/position lines. Returns a record dict."""
+    p = subprocess.Popen([exe], stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
+                         stderr=subprocess.PIPE, text=True, bufsize=1)
+    r = Reader(p.stdout)
+    bad = []
+
+    def send(c):
+        p.stdin.write(c + "\n")
+        p.stdin.flush()
+
+    def drain():
+        while True:
+            l = r.get()
+            if l is None:
+                raise RuntimeError("no readyok")
+            low = l.lower()
+            if "unknown option" in low or "invalid value" in low or "error" in low:
+                bad.append(l.strip())
+            if l.strip() == "readyok":
+                return
+
+    send("uci")
+    while True:
+        l = r.get(60)
+        if l is None or l.strip() == "uciok":
+            break
+    for opt in ["Hash value 16", "Threads value 1", "OwnBook value false"]:
+        send("setoption name " + opt); send("isready"); drain()
+    send("ucinewgame"); send("isready"); drain()
+
+    position_line = None
+    for line in pre_lines:
+        if line.startswith("setoption"):
+            send(line); send("isready"); drain()
+        elif line.startswith("position"):
+            position_line = line
+            send(line); send("isready"); drain()
+    if position_line is None:
+        raise SystemExit("FAIL no position line in case")
+
+    send(go)
+    depth_lines, best, score, nodes = [], None, None, None
+    while True:
+        l = r.get(300)
+        if l is None:
+            best = "ABSENT"
+            break
+        low = l.lower()
+        if "unknown option" in low or "invalid value" in low or "error" in low:
+            bad.append(l.strip())
+        if l.startswith("info depth"):
+            depth_lines.append(l.strip())
+            m = re.search(r" nodes (\d+) ", l + " ")
+            if m:
+                nodes = int(m.group(1))
+            m = re.search(r"score (cp|mate) (-?\d+)", l)
+            if m:
+                score = f"{m.group(1)} {m.group(2)}"
+        if l.startswith("bestmove"):
+            best = l.split()[1]
+            break
+    send("quit")
+    try:
+        p.wait(timeout=30)
+    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
+        p.kill()
+
+    # legality of the answer, from the position line
+    legal_ok = None
+    fen = None
+    m = re.search(r"position fen (.+)", position_line)
+    if m:
+        fen = m.group(1).strip()
+    elif position_line.startswith("position startpos"):
+        fen = "rnbqkbnr/pppppppp/8/8/8/8/PPPPPPPP/RNBQKBNR w KQkq - 0 1"
+        suffix = position_line[len("position startpos"):].strip()
+        if suffix.startswith("moves"):
+            moves = suffix.split()[1:]
+            b = chess.Board()
+            for mv in moves:
+                b.push(chess.Move.from_uci(mv))
+            fen = b.fen()
+    if fen and best not in (None, "ABSENT"):
+        try:
+            b = chess.Board(fen)
+            legal = [x.uci() for x in b.legal_moves]
+            legal_ok = (best == "0000" and not legal) or (best in legal)
+        except ValueError:
+            legal_ok = None
+    return {"bestmove": best, "legal": legal_ok, "depth_lines": len(depth_lines),
+            "nodes": nodes, "score": score, "bad": bad}
+
+
+def main():
+    base_exe, pc_exe, outdir = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2], sys.argv[3]
+    os.makedirs(outdir, exist_ok=True)
+    rows = []
+    print(f"{'case':26s} {'BASE (best/score/nodes)':44s} {'PC (best/score/nodes)':44s} verdict")
+    for name, pre, go, note in CASES:
+        pre_lines = pre.split("\n")
+        b = run(base_exe, pre_lines, go)
+        p = run(pc_exe, pre_lines, go)
+        same_move = b["bestmove"] == p["bestmove"]
+        same_score = b["score"] == p["score"]
+        same_nodes = b["nodes"] == p["nodes"]
+        identical = same_move and same_score and same_nodes and b["depth_lines"] == p["depth_lines"]
+        verdict = "SAME" if identical else "DIFFERS"
+        rows.append({"case": name, "go": go, "note": note, "base": b, "pc": p,
+                     "differs": not identical, "same_move": same_move,
+                     "same_score": same_score, "same_nodes": same_nodes})
+        bl = f"{b['bestmove']}/{b['score']}/{b['nodes']}/{b['depth_lines']}d"
+        pl = f"{p['bestmove']}/{p['score']}/{p['nodes']}/{p['depth_lines']}d"
+        print(f"{name:26s} {bl:44s} {pl:44s} {verdict}", flush=True)
+        if b["bad"] or p["bad"]:
+            print(f"    BAD LINES base={b['bad'][:2]} pc={p['bad'][:2]}")
+
+    import json
+    json.dump(rows, open(os.path.join(outdir, "differential.json"), "w"), indent=1)
+    differs = [r for r in rows if r["differs"]]
+    print()
+    print(f"cases differing: {len(differs)} of {len(rows)}")
+    explained = [r for r in differs if r["note"] not in ("unlisted",)]
+    unexplained = [r for r in differs if r["note"] == "unlisted"]
+    print(f"  with a named PC switch in the note (expected): {len(explained)}")
+    print(f"  NOT explained by a named switch:                {len(unexplained)}")
+    for r in unexplained:
+        print(f"    UNEXPLAINED {r['case']}: base {r['base']['bestmove']}/{r['base']['score']}/"
+              f"{r['base']['nodes']}  pc {r['pc']['bestmove']}/{r['pc']['score']}/{r['pc']['nodes']}")
+    # any illegal answer is a fault regardless of explanation
+    illegal = [(r["case"], "base") for r in rows if r["base"]["legal"] is False] + \
+              [(r["case"], "pc") for r in rows if r["pc"]["legal"] is False]
+    print()
+    if illegal:
+        print("ILLEGAL ANSWERS (a fault on that build): " + str(illegal[:8]))
+    else:
+        print("no illegal answer on either build in any case")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

diff --git a/forge-combo29/swarm/07/job34/sum_delta.py b/forge-combo29/swarm/07/job34/sum_delta.py
new file mode 100644
index 000000000..36fb533b0
--- /dev/null
+++ b/forge-combo29/swarm/07/job34/sum_delta.py
@@ -0,0 +1,111 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""sum_delta.py BASE_S14_JSON PC20_JSON OUTDIR
+
+Reports the per-position difference between base-under-S14 and PC-under-PC20 for the same set, so a
+reader can see WHICH positions changed and by how much — the coordinator's point: one aggregate tells
+you the totals moved, a per-position table tells you whether the PC's search changes are broad or narrow.
+
+Inputs are the two sum_*.json files this seat already produced:
+  job9/raw/sum_d12.json           base tree, S14,  depth 12, 200 positions  (07-C3)
+  job30/raw/sum_PC20_d12.json     PC r15, PC20, depth 12, 200 positions     (07-C26)
+
+Caveat stated up front and repeated in the output: the two runs differ in BOTH build and settings, so
+a per-position difference cannot be attributed to the PC's search changes alone. This is a
+characterisation of the pair of configurations the owner actually uses, not a controlled experiment.
+"""
+import json
+import os
+import statistics
+import sys
+
+
+def normalise(row):
+    """Two of this seat's own runs used slightly different row schemas; accept either."""
+    return {
+        "i": row.get("i", row.get("index")),
+        "fen": row["fen"],
+        "nodes": row["nodes"],
+        "best": row.get("best"),
+        "score": row.get("score", row.get("last_score_line")),
+    }
+
+
+def load(path, key="rows"):
+    d = json.load(open(path))
+    return [normalise(r) for r in d.get(key, d)], d.get("sum")
+
+
+def main():
+    base_path, pc_path, outdir = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2], sys.argv[3]
+    os.makedirs(outdir, exist_ok=True)
+    base, base_sum = load(base_path)
+    pc, pc_sum = load(pc_path)
+    if len(base) != len(pc):
+        raise SystemExit(f"FAIL position counts differ: {len(base)} vs {len(pc)}")
+
+    rows = []
+    for b, p in zip(base, pc):
+        if b["fen"] != p["fen"]:
+            raise SystemExit(f"FAIL fen mismatch at {b['i']}: {b['fen']} vs {p['fen']}")
+        delta = p["nodes"] - b["nodes"]
+        rows.append({"i": b["i"], "fen": b["fen"], "base_nodes": b["nodes"], "pc_nodes": p["nodes"],
+                     "delta": delta, "base_best": b["best"], "pc_best": p["best"],
+                     "base_score": b["score"], "pc_score": p["score"],
+                     "same_bestmove": b["best"] == p["best"],
+                     "same_score": b["score"] == p["score"]})
+
+    deltas = [r["delta"] for r in rows]
+    absd = [abs(d) for d in deltas]
+    sign_same = sum(1 for d in deltas if d > 0)
+    changed_move = [r for r in rows if not r["same_bestmove"]]
+    changed_score = [r for r in rows if not r["same_score"]]
+    changed_nodes = [r for r in rows if r["delta"] != 0]
+
+    out = []
+    out.append("BASE-S14 vs PC-PC20, set O, depth 12, 200 positions")
+    out.append(f"base sum {base_sum}   pc sum {pc_sum}   difference {pc_sum - base_sum}")
+    out.append("")
+    out.append("CAVEAT: the two runs differ in BOTH build and settings (base+S14 vs PC+PC20), so a")
+    out.append("per-position difference is a property of the PAIR, not of the PC's search alone.")
+    out.append("")
+    out.append(f"positions where the node count changed : {len(changed_nodes)} of {len(rows)}")
+    out.append(f"  node count increased on PC           : {sign_same}")
+    out.append(f"  node count decreased on PC           : {len([d for d in deltas if d < 0])}")
+    out.append(f"  identical node count                 : {len(rows) - len(changed_nodes)}")
+    out.append(f"positions where the BESTMOVE changed   : {len(changed_move)}")
+    out.append(f"positions where the SCORE changed      : {len(changed_score)}")
+    out.append("")
+    if deltas:
+        out.append(f"delta nodes: min {min(deltas)}  median {int(statistics.median(deltas))}  "
+                   f"max {max(deltas)}  mean {statistics.mean(deltas):.1f}")
+        out.append(f"|delta| nodes: median {int(statistics.median(absd))}  "
+                   f"90th pct {sorted(absd)[int(0.9 * len(absd)) - 1]}  max {max(absd)}")
+    out.append("")
+    out.append("HOW BROAD IS IT?")
+    n_all = len(rows)
+    for label, count in [("node count changed", len(changed_nodes)),
+                         ("bestmove changed", len(changed_move)),
+                         ("score changed", len(changed_score))]:
+        out.append(f"  {label:20s} {count:3d}/{n_all} = {100.0 * count / n_all:5.1f}%")
+    out.append("")
+    out.append("Largest 15 changes by |delta| (fen, base nodes -> pc nodes, delta, bestmove change):")
+    for r in sorted(rows, key=lambda x: -abs(x["delta"]))[:15]:
+        bm = "" if r["same_bestmove"] else f"   bestmove {r['base_best']} -> {r['pc_best']}"
+        out.append(f"  {r['i']:3d} {r['fen'][:52]:54s} {r['base_nodes']:8d} -> {r['pc_nodes']:8d} "
+                   f"({r['delta']:+8d}){bm}")
+    out.append("")
+    out.append("Positions where the bestmove changed (all of them):")
+    if not changed_move:
+        out.append("  none")
+    for r in changed_move:
+        out.append(f"  {r['i']:3d} {r['fen'][:52]:54s} {r['base_best']} -> {r['pc_best']}   "
+                   f"score {r['base_score']} -> {r['pc_score']}")
+
+    text = "\n".join(out) + "\n"
+    open(os.path.join(outdir, "sum_delta.txt"), "w").write(text)
+    json.dump(rows, open(os.path.join(outdir, "sum_delta.json"), "w"), indent=1)
+    print(text)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

diff --git a/forge-combo29/swarm/07/job35/isolate_pc20.py b/forge-combo29/swarm/07/job35/isolate_pc20.py
new file mode 100644
index 000000000..dc40f2830
--- /dev/null
+++ b/forge-combo29/swarm/07/job35/isolate_pc20.py
@@ -0,0 +1,148 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""isolate_pc20.py PC_EXE FENS OUTDIR DEPTH
+
+Which PC20 option drives the difference? The four-leg attribution showed:
+
+    base + S14   9,500,069
+    PC   + S14   9,500,069   <- identical, so the patch's FORGE_FIX_* switches change nothing here
+    PC   + PC20  8,315,168   <- the whole difference needs the PC-only options
+
+So one (or more) of the six PC20 additions does it. This runs S14 + each addition ALONE over a
+subset of positions, so the owner can see which default actually matters.
+
+The base build cannot honour these five options at all (it answers `unknown option`, verified), which
+is why the base+PC20 leg equals base+S14 trivially and is NOT evidence about the settings.
+"""
+import json
+import os
+import queue
+import re
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import threading
+
+S14 = [
+    "LmrQuietBase value 93", "LmrQuietDivisor value 205", "LmrNoisyBase value 13",
+    "LmrNoisyDivisor value 333", "LmrHistoryDivisor value 5643", "NullMoveBase value 5",
+    "LmpBase value 8", "HistoryPruneMultiplier value 2220",
+    "HistoryBonusQuadratic value 24", "HistoryBonusLinear value 54",
+    "HistoryBonusMax value 2212", "SingularDepth value 6", "IirDepth value 2",
+    "NonPawnCorrection value true",
+]
+ADDITIONS = [
+    ("CuckooRep", ["CuckooRep value true"]),
+    ("HistRework2", ["HistRework value 2"]),
+    ("HistRework3", ["HistRework value 3"]),
+    ("TtPruneV2", ["TtPruneV2 value true"]),
+    ("CorrHistV2", ["CorrHistV2 value true"]),
+    ("MateAlphaGuard", ["MateAlphaGuard value true"]),
+    ("OwnBookOff", ["OwnBook value false"]),
+]
+
+
+class Reader:
+    def __init__(s, st):
+        s.q = queue.Queue()
+        threading.Thread(target=s._pump, args=(st,), daemon=True).start()
+
+    def _pump(s, st):
+        for l in st:
+            s.q.put(l)
+        s.q.put(None)
+
+    def get(s, t=300):
+        try:
+            return s.q.get(timeout=t)
+        except queue.Empty:
+            return None
+
+
+def go_once(exe, options, fen, depth):
+    p = subprocess.Popen([exe], stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
+                         stderr=subprocess.PIPE, text=True, bufsize=1)
+    r = Reader(p.stdout)
+
+    def send(c):
+        p.stdin.write(c + "\n")
+        p.stdin.flush()
+
+    def drain(tag):
+        while True:
+            l = r.get()
+            if l is None:
+                raise RuntimeError(f"no readyok after {tag}")
+            if l.strip() == "readyok":
+                return
+
+    send("uci")
+    while True:
+        l = r.get(60)
+        if l is None or l.strip() == "uciok":
+            break
+    for opt in ["Hash value 16", "Threads value 1"] + options:
+        send("setoption name " + opt); send("isready"); drain(opt)
+    send("ucinewgame"); send("isready"); drain("ucinewgame")
+    send("position fen " + fen); send("isready"); drain("position")
+    send(f"go depth {depth}")
+    nodes, best = None, None
+    while True:
+        l = r.get(600)
+        if l is None:
+            raise RuntimeError(f"no bestmove for {fen}")
+        if l.startswith(f"info depth {depth}") and " nodes " in l:
+            m = re.search(r" nodes (\d+) ", l)
+            if m:
+                nodes = int(m.group(1))
+        if l.startswith("bestmove"):
+            best = l.split()[1]
+            break
+    send("quit")
+    try: p.wait(timeout=30)
+    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired: p.kill()
+    if nodes is None:
+        raise SystemExit(f"FAIL no nodes for {fen}")
+    return nodes, best
+
+
+def sum_for(exe, options, fens, depth):
+    total = 0
+    for fen in fens:
+        n, _ = go_once(exe, options, fen, depth)
+        total += n
+    return total
+
+
+def main():
+    exe, fens_path, outdir, depth = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2], sys.argv[3], int(sys.argv[4])
+    limit = int(sys.argv[5]) if len(sys.argv) > 5 else 40
+    os.makedirs(outdir, exist_ok=True)
+    fens = [l.strip() for l in open(fens_path) if l.strip()][:limit]
+    print(f"positions {len(fens)}, depth {depth}, PC build, Threads 1, Hash 16", flush=True)
+
+    base_s14 = sum_for(exe, S14, fens, depth)
+    print(f"S14 alone                      sum {base_s14}", flush=True)
+    rows = [{"config": "S14", "sum": base_s14, "delta": 0}]
+    for name, opt in ADDITIONS:
+        s = sum_for(exe, S14 + opt, fens, depth)
+        d = s - base_s14
+        rows.append({"config": "S14+" + name, "sum": s, "delta": d})
+        print(f"S14 + {name:16s} sum {s:>10d}  delta {d:>+9d} "
+              f"({100.0 * d / base_s14:+.1f}%)", flush=True)
+    all_pc20 = S14 + ["CuckooRep value true", "HistRework value 2", "TtPruneV2 value true",
+                      "CorrHistV2 value true", "MateAlphaGuard value true", "OwnBook value false"]
+    s = sum_for(exe, all_pc20, fens, depth)
+    rows.append({"config": "S14+all PC20", "sum": s, "delta": s - base_s14})
+    print(f"S14 + all six (PC20)           sum {s:>10d}  delta {s - base_s14:>+9d} "
+          f"({100.0 * (s - base_s14) / base_s14:+.1f}%)", flush=True)
+    json.dump({"positions": len(fens), "depth": depth, "rows": rows},
+              open(os.path.join(outdir, "isolate.json"), "w"), indent=1)
+    print()
+    ranked = sorted([r for r in rows if r["config"] != "S14"],
+                    key=lambda r: -abs(r["delta"]))
+    print("largest single-option effects, in order:")
+    for r in ranked[:5]:
+        print(f"  {r['config']:20s} delta {r['delta']:+9d}")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

diff --git a/forge-combo29/swarm/07/job36/diff100.py b/forge-combo29/swarm/07/job36/diff100.py
new file mode 100644
index 000000000..80e9600c1
--- /dev/null
+++ b/forge-combo29/swarm/07/job36/diff100.py
@@ -0,0 +1,172 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""diff100.py BASE_EXE PC_EXE FENS OUTDIR DEPTH
+
+The 100-case differential: for each position, run the same search on base and on the PC build under
+IDENTICAL settings, then for every position where the answer differs, isolate which FORGE_FIX_* switch
+is responsible by testing scratch builds with each switch alone.
+
+Settings: Threads 1, Hash 16, OwnBook false, ucinewgame + isready before the go, fresh process per
+run. No S14/PC20 options here on purpose -- this compares the BUILDS, so the settings must be equal
+and minimal.
+
+Stage 1  base vs PC under identical settings -> list of differing positions.
+Stage 2  for each differing position, and for whichever switches the caller supplies as scratch
+         builds, re-run that one position and record which build reproduces the PC answer.
+
+Isolation builds are passed as `--variant NAME=PATH` and must have been built from the PC tree with
+exactly one switch changed; the caller is responsible for that (see job33 for the recipe), and this
+script records the mapping so the report can name the switch per difference.
+"""
+import json
+import os
+import queue
+import re
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import threading
+
+
+class Reader:
+    def __init__(s, st):
+        s.q = queue.Queue()
+        threading.Thread(target=s._pump, args=(st,), daemon=True).start()
+
+    def _pump(s, st):
+        for l in st:
+            s.q.put(l)
+        s.q.put(None)
+
+    def get(s, t=300):
+        try:
+            return s.q.get(timeout=t)
+        except queue.Empty:
+            return None
+
+
+def run_one(exe, fen, depth):
+    p = subprocess.Popen([exe], stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
+                         stderr=subprocess.PIPE, text=True, bufsize=1)
+    r = Reader(p.stdout)
+
+    def send(c):
+        p.stdin.write(c + "\n")
+        p.stdin.flush()
+
+    def drain():
+        while True:
+            l = r.get()
+            if l is None:
+                raise RuntimeError("no readyok")
+            if l.strip() == "readyok":
+                return
+
+    send("uci")
+    while True:
+        l = r.get(60)
+        if l is None or l.strip() == "uciok":
+            break
+    for opt in ["Hash value 16", "Threads value 1", "OwnBook value false"]:
+        send("setoption name " + opt); send("isready"); drain()
+    send("ucinewgame"); send("isready"); drain()
+    send("position fen " + fen); send("isready"); drain()
+    send(f"go depth {depth}")
+    nodes, score, best, dlines = None, None, None, 0
+    while True:
+        l = r.get(600)
+        if l is None:
+            best = "ABSENT"
+            break
+        if l.startswith("info depth"):
+            dlines += 1
+            m = re.search(r" nodes (\d+) ", l + " ")
+            if m:
+                nodes = int(m.group(1))
+            m = re.search(r"score (cp|mate) (-?\d+)", l)
+            if m:
+                score = f"{m.group(1)} {m.group(2)}"
+        if l.startswith("bestmove"):
+            best = l.split()[1]
+            break
+    send("quit")
+    try: p.wait(timeout=30)
+    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired: p.kill()
+    return {"nodes": nodes, "score": score, "best": best, "depth_lines": dlines}
+
+
+def main():
+    args = sys.argv[1:]
+    variants = []
+    positional = []
+    i = 0
+    while i < len(args):
+        if args[i] == "--variant":
+            name, path = args[i + 1].split("=", 1)
+            variants.append((name, path))
+            i += 2
+        else:
+            positional.append(args[i]); i += 1
+    base_exe, pc_exe, fens_path, outdir, depth = (positional[0], positional[1], positional[2],
+                                                  positional[3], int(positional[4]))
+    os.makedirs(outdir, exist_ok=True)
+    fens = [l.strip() for l in open(fens_path) if l.strip()]
+    print(f"positions {len(fens)}, depth {depth}, Threads 1, Hash 16, OwnBook false")
+    print(f"isolation variants supplied: {[v[0] for v in variants]}")
+
+    stage1 = []
+    for idx, fen in enumerate(fens):
+        b = run_one(base_exe, fen, depth)
+        p = run_one(pc_exe, fen, depth)
+        same = (b["nodes"] == p["nodes"] and b["score"] == p["score"] and b["best"] == p["best"])
+        rec = {"i": idx, "fen": fen, "base": b, "pc": p, "differs": not same}
+        stage1.append(rec)
+        if not same:
+            print(f"  DIFF {idx:3d} base {b['best']}/{b['score']}/{b['nodes']}  "
+                  f"pc {p['best']}/{p['score']}/{p['nodes']}", flush=True)
+        if (idx + 1) % 25 == 0:
+            n = sum(1 for r in stage1 if r["differs"])
+            print(f"  ...{idx+1}/{len(fens)}  differences so far {n}", flush=True)
+
+    differing = [r for r in stage1 if r["differs"]]
+    print(f"\nstage 1: {len(differing)} of {len(fens)} positions differ "
+          f"({100.0 * len(differing) / len(fens):.1f}%)")
+
+    # stage 2: isolate, per differing position, which variant reproduces the PC answer
+    if variants and differing:
+        print("\nstage 2: isolating the responsible switch per differing position")
+        for rec in differing:
+            rec["isolation"] = {}
+            for name, path in variants:
+                v = run_one(path, rec["fen"], depth)
+                rec["isolation"][name] = v
+                if (v["best"] == rec["pc"]["best"] and v["nodes"] == rec["pc"]["nodes"]):
+                    print(f"  {rec['i']:3d} switch {name} reproduces the PC answer exactly",
+                          flush=True)
+            # name the single switch that matches, when exactly one does
+            matches = [n for n, v in rec["isolation"].items()
+                       if v["best"] == rec["pc"]["best"] and v["nodes"] == rec["pc"]["nodes"]]
+            rec["responsible"] = matches if matches else ["NONE/COMBINATION"]
+
+    json.dump({"positions": len(fens), "depth": depth,
+               "variants": [v[0] for v in variants], "rows": stage1},
+              open(os.path.join(outdir, "diff100.json"), "w"), indent=1)
+
+    print("\n=== SUMMARY ===")
+    print(f"positions differing: {len(differing)} / {len(fens)}")
+    if variants:
+        tally = {}
+        for rec in differing:
+            for name in rec.get("responsible", ["?"]):
+                tally[name] = tally.get(name, 0) + 1
+        print("responsible switch, counted over differing positions:")
+        for name, n in sorted(tally.items(), key=lambda kv: -kv[1]):
+            print(f"  {name:34s} {n}")
+    # any illegal or absent answer is a fault worth naming
+    bad = [(r["i"], "base", r["base"]["best"]) for r in stage1
+           if r["base"]["best"] in (None, "ABSENT")]
+    bad += [(r["i"], "pc", r["pc"]["best"]) for r in stage1
+            if r["pc"]["best"] in (None, "ABSENT")]
+    print(f"absent answers: {bad if bad else 'none'}")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

diff --git a/forge-combo29/swarm/07/job37/build_samples.py b/forge-combo29/swarm/07/job37/build_samples.py
new file mode 100644
index 000000000..aa4e984d1
--- /dev/null
+++ b/forge-combo29/swarm/07/job37/build_samples.py
@@ -0,0 +1,268 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""build_samples.py G_EPD OUTDIR
+
+Builds the two samples the coordinator asked for, and says which switch each position is meant to
+exercise. Classification is done with python-chess, independently of the engine.
+
+SAMPLE 1 -- "targeted" (100 positions): the states the four FORGE_FIX_* switches are FOR.
+  a) drawn roots (FORGE_FIX_ROOT_DRAWN): positions where the root is a THIRD repetition, built by
+     playing a legal move list so the same position occurs three times, and separately positions with
+     the halfmove counter at or past 100.
+  b) bare-king endings (FORGE_FIX_BARE_KING_LMR_CAP, _ONE_THREAD): one side is a lone king; built by
+     stripping material from real game positions rather than inventing boards.
+  c) late endgames from G: few pieces, both sides still with material, and a real 50-move counter
+     carried over from the game position.
+
+SAMPLE 2 -- "ordinary" (100 positions): middlegames from set G with plenty of material, i.e. the
+control sample where the switches should NOT fire. Together the two tell the owner where the patch acts.
+
+Every position is written with a tag naming the switch it targets, so the differential can report the
+switch per difference instead of guessing.
+"""
+import json
+import os
+import random
+import sys
+
+import chess
+
+random.seed(701)
+
+
+def load_g(path):
+    out = []
+    for line in open(path, encoding="utf-8"):
+        parts = line.split()
+        if len(parts) >= 4:
+            fen = " ".join(parts[:6]) if len(parts) >= 6 else " ".join(parts[:4]) + " 0 1"
+            try:
+                b = chess.Board(fen)
+            except ValueError:
+                continue
+            out.append(b.fen())
+    return out
+
+
+def material(b):
+    v = {chess.PAWN: 1, chess.KNIGHT: 3, chess.BISHOP: 3, chess.ROOK: 5, chess.QUEEN: 9,
+         chess.KING: 0}
+    return sum(v[p.piece_type] for p in b.piece_map().values())
+
+
+def bare_king_side(b):
+    wk = b.king(chess.WHITE) is not None
+    bk = b.king(chess.BLACK) is not None
+    if not (wk and bk):
+        return None
+    w_other = [p for s, p in b.piece_map().items() if p.color == chess.WHITE and p.piece_type != chess.KING]
+    b_other = [p for s, p in b.piece_map().items() if p.color == chess.BLACK and p.piece_type != chess.KING]
+    if not w_other and b_other:
+        return "black_has_material"
+    if not b_other and w_other:
+        return "white_has_material"
+    return None
+
+
+def strip_to_bare_king(b, keep_color):
+    """Leave `keep_color` with a modest force and the other side with a lone king.
+    Deterministic: keeps the nearest pieces to the enemy king, which keeps the result plausible."""
+    out = chess.Board(None)
+    for color in (chess.WHITE, chess.BLACK):
+        ksq = b.king(color)
+        if ksq is None:
+            return None
+        out.set_piece_at(ksq, chess.Piece(chess.KING, color))
+    if keep_color == chess.WHITE:
+        loser = chess.BLACK
+    else:
+        loser = chess.WHITE
+    lk = b.king(loser)
+    if lk is None:
+        return None
+    cands = [(s, p) for s, p in b.piece_map().items()
+             if p.color == keep_color and p.piece_type != chess.KING]
+    cands.sort(key=lambda sp: chess.square_distance(sp[0], lk))
+    added = 0
+    for s, p in cands:
+        # skip pawns on the first/last rank, which the engine rightly refuses
+        if p.piece_type == chess.PAWN and chess.square_rank(s) in (0, 7):
+            continue
+        out.set_piece_at(s, p)
+        added += 1
+        if added >= 3:
+            break
+    if added == 0:
+        return None
+    out.turn = b.turn
+    out.castling_rights = 0
+    out.ep_square = None
+    out.halfmove_clock = 0
+    out.fullmove_number = 1
+    if not out.is_valid():
+        return None
+    # the side that is not to move must not be in check from the side to move
+    if out.is_valid():
+        return out
+    return None
+
+
+def make_threefold(start_fen):
+    """Play a legal knight shuffle from `start_fen` until the SAME position occurs three times.
+    Returns the move list, or None. Deterministic: tries each legal move in order at each ply."""
+    base = chess.Board(start_fen)
+    # find a shuffle the position allows: any two moves that return to the start
+    moves = list(base.legal_moves)
+    shuffles = []
+    for m1 in moves:
+        b1 = base.copy(); b1.push(m1)
+        for m2 in b1.legal_moves:
+            b2 = b1.copy(); b2.push(m2)
+            # same placement AND same side to move => the pair returns to the start position
+            if b2.board_fen() == base.board_fen() and b2.turn == base.turn:
+                shuffles.append((m1, m2))
+        if len(shuffles) >= 4:
+            break
+    if not shuffles:
+        return None
+    # Verify the pair really is replayable twice from the start; a pair that works only on the
+    # first trip is useless (my first version asserted and crashed on exactly that).
+    for m1, m2 in shuffles:
+        b = base.copy()
+        seq = []
+        ok = True
+        for _ in range(2):        # two round trips => the start position occurs three times
+            for m in (m1, m2):
+                if m not in b.legal_moves:
+                    ok = False
+                    break
+                b.push(m)
+                seq.append(m.uci())
+            if not ok:
+                break
+        if ok and b.is_repetition(3):
+            return seq, b
+    return None
+
+
+def main():
+    g_path, outdir = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
+    os.makedirs(outdir, exist_ok=True)
+    g_fens = load_g(g_path)
+    print(f"set G positions loaded: {len(g_fens)}")
+    boards = []
+    for f in g_fens:
+        try:
+            boards.append(chess.Board(f))
+        except ValueError:
+            pass
+
+    targeted, ordinary = [], []
+
+    # ---------- SAMPLE 2: ordinary middlegames from G ----------
+    rich = [b for b in boards if material(b) >= 26 and bare_king_side(b) is None]
+    print(f"G positions with material >= 26 and no bare king: {len(rich)}")
+    random.shuffle(rich)
+    for b in rich[:100]:
+        ordinary.append({"fen": b.fen(), "tag": "ordinary_middlegame", "material": material(b)})
+
+    # ---------- SAMPLE 1a: drawn roots by third repetition ----------
+    # Set G's middlegame positions rarely admit a returning move pair (the pieces have work to do),
+    # so I also try the QUIET endgames and a few hand-built king-and-piece positions. A position with
+    # a returning pair is what is needed, not a specific FEN, so the sample is built by finding pairs.
+    pool = [b for b in boards if not b.is_game_over()]
+    random.shuffle(pool)
+    quiet = [b for b in boards
+             if material(b) <= 14 and b.king(chess.WHITE) is not None and b.king(chess.BLACK) is not None]
+    random.shuffle(quiet)
+    candidates = quiet[:120] + pool[:120]
+    for b in candidates:
+        if len([t for t in targeted if t["tag"].startswith("drawn_repetition")]) >= 25:
+            break
+        r = make_threefold(b.fen())
+        if r is None:
+            continue
+        seq, end = r
+        targeted.append({"fen": end.fen(), "tag": "drawn_repetition_third",
+                         "moves": seq, "note": "root is a third repetition"})
+    # if the real positions still yield none, say so loudly rather than leave the class empty
+    n_rep = len([t for t in targeted if t["tag"].startswith("drawn_repetition")])
+    print(f"repetition positions built from real material: {n_rep}")
+    if n_rep == 0:
+        print("WARNING: no threefold could be built from set G; the ROOT_DRAWN class will be empty.")
+        print("         That is a REAL limitation of this sample and is reported as such.")
+
+    # ---------- SAMPLE 1b: fifty-move counter at/past 100 ----------
+    for b in pool:
+        if len([t for t in targeted if t["tag"].startswith("fifty_move")]) >= 20:
+            break
+        c = b.copy()
+        # only legal if no pawn/capture in the history; a bare FEN with a high clock is accepted
+        # by this engine (it caps the stored clock at 65535), so build it directly
+        f = c.fen().split()
+        f[4] = "100"
+        try:
+            nb = chess.Board(" ".join(f))
+        except ValueError:
+            continue
+        if nb.is_valid():
+            targeted.append({"fen": nb.fen(), "tag": "fifty_move_100",
+                             "note": "halfmove counter exactly 100 at the root"})
+
+    # ---------- SAMPLE 1c: bare-king endings from G, stripped ----------
+    for b in boards:
+        if len([t for t in targeted if t["tag"].startswith("bare_king")]) >= 30:
+            break
+        for keep in (chess.WHITE, chess.BLACK):
+            nb = strip_to_bare_king(b, keep)
+            if nb is None:
+                continue
+            side = bare_king_side(nb)
+            if side is None:
+                continue
+            targeted.append({"fen": nb.fen(), "tag": "bare_king_" + side,
+                             "note": "one side has a lone king (FORGE_FIX_BARE_KING_*)"})
+            break
+
+    # ---------- SAMPLE 1d: late endgames from G (few pieces, both sides with material) ----------
+    late = [b for b in boards
+            if 3 <= material(b) <= 14 and bare_king_side(b) is None
+            and b.king(chess.WHITE) is not None and b.king(chess.BLACK) is not None]
+    random.shuffle(late)
+    for b in late:
+        if len(targeted) >= 100:
+            break
+        targeted.append({"fen": b.fen(), "tag": "late_endgame", "material": material(b)})
+
+    # top up if short
+    if len(targeted) < 100:
+        for b in rich:
+            if len(targeted) >= 100:
+                break
+            if any(t["fen"] == b.fen() for t in targeted):
+                continue
+            targeted.append({"fen": b.fen(), "tag": "late_endgame_topup", "material": material(b)})
+
+    targeted = targeted[:100]
+    ordinary = ordinary[:100]
+
+    with open(os.path.join(outdir, "targeted100.txt"), "w") as fh:
+        for t in targeted:
+            fh.write(t["fen"] + "\n")
+    with open(os.path.join(outdir, "ordinary100.txt"), "w") as fh:
+        for t in ordinary:
+            fh.write(t["fen"] + "\n")
+    json.dump({"targeted": targeted, "ordinary": ordinary},
+              open(os.path.join(outdir, "samples.json"), "w"), indent=1)
+
+    from collections import Counter
+    print()
+    print(f"targeted sample: {len(targeted)} positions")
+    for tag, n in sorted(Counter(t['tag'] for t in targeted).items()):
+        print(f"  {tag:28s} {n}")

+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":

diff --git a/forge-combo29/swarm/07/job38/bareking_worse.py b/forge-combo29/swarm/07/job38/bareking_worse.py
new file mode 100644
index 000000000..77e6495d3
--- /dev/null
+++ b/forge-combo29/swarm/07/job38/bareking_worse.py
@@ -0,0 +1,177 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""bareking_worse.py OUTDIR
+
+Item 2: of the 30 bare-king positions where the PC build differs from base, is the PC's answer ever
+WORSE rather than merely different?
+
+Seat reporting: another seat found one bare-king position where the cap picks a mate in 10 over a mate
+in 8. That would be a regression introduced by FORGE_FIX_BARE_KING_LMR_CAP. This scans my 30 for the
+same shape.
+
+Method. "Worse" is decided by comparing the two builds' scores from the SAME side's point of view
+at the same depth, and separately by a deeper reference so that a shallow search cannot mislabel a
+deliberate trade:
+
+  1. both builds at depth 12 -> compare scores.
+  2. a deeper probe (depth 18) on the PC build -> the reference the shallow answers are judged against.
+  3. a mate-distance comparison where both report mate: fewer plies is better.
+
+A difference is called PC-WORSE only when the PC score is worse than base by a decisive margin
+(>= 100 cp, or a mate distance that is genuinely longer), AND the depth-18 reference does not vindicate
+the PC's choice. Anything in the noise band is called NEUTRAL, not worse.
+
+The distinction matters: most of the 30 differ because base answered `cp 0` with 0 nodes (a drawn-root
+artefact) and the PC actually searched; a base `cp 0` is not "better" than a PC `cp -120`.
+"""
+import json
+import os
+import queue
+import re
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import threading
+
+BASE = "/agent/repos/base/forge-combo29/build-rel/forge"
+PC = "/agent/repos/pcbase/forge-combo29/build-pc/forge"
+BARE_VARIANT = "/tmp/var_BARE_KING_LMR_CAP/build-pc/forge"
+
+NOISE = 50          # |cp| inside this is not a difference in substance
+DECISIVE = 100      # a PC score this much worse is a candidate regression
+
+
+class Reader:
+    def __init__(s, st):
+        s.q = queue.Queue()
+        threading.Thread(target=s._pump, args=(st,), daemon=True).start()
+
+    def _pump(s, st):
+        for l in st:
+            s.q.put(l)
+        s.q.put(None)
+
+    def get(s, t=300):
+        try:
+            return s.q.get(timeout=t)
+        except queue.Empty:
+            return None
+
+
+def search(exe, fen, depth):
+    p = subprocess.Popen([exe], stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
+                         stderr=subprocess.PIPE, text=True, bufsize=1)
+    r = Reader(p.stdout)
+
+    def send(c):
+        p.stdin.write(c + "\n")
+        p.stdin.flush()
+
+    def drain():
+        while True:
+            l = r.get()
+            if l is None:
+                raise RuntimeError("no readyok")
+            if l.strip() == "readyok":
+                return
+
+    send("uci")
+    while True:
+        l = r.get(60)
+        if l is None or l.strip() == "uciok":
+            break
+    for o in ["Hash value 16", "Threads value 1", "OwnBook value false"]:
+        send("setoption name " + o); send("isready"); drain()
+    send("ucinewgame"); send("isready"); drain()
+    send("position fen " + fen); send("isready"); drain()
+    send(f"go depth {depth}")
+    nodes, score, best = None, None, None
+    while True:
+        l = r.get(900)
+        if l is None:
+            best = "ABSENT"
+            break
+        if l.startswith("info depth") and " nodes " in l:
+            m = re.search(r" nodes (\d+) ", l)
+            if m:
+                nodes = int(m.group(1))
+            m = re.search(r"score (cp|mate) (-?\d+)", l)
+            if m:
+                score = (m.group(1), int(m.group(2)))
+        if l.startswith("bestmove"):
+            best = l.split()[1]
+            break
+    send("quit")
+    try: p.wait(timeout=30)
+    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired: p.kill()
+    return {"nodes": nodes, "score": score, "best": best}
+
+
+def cp_of(sc):
+    """Centipawn value of a score, with mate mapped to a large sentinel of the right sign."""
+    if sc is None:
+        return None
+    kind, val = sc
+    if kind == "cp":
+        return val
+    # mate N: side to move mates in N -> huge positive; mate -N -> huge negative
+    return 100000 - abs(val) if val > 0 else -(100000 - abs(val))
+
+
+def main():
+    outdir = sys.argv[1]
+    os.makedirs(outdir, exist_ok=True)
+    samples = json.load(open("../job37/raw/samples.json"))
+    bk = [t for t in samples["targeted"] if t["tag"].startswith("bare_king")]
+    print(f"bare-king positions: {len(bk)}")
+    print(f"{'#':>2} {'base d12':>14} {'pc d12':>14} {'pc d18 ref':>14} {'variant d12':>14} verdict")
+    rows = []
+    for i, t in enumerate(bk):
+        fen = t["fen"]
+        b = search(BASE, fen, 12)
+        p = search(PC, fen, 12)
+        ref = search(PC, fen, 18)
+        var = search(BARE_VARIANT, fen, 12)
+        bc, pc_, rc = cp_of(b["score"]), cp_of(p["score"]), cp_of(ref["score"])
+        verdict = "NEUTRAL"
+        if bc is None or pc_ is None:
+            verdict = "UNSCORED"
+        elif bc == 0 and b["nodes"] == 0:
+            # base answered without searching; it has no claim to be "better"
+            verdict = "base was a 0-node draw artefact, not a real score"
+        elif abs(bc - pc_) <= NOISE:
+            verdict = "NEUTRAL (within noise)"
+        elif pc_ < bc - DECISIVE:
+            # candidate regression: check the reference
+            if rc is not None and abs(rc - pc_) < abs(rc - bc):
+                verdict = "PC-WORSE than base at depth 12, but depth-18 supports PC"
+            else:
+                verdict = "PC-WORSE: candidate regression"
+        elif pc_ > bc + DECISIVE:
+            verdict = "PC-BETTER"
+        else:
+            verdict = "differs, below the decisive margin"
+        rows.append({"i": i, "fen": fen, "base": b, "pc": p, "ref18": ref, "variant": var,
+                     "verdict": verdict})
+        print(f"{i:>2} {str(b['score']):>14} {str(p['score']):>14} {str(ref['score']):>14} "
+              f"{str(var['score']):>14} {verdict}", flush=True)
+
+    import collections
+    c = collections.Counter(r["verdict"] for r in rows)
+    print()
+    print("verdict counts:")
+    for k, n in sorted(c.items(), key=lambda kv: -kv[1]):
+        print(f"  {k:52s} {n}")
+    worse = [r for r in rows if r["verdict"].startswith("PC-WORSE")]
+    print()
+    if worse:
+        print("POSITIONS WHERE THE PC ANSWER LOOKS WORSE — inspect these:")
+        for r in worse:
+            print(f"  #{r['i']} {r['fen']}")
+            print(f"     base {r['base']['score']}/{r['base']['nodes']}   "
+                  f"pc {r['pc']['score']}/{r['pc']['nodes']}   ref18 {r['ref18']['score']}")
+    else:
+        print("No position where the PC answer is worse than base's by a decisive margin.")
+    json.dump(rows, open(os.path.join(outdir, "bareking_worse.json"), "w"), indent=1)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
diff --git a/forge-combo29/swarm/07/job38/fifty_rate.py b/forge-combo29/swarm/07/job38/fifty_rate.py
new file mode 100644
index 000000000..fd49e17d1
--- /dev/null
+++ b/forge-combo29/swarm/07/job38/fifty_rate.py
@@ -0,0 +1,178 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""fifty_rate.py OUTDIR
+
+Turns 07-F3's single detailed case into a RATE, which is the number that says what FORGE_FIX_ROOT_DRAWN
+is worth.
+
+For each of the 20 fifty-move-counter-100 positions in the targeted sample:
+
+  1. Is a counter-RESETTING move available?  A move that resets the halfmove clock is a capture or a
+     pawn move (FIDE 9.3 / the fifty-move rule). python-chess decides this, not the engine.
+  2. What does the BASE build answer, and what does the PC build answer?  (read from the differential
+     already recorded, plus a fresh run so the pairing is certain)
+  3. Is the base's `cp 0` actually a DRAW claim, and is it WRONG?
+
+The "is it wrong" test follows file 6 but with the correction 07-F3 established: file 6's inequality
+(2N-1 <= 100-counter) is only valid when the fifty-move draw CANNOT be reset. So:
+
+  * if a resetting move exists and the side to move is winning (evaluable by asking a deep search on the
+    SAME board with counter 0, which cannot be a fifty-move draw),
+    then a base answer of `cp 0` is a WRONG draw declaration;
+  * if no resetting move exists, the position really is drawn and base's `cp 0` is right.
+
+The counter-0 probe is the independent referee: with the clock reset the fifty-move rule is out of the
+way for 100 half-moves, so a mate or a winning score there means a win existed at the root.
+"""
+import json
+import os
+import queue
+import re
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import threading
+
+import chess
+
+BASE = "/agent/repos/base/forge-combo29/build-rel/forge"
+PC = "/agent/repos/pcbase/forge-combo29/build-pc/forge"
+
+
+class Reader:
+    def __init__(s, st):
+        s.q = queue.Queue()
+        threading.Thread(target=s._pump, args=(st,), daemon=True).start()
+
+    def _pump(s, st):
+        for l in st:
+            s.q.put(l)
+        s.q.put(None)
+
+    def get(s, t=300):
+        try:
+            return s.q.get(timeout=t)
+        except queue.Empty:
+            return None
+
+
+def search(exe, fen, depth=12):
+    p = subprocess.Popen([exe], stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
+                         stderr=subprocess.PIPE, text=True, bufsize=1)
+    r = Reader(p.stdout)
+
+    def send(c):
+        p.stdin.write(c + "\n")
+        p.stdin.flush()
+
+    def drain():
+        while True:
+            l = r.get()
+            if l is None:
+                raise RuntimeError("no readyok")
+            if l.strip() == "readyok":
+                return
+
+    send("uci")
+    while True:
+        l = r.get(60)
+        if l is None or l.strip() == "uciok":
+            break
+    for o in ["Hash value 16", "Threads value 1", "OwnBook value false"]:
+        send("setoption name " + o); send("isready"); drain()
+    send("ucinewgame"); send("isready"); drain()
+    send("position fen " + fen); send("isready"); drain()
+    send(f"go depth {depth}")
+    nodes, score, best = None, None, None
+    while True:
+        l = r.get(600)
+        if l is None:
+            best = "ABSENT"
+            break
+        if l.startswith("info depth") and " nodes " in l:
+            m = re.search(r" nodes (\d+) ", l)
+            if m:
+                nodes = int(m.group(1))
+            m = re.search(r"score (cp|mate) (-?\d+)", l)
+            if m:
+                score = f"{m.group(1)} {m.group(2)}"
+        if l.startswith("bestmove"):
+            best = l.split()[1]
+            break
+    send("quit")
+    try: p.wait(timeout=30)
+    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired: p.kill()
+    return {"nodes": nodes, "score": score, "best": best}
+
+
+def resetting_moves(b):
+    """Moves that reset the halfmove clock: pawn moves and captures."""
+    out = []
+    for m in b.legal_moves:
+        pc = b.piece_at(m.from_square)
+        if pc is not None and pc.piece_type == chess.PAWN:
+            out.append(m.uci())
+        elif b.is_capture(m):
+            out.append(m.uci())
+    return out
+
+
+def with_counter(fen, value):
+    f = fen.split()
+    f[4] = str(value)
+    return " ".join(f)
+
+
+def main():
+    outdir = sys.argv[1]
+    os.makedirs(outdir, exist_ok=True)
+    samples = json.load(open("../job37/raw/samples.json"))
+    fif = [t for t in samples["targeted"] if t["tag"] == "fifty_move_100"]
+    rows = []
+    print(f"{'#':>2} {'resets':>7} {'base':>18} {'pc':>18} {'counter0 probe':>20} verdict")
+    for i, t in enumerate(fif):
+        fen = t["fen"]
+        b = chess.Board(fen)
+        resets = resetting_moves(b)
+        base = search(BASE, fen)
+        pc = search(PC, fen)
+        # independent referee: the same board with the clock reset
+        probe_fen = with_counter(fen, 0)
+        probe = search(BASE, probe_fen)
+        decisive = probe["score"] is not None and not probe["score"].startswith("cp 0")
+        base_draw = base["score"] == "cp 0"
+        if resets and base_draw and decisive:
+            verdict = "BASE WRONG (win exists, reset available, base claimed a draw)"
+        elif resets and base_draw and not decisive:
+            verdict = "base draw, reset available but probe finds no win"
+        elif not resets and base_draw:
+            verdict = "base draw correct (no reset available)"
+        elif base_draw and decisive:
+            verdict = "base draw but probe sees a win, no reset"
+        else:
+            verdict = "base not a draw"
+        rows.append({"i": i, "fen": fen, "resets": resets, "base": base, "pc": pc,
+                     "probe_counter0": probe, "verdict": verdict})
+        print(f"{i:>2} {len(resets):>7} {str(base['score']) + '/' + str(base['nodes']):>18} "
+              f"{str(pc['score']) + '/' + str(pc['nodes']):>18} "
+              f"{str(probe['score']) + '/' + str(probe['nodes']):>20} {verdict}", flush=True)
+
+    n = len(rows)
+    with_reset = [r for r in rows if r["resets"]]
+    wrong = [r for r in rows if r["verdict"].startswith("BASE WRONG")]
+    no_reset = [r for r in rows if not r["resets"]]
+    print()
+    print(f"fifty-move positions:                       {n}")
+    print(f"  with a counter-resetting move available:  {len(with_reset)}")
+    print(f"  with NO reset available (genuinely drawn): {len(no_reset)}")
+    print(f"  base claims a draw while a win exists:     {len(wrong)}")
+    print()
+    print("THE RATE that says what ROOT_DRAWN is worth on this sample:")
+    print(f"  {len(wrong)} of {n} fifty-move roots ({100.0 * len(wrong) / n:.0f}%) are base-tree "
+          f"errors (a draw claimed where a win exists)")
+    if with_reset:
+        print(f"  {len(wrong)} of {len(with_reset)} of the reset-available ones "
+              f"({100.0 * len(wrong) / len(with_reset):.0f}%)")
+    json.dump(rows, open(os.path.join(outdir, "fifty_rate.json"), "w"), indent=1)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

diff --git a/forge-combo29/swarm/07/job39/fifty_deep.py b/forge-combo29/swarm/07/job39/fifty_deep.py
new file mode 100644
index 000000000..9c16171cd
--- /dev/null
+++ b/forge-combo29/swarm/07/job39/fifty_deep.py
@@ -0,0 +1,169 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""fifty_deep.py OUTDIR DEPTH
+
+Closes the one gap in 07-F4: the 10 fifty-move positions that were INCONCLUSIVE at depth 12.
+
+For each of the twenty, search the counter-RESET reference (the same board with the halfmove counter set
+to 0, so the fifty-move rule is 100 half-moves away and cannot mask the result) at a DEEPER depth than
+12. The point is to see how many of the 10 inconclusive ones become decisive, which turns "6 of 20" into
+an estimate closer to the truth.
+
+Decision thresholds, fixed BEFORE the run and stated here so the result cannot be read generously after
+the fact:
+  DECISIVE-WIN   : mate for the side to move, or cp >= +300
+  DECISIVE-LOSS  : mate against, or cp <= -300
+  INCONCLUSIVE   : -299 .. +299
+A position is counted as a base error when its reset-counter reference is decisive at this depth, because
+base answered `cp 0` without searching and a decisive reference means the position was not a draw.
+
+The depth-12 numbers from 07-F4 are re-read from job38/raw/fifty_rate.json so the two runs are compared
+against identical inputs.
+"""
+import json
+import os
+import queue
+import re
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import threading
+
+BASE = "/agent/repos/base/forge-combo29/build-rel/forge"
+WIN, LOSS = 300, -300
+
+
+class Reader:
+    def __init__(s, st):
+        s.q = queue.Queue()
+        threading.Thread(target=s._pump, args=(st,), daemon=True).start()
+
+    def _pump(s, st):
+        for l in st:
+            s.q.put(l)
+        s.q.put(None)
+
+    def get(s, t=1200):
+        try:
+            return s.q.get(timeout=t)
+        except queue.Empty:
+            return None
+
+
+def search(exe, fen, depth):
+    p = subprocess.Popen([exe], stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
+                         stderr=subprocess.PIPE, text=True, bufsize=1)
+    r = Reader(p.stdout)
+
+    def send(c):
+        p.stdin.write(c + "\n")
+        p.stdin.flush()
+
+    def drain():
+        while True:
+            l = r.get()
+            if l is None:
+                raise RuntimeError("no readyok")
+            if l.strip() == "readyok":
+                return
+
+    send("uci")
+    while True:
+        l = r.get(60)
+        if l is None or l.strip() == "uciok":
+            break
+    for o in ["Hash value 16", "Threads value 1", "OwnBook value false"]:
+        send("setoption name " + o); send("isready"); drain()
+    send("ucinewgame"); send("isready"); drain()
+    send("position fen " + fen); send("isready"); drain()
+    send(f"go depth {depth}")
+    nodes, score = None, None
+    while True:
+        l = r.get(1200)
+        if l is None:
+            break
+        if l.startswith("info depth") and " nodes " in l:
+            m = re.search(r" nodes (\d+) ", l)
+            if m:
+                nodes = int(m.group(1))
+            m = re.search(r"score (cp|mate) (-?\d+)", l)
+            if m:
+                score = [m.group(1), int(m.group(2))]
+        if l.startswith("bestmove"):
+            break
+    send("quit")
+    try: p.wait(timeout=30)
+    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired: p.kill()
+    return {"nodes": nodes, "score": score}
+
+
+def classify(sc):
+    """Accepts a [kind, value] list (fresh runs) or a "cp N"/"mate N" string (the stored d12 run)."""
+    if sc is None:
+        return "NO-SCORE"
+    if isinstance(sc, str):
+        parts = sc.split()
+        if len(parts) != 2:
+            return "NO-SCORE"
+        kind, val = parts[0], int(parts[1])
+    else:
+        kind, val = sc
+    if kind == "mate":
+        return "DECISIVE-WIN" if val > 0 else "DECISIVE-LOSS"
+    if val >= WIN:
+        return "DECISIVE-WIN"
+    if val <= LOSS:
+        return "DECISIVE-LOSS"
+    return "INCONCLUSIVE"
+
+
+def with_counter(fen, v):
+    f = fen.split(); f[4] = str(v); return " ".join(f)
+
+
+def main():
+    outdir = sys.argv[1]
+    depth = int(sys.argv[2]) if len(sys.argv) > 2 else 18
+    os.makedirs(outdir, exist_ok=True)
+    prev = json.load(open("raw/fifty_rate.json"))
+    print(f"fifty-move positions: {len(prev)}, reference depth now {depth} "
+          f"(was 12), thresholds ±{WIN} cp or mate")
+    rows = []
+    print(f"{'#':>2} {'d12 probe':>12} {'d12 class':>15} {'d'+str(depth)+' probe':>14} "
+          f"{'d'+str(depth)+' class':>15} changed?")
+    for r in prev:
+        fen = r["fen"]
+        p12 = r["probe_counter0"]["score"]
+        c12 = classify(p12)
+        deep = search(BASE, with_counter(fen, 0), depth)
+        cdeep = classify(deep["score"])
+        changed = "YES" if (c12 == "INCONCLUSIVE" and cdeep.startswith("DECISIVE")) else ""
+        rows.append({"i": r["i"], "fen": fen, "probe_d12": p12, "class_d12": c12,
+                     "probe_deep": deep["score"], "class_deep": cdeep,
+                     "deep_nodes": deep["nodes"]})
+        print(f"{r['i']:>2} {str(p12):>12} {c12:>15} {str(deep['score']):>14} {cdeep:>15} {changed}",
+              flush=True)
+
+    from collections import Counter
+    c12 = Counter(x["class_d12"] for x in rows)
+    cd = Counter(x["class_deep"] for x in rows)
+    newly = [x for x in rows if x["class_d12"] == "INCONCLUSIVE"
+             and x["class_deep"].startswith("DECISIVE")]
+    print()
+    print(f"at depth 12: {dict(c12)}")
+    print(f"at depth {depth}: {dict(cd)}")
+    print()
+    print(f"of the {c12.get('INCONCLUSIVE',0)} inconclusive at depth 12, "
+          f"{len(newly)} became decisive at depth {depth}:")
+    for x in newly:
+        print(f"  #{x['i']:>2}  d12 {x['probe_d12']} -> d{depth} {x['probe_deep']}  "
+              f"({x['class_deep']})  fen {x['fen'][:56]}")
+    w = cd.get("DECISIVE-WIN", 0); l = cd.get("DECISIVE-LOSS", 0)
+    print()
+    print(f"TIGHTENED RATE at depth {depth}: decisive base error {w + l} of {len(rows)} "
+          f"({100.0 * (w + l) / len(rows):.0f}%)")
+    print(f"  of which a win thrown away ({w}) and a loss masked ({l})")
+    json.dump({"depth": depth, "rows": rows}, open(os.path.join(outdir, "fifty_deep.json"), "w"),
+              indent=1)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

diff --git a/forge-combo29/swarm/07/job4/perft_board.py b/forge-combo29/swarm/07/job4/perft_board.py
new file mode 100644
index 000000000..72053d147
--- /dev/null
+++ b/forge-combo29/swarm/07/job4/perft_board.py
@@ -0,0 +1,189 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""perft_board.py EXE OUTDIR [DEPTH]
+
+Board-level test for the area-7 job-3 read of src/board.cpp: compares `go perft N`
+with python-chess on positions chosen for the code paths that can be wrong in
+NORMAL PLAY -- castling rights, en passant (including ep that would expose the
+king), promotion and capture-promotion, and repetition-relevant pawn structure.
+
+Every comparison asserts that a `nodes <n>` line was FOUND. A missing line, a
+missing divide line, or a non-integer is a hard error: no zero, empty or NaN may
+pass as agreement (the seat-19 rule).
+
+Writes OUTDIR/<case>.json and OUTDIR/all.json; prints one row per case.
+"""
+import json
+import os
+import queue
+import re
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import threading
+
+import chess
+
+HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
+
+# (name, fen, depth)  -- depth kept small enough to finish quickly, large enough
+# that castling/ep/promotion differences would show.
+CASES = [
+    ("kiwipete_d3", "r3k2r/p1ppqpb1/bn2pnp1/3PN3/1p2P3/2N2Q1p/PPPBBPPP/R3K2R w KQkq - 0 1", 3),
+    ("kiwipete_d4", "r3k2r/p1ppqpb1/bn2pnp1/3PN3/1p2P3/2N2Q1p/PPPBBPPP/R3K2R w KQkq - 0 1", 4),
+    ("pos3_d4", "8/2p5/3p4/KP5r/1R3p1k/8/4P1P1/8 w - - 0 1", 4),
+    ("pos3_d5", "8/2p5/3p4/KP5r/1R3p1k/8/4P1P1/8 w - - 0 1", 5),
+    ("pos4_d3", "r3k2r/Pppp1ppp/1b3nbN/nP6/BBP1P3/q4N2/Pp1P2PP/R2Q1RK1 w kq - 0 1", 3),
+    ("pos4_d4", "r3k2r/Pppp1ppp/1b3nbN/nP6/BBP1P3/q4N2/Pp1P2PP/R2Q1RK1 w kq - 0 1", 4),
+    ("pos5_d3", "rnbq1k1r/pp1Pbppp/2p5/8/2B5/8/PPP1NnPP/RNBQK2R w KQ - 1 8", 3),
+    ("pos6_d3", "r4rk1/1pp1qppp/p1np1n2/2b1p1B1/2B1P1b1/P1NP1N2/1PP1QPPP/R4RK1 w - - 0 10", 3),
+    # en passant that would expose the king along the rank (the classic trap)
+    ("ep_pin_d4", "8/8/8/KPp4r/8/8/8/7k w - c6 0 1", 4),
+    ("ep_discovered_d3", "8/8/8/2k5/3Pp3/8/8/4K3 b - d3 0 1", 3),
+    # promotion and capture-promotion, incl. promotion with check
+    ("promo_d4", "rn2k2r/1P4P1/8/8/8/8/1p4p1/RN2K2R w KQkq - 0 1", 4),
+    ("promo_check_d3", "3r2k1/1P6/8/8/8/8/6p1/3R2K1 w - - 0 1", 4),
+    # castling rights lost by rook capture / rook move
+    ("castle_rights_d4", "r3k2r/8/8/8/8/8/8/R3K2R w KQkq - 0 1", 4),
+    ("castle_blocked_d3", "r3k2r/8/8/8/8/8/8/R3K1NR w KQkq - 0 1", 4),
+]
+
+NODES = re.compile(r"^nodes (\d+)$")
+
+
+class Reader:
+    def __init__(self, stream):
+        self.q = queue.Queue()
+        threading.Thread(target=self._pump, args=(stream,), daemon=True).start()
+
+    def _pump(self, stream):
+        for line in stream:
+            self.q.put(line)
+        self.q.put(None)
+
+    def readline(self, deadline_timeout=120.0):
+        try:
+            return self.q.get(timeout=deadline_timeout)
+        except queue.Empty:
+            return None
+
+
+def run_case(exe, name, fen, depth):
+    proc = subprocess.Popen([exe], stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
+                            stderr=subprocess.PIPE, text=True, bufsize=1)
+    reader = Reader(proc.stdout)
+
+    def send(cmd):
+        proc.stdin.write(cmd + "\n")
+        proc.stdin.flush()
+
+    def drain():
+        while True:
+            line = reader.readline()
+            if line is None:
+                raise RuntimeError(f"{name}: engine stopped before readyok")
+            if line.strip() == "readyok":
+                return
+
+    send("uci")
+    while True:
+        line = reader.readline()
+        if line is None or line.strip() == "uciok":
+            break
+    send("setoption name Hash value 16")
+    send("isready")
+    drain()
+    send("position fen " + fen)
+    send("isready")
+    drain()
+    send(f"go perft {depth}")
+    total = None
+    divide = {}
+    while True:
+        line = reader.readline(300.0)
+        if line is None:
+            raise RuntimeError(f"{name}: no output while waiting for perft nodes")
+        s = line.rstrip("\n")
+        m = NODES.match(s)
+        if m:
+            total = int(m.group(1))
+            break
+        if ":" in s:
+            left, right = s.split(":", 1)
+            left, right = left.strip(), right.strip()
+            if right.isdigit():
+                divide[left] = int(right)
+    send("quit")
+    try:
+        proc.wait(timeout=30)
+    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
+        proc.kill()
+    err = proc.stderr.read() if proc.stderr else ""
+    if total is None:
+        raise SystemExit(f"FAIL {name}: no 'nodes <n>' line was found. "
+                         f"Refusing to compare -- nothing was measured.")
+    return {"case": name, "fen": fen, "depth": depth, "engine_nodes": total,
+            "engine_divide": divide, "stderr": err}
+
+
+def main():
+    exe, outdir = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
+    os.makedirs(outdir, exist_ok=True)
+    rows, problems = [], []
+    for name, fen, depth in CASES:
+        rec = run_case(exe, name, fen, depth)
+        board = chess.Board(fen)
+        # python-chess reference, perft and per-move divide
+        ref_total = 0
+        ref_divide = {}
+        for move in board.legal_moves:
+            board.push(move)
+            n = perft(board, depth - 1)
+            board.pop()
+            ref_divide[move.uci()] = n
+            ref_total += n
+        rec["ref_nodes"] = ref_total
+        rec["ref_divide"] = ref_divide
+        rec["equal"] = (rec["engine_nodes"] == ref_total)
+        diffs = []
+        for move_uci in sorted(set(rec["engine_divide"]) | set(ref_divide)):
+            a = rec["engine_divide"].get(move_uci)
+            b = ref_divide.get(move_uci)
+            if a != b:
+                diffs.append({"move": move_uci, "engine": a, "python_chess": b})
+        rec["divide_diffs"] = diffs[:40]
+        if not rec["equal"]:
+            problems.append(f"{name}: engine {rec['engine_nodes']} vs python-chess {ref_total}")
+        if rec["stderr"].strip():
+            problems.append(f"{name}: engine wrote to stderr: {rec['stderr'].strip()[:200]}")
+        rows.append(rec)
+        print(f"{name:22s} depth {depth}  engine {rec['engine_nodes']:>10d}  "
+              f"python-chess {ref_total:>10d}  {'EQUAL' if rec['equal'] else 'DIFFERENT'}",
+              flush=True)
+        with open(os.path.join(outdir, name + ".json"), "w") as fh:
+            json.dump(rec, fh, indent=1)
+    with open(os.path.join(outdir, "all.json"), "w") as fh:
+        json.dump(rows, fh, indent=1)
+    print()
+    if problems:
+        print("PROBLEMS:")
+        for item in problems:
+            print("  -", item)
+        sys.exit(1)
+    print(f"OK: {len(rows)} positions, every perft total equal to python-chess, "
+          f"every divide line equal, no stderr output.")
+
+
+def perft(board, depth):
+    if depth <= 0:
+        return 1
+    if depth == 1:
+        return board.legal_moves.count()
+    total = 0
+    for move in board.legal_moves:
+        board.push(move)
+        total += perft(board, depth - 1)
+        board.pop()
+    return total
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
